[color=#5f95cc]1. Black Market Improvement[/color]
Black Market has been improved.
Our priority is to prevent and fix errors related to the Black Market and newly applied features, and to ensure their stability.

Therefore, the Costume Combo Sales feature, originally scheduled to be implemented along with the Black Market improvement, has been postponed.

A separate notice will be made when the Costume Combo Sales feature is implemented in the future. We sincerely apologize for not being able to update according to the previously announced schedule.

[color=#ffae42]▶ Display Adjustments[/color]
Unregistered items are no longer displayed in the Black Market and Purchase reservation Black Market.The Black Market will display items from lowest to highest price, while the Purchase reservation Black Market will display items from highest to lowest price.
[color=#ffae42]▶ New Filters[/color]
In Black Market, the [Core], [Module], [Trinket], and [Amplifier] filters have been updated with new options: [Quality Grade] and [Enhancement Lv.].In Purchase reservation Black Market, [Quality Grade], [Enhancement Lv.] and [Max Tuning Grade] filter will not be displayed.
[color=#ffae42]▶ New Search Feature[/color]
Entering the (*) symbol allows you to search all items related to the text, excluding the symbol.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Additional Notes on Black Market Improvements[/color]
After the Sep 24 update, all Market Fee in Black Market will be fixed at 10%.During the Sep 24 maintenance, all Black Market listings will be treated as expired (unsold).Certain images and contents have been updated in the Game Guide according to the Black Market improvements.

notes.content:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d32144519fe250e790ad3ce2a591edec86d3dfee.png

▶ Event Overview

[table][tr][td]
What are [Firecracker]?
[/td][td][Firecracker] is an event item that is only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period and can be acquired from both the Cash Shop and in-game.Using [Firecracker] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What are [Festival Points]?
[/td][td][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points has been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?
[/td][td]The Server Buff applies buff effects to all players and all characters.The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?
[/td][td]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What are some other benefits?
[/td][td]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Troubleshooter outfit (B type) and other exclusive rewards!The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/td][/tr][tr][td]
What determines the ranks?

notes.title: [GM Note] Together, We Go Further! PD Leadership Update!
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, I would like to share an important announcement with all Agents.

In order to provide long-term service for Closers and to strengthen our communication with all Agents, we are pleased to inform you of an update to our PD leadership.

PD Hyun-Jun Kang who is currently managing Closers will oversee the overall management. In addition, a new PD has joined the Closers project to further support and enhance the game's direction.

With both PDs now working together, Closers will continue to develop in a more positive direction, with increased communication and engagement with all Agents.

Accordingly, we have conducted an interview with each PD to address the questions you may have.

We are pleased to now share their responses with you.
Shall we begin?


[color=#89CFF0]▶ Interview with PD Hyun-Jun Kang[/color]

Q. Over the past two years, you’ve overseen many updates as the dedicated PD of Closers. To what extent do you feel your initial goals have been achieved?

A. When I first assumed the role of PD for Closers, my top priority was “optimization.”
As the game had been live for many years, various efforts had been made to enhance the environment—such as transitioning to 64-bit, supporting 120 FPS, and upgrading to DirectX 11. However, these improvements had sometimes led to unintended issues, including frame drops and performance degradation.

With that in mind, I firmly believed that establishing a stable and seamless environment should come first.
I would say that approximately 85% of the goals I set have been achieved over the past two years.

Another objective was to revitalize the narrative flow among the teams.
To that end, we actively developed new characters and made considerable efforts to integrate them naturally into the existing teams—for example, characters such as Ria Yoon and Triss. I'm grateful that many Agents responded positively to these additions.


Q. There have been various updates, including Break Challenge, new characters, raids, and QoL improvements. What were the guiding principles behind these decisions?

A. Rather than following a rigid structure, I focused on identifying what was most needed at each point in time.
During summer and winter, we prioritized large-scale content, while spring and fall were typically dedicated to system improvements and quality-of-life updates.

At each stage, we carefully examined what the Agents most needed and what areas required enhancement, allowing us to determine the proper priorities. Thanks to this approach, each seasonal update took on its own unique characteristics.


Q. Among the updates that have been released thus far, is there anything you found regrettable?

A. In our efforts to enhance the enjoyment of farming, we implemented various initiatives—one of which was Break Challenge: Fly King.

At the time, we wanted to introduce an element of randomness to break away from the monotony of existing farming structures. Additionally, we sought to reinterpret existing raid bosses in new ways to offer a fresh combat experience.

However, in hindsight, we recognize that this approach may not have aligned with the expectations of our Agents. The random nature without guaranteed drops, and the lack of intuitive combat patterns, ultimately caused inconvenience. I feel bad that we were not able to fully deliver the enjoyment we had intended.


Q. On a different note—could you tell us a bit about the newly joining PD?

A. The new PD has a wealth of experience operating a wide range of games, having worked with our company for many years. Most importantly, he has a genuine affection and passion for Closers.

With his diverse background, he brings a fresh perspective and new approaches. I firmly believe he will offer new enjoyment and improved experiences for our Agents. As I continue to oversee overall management, I will work closely with him and share insights to ensure consistent quality going forward.

I kindly ask for your warm support and encouragement for our newly joined PD.

 
[color=#89CFF0]▶ Interview with PD Lee Hyun Soo[/color]

Q. You seem like a familiar face. Could you please introduce yourself briefly?

A. Greetings. My name is Lee Hyunsoo, and I have recently joined Closers as its sixth PD.
It has now been over seven years since I joined NADDIC Games. Although I officially became part of the Closers team around May of this year, I had already been observing the project and the work of previous PDs closely in the company.

While I am no longer active in broadcasting area, there may be some who recognize me from occasional appearances on game-related broadcasts. If, by unfortunate algorithmic recommendation, my face happened to reach your screen, I extend my apologies for any visual inconvenience caused.


Q. How do you feel about stepping into the role of PD following PD Hyun Jun Kang?

A. I feel a great sense of responsibility.

“Sixth.”

The fact that the number has increased by one may seem trivial, but it carries significant weight. Of course, the number itself is not as important as the role it signifies. I hope to serve as a “Bridge”, maintaining the positive legacy built by the previous PDs while also steadily addressing areas for improvement. Rather than declaring a complete overhaul, I intend to take a thoughtful approach—focusing on consistent improvement and advancement based on the foundation that has already been established.


Q. Have you been playing Closers since the beginning?

A. Closers is a title I have followed since its early development phase. Although circumstances led to it being serviced by another publisher at the time, I continued to observe its progress with interest. After joining NADDIC Games, I became even more closely involved with the project. There was a brief period when I had to step away due to other responsibilities, but I have since returned and am now fully dedicated to the project.


Q. Which characters are you currently playing?

A. While I do play all characters, I currently focus primarily on five:
Yuri, Triss, Mistel, Lucy, and Ria.


Q. Many Agents may feel uncertain due to the leadership change. Will this shift in PD result in any significant changes to update schedules or overall direction?
A. While the change may appear sudden from the perspective of our Agents, I have in fact been working alongside PD Kang prior to formally taking on the role, sharing in decision-making as part of the transition process. Both PD Kang and I have placed strong emphasis on striking a balance between continuity and change. 

Major scheduled updates will proceed as planned, without significant alterations. In between, we intend to introduce improvements to outdated systems where necessary. 

In particular, we are committed to responding promptly to ongoing concerns raised by our Agents—such as service stability and suggestions regarding update content. While we recognize that there may still be room for improvement, we are actively gathering feedback across various channels and will do our best to address it accordingly. We ask for your continued patience and support as we move forward.


Q. Were there any aspects of Closers you personally hoped to improve upon once you became PD?

A. One of my medium- to long-term goals is to move beyond repetitive gameplay loops, such as “Xue/Triss/Gildal” or “Dogra/Magra/Integrated Farming Dungeon,” and instead create spaces and moments where Agents can truly enjoy staying within the game. In addition, as the service lifespan of Closers grows longer, we have seen a gradual decline in accessibility for new and returning Agents. I aim to explore ways to open up these entry points once again. Of course, no single solution can address everything. Therefore, I hope to experiment with various approaches and remain open to strong feedback if our direction ever diverges from expectations. Our Agents’ voices will serve as the foundation for growth and positive change.


Q. There are a few updates that were previously announced but have yet to be implemented—for example, the Crew Leader Delegation system and bundled costume sales. What is the current status of these items?

A. These features have not been abandoned. They remain on our list of pending development tasks. We fully understand that many Agents are awaiting these updates and have expressed their opinions regarding them. Although their implementation has been delayed due to a focus on service stability, we will make every effort to resume development and apply them as soon as possible. 
Given that Closers is a title that has been developed over many years and by many hands, certain changes—even minor ones—can produce unexpected ripple effects. Some delays arise from the need to introduce new systems while also ensuring overall stability. That said, we recognize the importance of keeping our Agents informed and offering transparency about the status of such developments. We will work to not only deliver quality content, but also to communicate more frequently with you—sharing our thoughts and development progress more openly and regularly.


Q. Do you have any unique strategies or approaches to further revitalize Closers?

A. First and foremost, we are preparing a space and time in which we can actively listen to the voices of our Agents. While we are still finalizing the schedule and format, we plan to hold a session where feedback can be heard in real time—or as close to it as possible. We will provide detailed information regarding the schedule and method in the near future.


Q. Could you share your vision or any final message for the Agents of Closers?

A. This coming winter, Closers will celebrate its 11th anniversary, launching in Korea. While it may sound cliché, our development team—including PD Hyun Jun Kang as the overall manager—will continue to unite our efforts in order to ensure that Closers remains a game you can enjoy with satisfaction not only now, but all the way to its 20th anniversary and beyond.

Thank you for your continued support.

Today, we have shared interviews with PD Lee Hyun Soo, who has newly joined Closers, and PD Hyun-Jun Kang, who will continue to oversee overall management.

Lastly, both PDs have each written a special message for all Closers Agents.
 
Please click the link below to read their letters:
PD Hyun-Jun Kang’s Developer's LetterPD Lee Hyun Soo’s Developer's Letter
To commemorate the appointment of the new PD, we are pleased to provide a special reward to all Agents.

We look forward to your continued interest and support as Closers strives to grow and communicate more closely with all Agents.

Thank you.

[color=#5f95cc]1. Raid Entry System[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ New Raid Entry System[/color]
A new [Raid Entry System] has been added starting with the new raid.While in a party, the leader can access the Dungeon Entry System from the Dungeon Entry NPC or the ‘Unified Entry System.’
[color=#ffae42]▶ Raid Theme Select Window[/color]
Left click the Form Raid button to display the Raid theme select window.You can only enter the Raid when you are in a party.Only the party leader can initiate raid entry.If the entry requirements are not met, a message will appear stating you cannot enter the raid, along with the name of the required mission.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Raid Status Board[/color]
The leader can use the Dungeon Status Board to select a dungeon, check party information, and view active effects and dungeon details.The Raid Status Board can be closed using the [X] button on the right side of the status window or the [ESC] key. Chat and other functions are available in town.Leaving the squad will immediately remove you from the raid party and close the Raid Status Board.Only the leader can use the [Forfeit Raid] button. When the leader gives up the raid, then the raid will end immediately, but the party will remain intact.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Raid Status Board - Squad Info[/color]
Displays character names and TCP of the members.Right clicking the character area in the Squad Info window will display related details.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Raid Status Board - Select Dungeon[/color]
Effect will be disappear from the dungeon where already cleared once. A buff icon will appear below the name of any dungeon that provides a buff.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Raid Status Board - Active Effects[/color]
Displays the buff obtained after clearing the specified buff dungeon.Shows the total values of all acquired buffs.Buff effects shown under ‘Active Effects’ apply only to the current dungeon in progress.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Raid Status Board - Dungeon Info[/color]
Displays the selected dungeon’s name, recommended TCP, dungeon type, Bonus REWARD count, and gear level.

notes.title: [Developer Diary] Introducing the New Character 'Triss'
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today’s Developer Diary covers the 22nd character, available last August 6th!

We asked various departments about the birth and background of Wolfdog’s Triss, and gathered their responses.

Let’s dive into the behind-the-scenes stories!

Q. Can you introduce Triss’s initial concept?

[color=#89CFF0]Scenario Team:[/color]
Triss is the younger sister of Levia, a playable character, and like her sister, she is a dimensional monster and a Closer. Many Agents may already be familiar with her origin, as you witnessed it firsthand. In a way, Triss was born thanks to your help.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9f0c6e9be5ec219aab442ba407ed71bd6959e9c9.png
In fact, Triss treasures the outfit her sister Levia gave her (灬º‿º灬)♡

At first, she couldn’t control the aura of wrath within her, causing some trouble. But with the help of the Closers and her own determination, she overcame the aura of wrath and even fought against Gildal and the Order alongside other Closers. However, letting go of the aura of wrath came at a cost. She lost much of her power and began to drift, unsure whether she truly belonged among humans. Due to this, and for other reasons revealed later, Triss embarks on her own journey. At the start of the story, she is not yet part of the Wolfdog team, much like Ria, and only joins after completing her personal journey. The main storyline will explore in depth how Triss became a "Vagabond," wandering to grow stronger.

One key trait to highlight is that Triss is both child and adult.

She appears mature and thinks like an adult, but she also shows childlike tastes and mindset. We put great effort into balancing these contrasting qualities, and we hope players will appreciate that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ef230e1d4c81e1787e3eda64b58047a629a98510.png

Q. Why was Triss designed as a tall character?
 
[color=#89CFF0]Scenario Team:[/color]
Initially, we imagined her as a small, cute child, which seemed natural for a newly born character. But we felt that was too predictable and dull. So we took a bold direction and made her taller than her older sister, adding an unexpected twist. This led to other traits, like her being self-conscious about her height and loving small, cute things.


Q. Any specific concept or inspiration behind Triss’s mature appearance?
 
[color=#c3a3ff]Character Art Team:[/color]
We began with the contrast “Levia like a round-faced puppy, Triss like a sharp-featured cat.”
We explored many “cool beauty” archetypes and ultimately shaped Triss from there.


Q. It must’ve been challenging to reflect her various roles, such as Levia’s sister and a member of the dragon race.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/50af3bb3d0d4f56750d5b7c00b081efc797634c1.jpg
A rough image reflecting the extensive consideration!

[color=#c3a3ff]Character Art Team:[/color]
Here’s the first rough sketch.
Unlike the cute sister, Triss was planned to be an ice queen, so we aimed for a chic vibe.
We also thought a lot about how to reflect their parents’ genes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fa7744229ffc81b3a775f6ba24d13b1c9dba7642.jpg

First draft after mindful considerations.
We debated over white vs. black hair and ultimately chose black as the base.
Triss was the first character to transition from a boss to a playable character, so we put a lot of effort into finding a balance between the two roles. While she needed to be a "playable" character who would be loved and supported by Agents, we also had to blend in the qualities of a “boss” character, as she was originally introduced as the formidable enemy commander of the Dragon Legion. Combining these two seemingly opposing elements in a natural and compelling way was a key part of the design process.

When deciding who Triss's horns and outfit should resemble, we ultimately felt it made the most sense for her to take after her father in the story. As a result, we drew heavily from Hecatoncheir’s design when creating her appearance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/58c1e49571cdc4bc1ffea1ed580ef554507ba228.jpg
Unfortunately, the ribbon was dropped in the final version (☍д⁰)

This is the final version of Triss's face design.
Although we decided to choose black as the base, we added purple highlights to express individuality. 
Because of her Evil Eye concept, we gave her eyes a unique look to differentiate her from other characters, while maintaining a connection to her sister Levia through matching eyeliner and eye color.

In the initial drafts, her hair was designed to be tied with a ribbon. The backstory was that Levia had tied it for her when Triss was born, but that detail was unfortunately removed during the revision process.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ccb52db7da75efc2f80dbe3e7f21776c47cda018.jpg
Which costume do you like the most?

We spent a lot of time deciding on the 1st draft.
It all started with the question: 'What kind of outfit would Triss wear when she first came into the world?'
We chose leather-based clothes to enhance her confident, sword-fighter image.

We wanted to highlight her hips and thighs, so we aimed for a design that would showcase those features as much as possible, while still keeping things simple since it’s her base outfit.

 
Q. Let’s talk about the illustration. What was most important in designing Triss’s illustrations?
 
[color=#c3a3ff]Character Art Team:[/color]
We especially focused on the abdomen and thigh areas to emphasize her silhouette. We believe a character with a beautiful body line is always appealing.


Q. Since all of Triss’s promotions have been released at once, what were the key points you focused on for each promotion illustration? Could you also explain the differences between them?
 
[color=#c3a3ff]Character Art Team:[/color]
The key points are as follows:

Regular Operative
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ee918bbf6029ae3842c2957a0fe12cf3bdc9dd5a.png
We focused on subtly revealing skin through gaps in the outfit. 
Rather than emphasizing excessive exposure, we aimed to highlight elegance by accentuating the body’s natural silhouette.

Special Operative
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/69c2dfa3e7f8079b7424c9d2d60574c07f94a2c0.png
Since the silhouette was similar to the regular outfit, we enhanced it with more elaborate and eye-catching elements. 
We placed particular emphasis on textures like decorative accents and transparent materials.

Fatal Crew
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/65fffe29e788a61a98db677573deb3eb6ee03b3f.png
We moved away from the usual front-facing composition and opted for a pose that combines her side and back view.
The key highlights are the sharp side profile of her face and the flowing body line from hips to thighs.
We gave particular attention to emphasizing hips and thighs. ^^d

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/99aebfc33eda81e65827159a39c27f79c60387cd.png

Q. Let’s move on to her weapon. Why was a greatsword chosen for Triss?

[color=#4d4de6]Planning Team:[/color]
The initial concept began with contrasting Triss against her sister, Levia.

Levia uses a staff to channel energy attacks in the form of orbs and projectiles, so for Triss, we aimed for a completely different combat style.

Given her "cool beauty" visual concept, we explored weapon types that would complement that. Favoring something simple, heavy, and metallic over something flashy or lightweight.

To contrast with Levia’s blunt staff, we decided on a bladed weapon, one that would focus on slashing and piercing physical attacks.

We also wanted to reflect the overwhelming presence of her father, Hecatoncheir, a massive and intimidating being, comparable in size to a skyscraper. To carry that symbolism forward, we gave Triss a similarly imposing weapon, which led to the decision to equip her with a greatsword.

Cold, Massive Greatsword.

The overwhelming destructive power of the massive weapon was ultimately defined as the core of Triss’s combat style and identity.


[color=#89CFF0]Scenario Team:[/color]
There’s narrative meaning behind choosing a sword.
In the dragon clan, many dimensional monsters use swords, like the Vagabond, Astaroth, and Mamba after their transformations. We envisioned Triss as a young dragon following her clan’s tradition and growing by training in swordsmanship. Her class name “VAGABOND” reflects both her connection to the original Vagabond and her growth through wandering and self-training.


Q. What were some key visual effects and animations for Triss?

[color=#90EE90]VFX Team:[/color]
Triss’s greatsword led us to focus on the impact and weight of each skill.

[previewyoutube=NerL0MfU0w0;full][/previewyoutube]
We emphasized the flow from charging, slashing, and the lingering shock after impact.

[table][tr][td][previewyoutube=kqTM6OMrU_g;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=fzsTxK-e7zQ;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][/table]
While Levia’s effects involve curves and explosions, Triss’s are direct and cutting across the battlefield.

While the overall color scheme remains subdued, we adjusted it to evoke a sense of intimidation. We also simplified the visual elements boldly to increase density and ensure powerful immersion, even in short bursts of action.

[color=#FFAC1C]Animation Team:[/color]
When creating the animations, we prioritized the tempo of a high-speed action game and the defining characteristics of the greatsword. Our goal was to allow for fast attacks without making them feel too light or unnatural, so we focused heavily on balancing weight and speed.

During production, we experimented with long, heavy objects to explore how such a weapon should move to feel natural, powerful, and satisfying.

Since the greatsword is nearly as tall as the character herself, we designed the motion with a lowered center of gravity, allowing the character's lower body movements to emphasize the weight and arc of each swing.

[table][tr][td][previewyoutube=rqw0gZR3PUE;full][/previewyoutube]
Her dance and emote animations are also designed to highlight lower body movement!
⸜(⠀  ᐢ ᵕ ᐢ  )⸝⸜(  ᐢ ᵕ ᐢ    )⸝‍
[/td][/tr][/table]

We made great effort to let players feel both the weight of the greatsword and the speed of Closers.

Q. How is Triss set apart from other characters?

[color=#90EE90]VFX Team:[/color]
Although Levia and Triss belong to the same lineage, their personalities and combat styles are completely different. That’s why we felt it was important to express them visually in distinct ways.

We adjusted the colors and tones of the effects and also developed new visual techniques such as distortion, grayscale, and inversion to better match the mood and identity of Triss's skills.

[table][tr][td][previewyoutube=YaVJQIW5kQg;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=DJUwEoGEa60;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][tr][td][previewyoutube=KhzMxEHD47Y;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=RMbSYsqSsik;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][/table]
(Left - original / Right - Slo-mo)

We believe these attempts helped elevate the overall tone of the effects, making them more refined, and significantly enhanced the sense of immersion during combat.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6d1db7f34c52c4bad7b2f39fa112001a1d2354b9.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a7ba74fcdf79d6c241d2eb70eda3fc33be52f410.png[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0]Scenario Team:[/color]
In the scenario, the most important focus was bringing to life the concept of Triss transitioning from a boss to a playable character. After receiving the planning request, the biggest challenge was making her appealing even as an enemy, while ensuring that her shift to a playable character wouldn’t feel awkward or unnatural. After all, we couldn’t make a simple villain, or a character who left a deeply negative impression on players, into someone they would actively want to play. This was one of the key considerations in the  scenario. We worked hard to portray her as an enemy, yet still compelling and guided by a strong sense of justice.

Another point we paid special attention to in terms of her background was giving Triss a narrative that aligns with the vibe of the Wolfdog team. After much discussion, we concluded that the most essential trait of a Wolfdog member is the yearning for freedom and the willingness to fight for it. Based on that, we shaped her character and story accordingly. We also revisited the past narrative of the Wolfdog team and made a conscious effort to build on it and evolve it in a meaningful way. We hope players will look forward to what we've prepared.

Q. Finally, what kind of players would enjoy Triss?
 
[color=#4d4de6]Planning Team:[/color]
We recommend Triss to players who are familiar with rhythmical skill inputs based on different combat situations. She’s especially suited for those who enjoy refining their mastery by minimizing downtime between skills and discovering faster attack tempos.

That wraps up the origin story of the 22nd new character, Triss!

We hope you’ll show lots of love and support for this new character joining our journey. Thank you!

notes.title: July 9th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png

[color=#5f95cc]Characters[/color]

[color=#5f95cc]1. 1st Skill System Revamp[/color]
 Skill system has been revamped.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Skill Point Revamp[/color]
 Character lv. specific Skill Points are applied to all characters regardless of the character’s current SP.
 All characters now receive 3 Skill Points for each level increase.
 All characters receive 5 Skill Points for each 10 level increase. (i.e. At lv.10, lv.20... lv.90)
 Skill Points granted every 10 levels will not be distributed together with Skill Upgrade Points.
※ It will be 303 Skill Points when the character reaches lv.95.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Active Skill Revamp[/color]
 Active Skills no longer consume Skill Points directly.
 Skills are now learned automatically based on Promotion requirement and level.
 [Support] skill items are no longer consumed. Skills will be automatically learned once the requirements are met.
 All eligible skills will auto-level when the character levels up.
 Skills eligible for EX conversion will be automatically converted.
 The passive learning requirement has been removed from the 5th Skill's learning requirement.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Passive Skill Revamp[/color]
 Polish Passive Skills remain unchanged and are still optional to use.
 Passive Skills remain unchanged and levels can still be adjusted.
 Character specific Passive Skills no longer consume Skill Points to level up.
 5th Passive Skill level is no longer adjustable, stat increase is now fixed at the current max level.
※ All Passive Skill Points will be reset after the update. Please redistribute them accordingly.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Skill Ticket Item Adjustment[/color]

 Skill Tickets are no longer usable following the skill system revamp. 'Unusable' has been added to the item description.
 Skill tickets have been discontinued from the UNION Store.
 The following methods are no longer available to acquire Skill Tickets:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bc0589ee90de3259e8f5ab077aa111dca9db88da.png
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ UI Adjustment[/color]
 [Skill Reset] check box in the Active Skill tab: the [EX] and [Master] buttons are no longer displayed.
 In Skill Tip descriptions, the requirements for already fulfilled conditions are no longer displayed.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Additional Notes on the UI Adjustment[/color]
 Active skills are now automatically sorted by learning order in the character’s skill window.
 A notification will be displayed when a new skill is learned through upgrading.
 A notification will be displayed when a learned skill is upgraded.
[color=#5f95cc]New Contents[/color]

[color=#5f95cc]1. Integrated Farming Dungeon[/color]
 Introduced the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.
 Collectable items such as Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residues etc can be acquired in the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Entering the Integrated Farming Dungeon[/color]
 Complete the [Triumph] Mission in the [Scenery Beyond the Gate] episode with character Lv 95 or higher, and you can enter the dungeon via .
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Integrated Farming Dungeon Details[/color]
 You can enter each dungeon via  and acquire different rewards in each dungeon.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/eef3c41d4896ef9b435feda18b0dadfd844f5630.png


[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Available Rewards[/color]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f15a66143ddf5588dcd230c6807a6f29aef27ca5.png

[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Additional Details[/color]
 Certain dungeon rewards have been removed due to the introduction of the Integrated Farming Dungeon.
 The following dungeon rewards & PNA EXP have been removed:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60302a13efe8bf05d4307056d7fb70cd12556c2b.png

 Certain drop rewards listed above have been transferred to the Integrated Farming Dungeon reward pool.
 With the removal of certain material acquisition methods, related crafting recipes and upgrade materials will be adjusted.
※ The current crafting recipes will be removed in the future. A separate notice will be issued before removal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bb491851c270a99edf01c4d25b7dac0e8b9b2f49.png

[color=#5f95cc]Systems[/color]

[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Matter Mixer Update[/color]
 Matter Mixer has been updated.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Material Item Search[/color]
 Introduced a new material item search feature.
 You can toggle the [Material Item Search] button at the top left to enable or disable the [Material Item Search] feature.
 With [Material Item Search] enabled, you can search for a material in the search window to view the items that can be crafted with it.
 With [Material Item Search] disabled, it functions the same way as the current Matter Mixer.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Selecting Inventory Item Search[/color]
 With [Material Item Search] enabled, it will enable the Inventory Item Search feature.
 With [Material Item Search] enabled, left-clicking a selected item in your inventory will search for the material by its item name.
 A “No search result” pop-up will appear when no matching results are found.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ Additional Notes on the Matter Mixer Update[/color]
 The contents of the Matter Mixer Guide have been modified and removed to reflect adjustments.
 The Matter Mixer overall UI has been revamped to reflect the latest update.
 [Crafting time] has been removed in the Matter Mixer UI and replaced with [Crafting Item Expiry].
[color=#5f95cc]2. Entry Limit for Each Character[/color]
 Entry counts for each character have been applied to dungeons that previously had account-based entry limits.
 e.g. If a dungeon has 6 weekly entries, the entry count per character is 2 — at least 3 characters are required to use all 6 entries.
※ Entry count per character currently applies to ‘Integrated Farming Dungeons’ and will be expanded to other dungeons in the future.
 Move the mouse over the top of a character’s Entry Limit to view which characters are eligible to enter the dungeon.
[color=#5f95cc]3. Chip Crafting Recipe Adjustment[/color]
 Chip crafting recipes have been adjusted following the introduction of the Integrated Farming Dungeon.
 The following crafting recipes have been removed:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6f553cc33c6a8d4d3cde21876488495bb2203024.png

[color=#5f95cc]4. Added Awakening Cube Crafting Recipes[/color]
 Added character’s awakening cube crafting recipes to the Matter Mixer.
 Awakening Cubes can be crafted by consuming 1m Credits.
[color=#5f95cc]5. Added a New Dungeon Feature to confirm Shared Entry Limits[/color]
 Move the mouse over the upper area of the Confirm Dungeon Entry Account / Character, the dungeon name will be displayed if a Shared Entry Count dungeon exists.

notes.title: [Developer Diary] Quick Evasion Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, we're back with a new type of content called the “Developer Diary,” which we introduced in the May 2025 Developer Letter to foster closer communication with all Agents.

Our first topic is the behind-the-scenes story of the Quick Evasion improvements.


[color=#5f95cc]0. About Quick Evasion[/color]
 
Agents, what do you think about Quick Evasion?

At present, it's usable even in midair, and it's seeing more frequent use thanks to its ability to counter Gewurah’s mechanics and synergize with Hetero Genes that grant additional benefits.

But before the overhaul, Quick Evasion felt lacking if it wasn’t equipped, yet awkward to actually use when needed.

Even when it seemed like the right time to use Quick Evasion, it was often more effective to use an invincibility skill or an ultimate move to bypass the pattern instead.

So, how did this ambiguous skill turn into the improved Quick Evasion we have now?

Let’s find out.


[color=#5f95cc]1. The Beginning of Quick Evasion Improvements[/color]

“What if we improved the inconvenience of the current Quick Evasion and encouraged more frequent use? Wouldn’t that make combat feel more dynamic and action-packed?”

That’s where the idea began.

The first step was identifying the problems with the existing Quick Evasion system.

■ Inconvenient because it couldn't be used in midair
Many aerial skills exist, but Quick Evasion couldn't be used while airborneBeing in the air often means using skills, but you couldn't use Quick Evasion while using a skill
■ High risk, little reward
Successfully using Quick Evasion gave almost no benefit, while failure came with significant risk
■ Questionable value
High risk, hard to use, and few rewardsOther skills provided invincibility and let you attack at the same time, so there was little need to use it
It was clear that Quick Evasion needed several improvements. Our first priority was to make it easier and more rewarding to use.

While considering what kind of improvements would enhance player convenience, we explored the idea of allowing Quick Evasion to be used in midair, and of granting greater rewards when it is successfully executed.

As such, we decided to first provide this convenience of midair usage and moved quickly into development.


[color=#5f95cc]2. Gewurah and Quick Evasion[/color]

The Quick Evasion revamp began during the development discussions of the new boss “Gewurah” in the Limbo of Ignorance content.

Gewurah’s concept was crystal clear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a75677b3f34c9faf343c5411e9be6cb5b22321ef.png
A battle maniac obsessed with fighting.Seeks out any strong opponent and fights them without hesitation.A wild, gladiator-like centaur.
The first things that stood out in Gewurah’s concept art were the charging silhouette on all fours and the sharp, solid horns.

“The art of combat lies not in fleeing, but in meeting your opponent head-on.”

It reminded us of fierce Spartan warriors in film.

While discussing Gewurah’s development, an idea hit us.

“What if, instead of dodging a charging monster with a movement or invincibility skill, players could execute a well-timed evasion to face the charge head-on?”

Picture a Closers character narrowly dodging a frontal charge with precise timing.

We envisioned players using Quick Evasion in that moment to make the dungeon more exciting.


[color=#5f95cc]3. Development of the Hetero Gene[/color]
 
We designed Gewurah’s battle structure to match its personality and centaur design, emphasizing powerful charging attacks.

While developing this battle structure, our biggest challenge was creating a meaningful benefit for breaking its patterns.

Since players could already evade these charges using movement or invincibility skills, Quick Evasion needed a greater incentive.

We decided to introduce a clear reward system: [Fail the evasion = Gewurah powers up / Succeed = your character powers up.]

This way, instead of just dodging, players could feel the satisfaction of precisely breaking a pattern with Quick Evasion and being rewarded with more power.

To extend this rewarding feeling beyond Gewurah, we also looked at adding similar benefits to Hetero Genes.


[color=#5f95cc]4. Development of Midair Quick Evasion[/color]

We returned to Quick Evasion with renewed focus of improving the existing problems.
Refining the skill was essential for implementing Gewurah’s pattern and the Hetero Gene.

The most critical problems were the inability to use it in midair and the inability to trigger it while using other skills.

Because Quick Evasion was originally designed for ground use, we improved it to make the skill available in the air.

We also expanded the skill cancel system so that Quick Evasion could smoothly cancel other skills in progress.

To make successful evasions more noticeable, we added a visual effect to “Just Evasion,” so players could clearly see when they pulled it off.

[table][tr][th]
Prototype 1 (Yellow Effect)
[/th][th]
Prototype 2 (Blue Effect)
[/th][/tr][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/30ce71bc013c0118695125604bdd536647326a6c.gif[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a265e12e2fd58b6cdfcd78c2ad74388bb11e3656.gif[/td][/tr][/table]
In the early concept, we considered two options for the Just Evasion effect color: yellow and blue.

■ Blue Effect
Matches many blue-tone world backgrounds (sky blue, navy, violet, etc.).Blends smoothly with other skill effects, providing visual stability.
■ Yellow Effect
High visibility due to its brightness.A flashy effect that clearly says “You nailed the Just Evasion!”
Although blue was the initial favorite due to familiarity, repeated testing swayed opinions toward yellow. It was ultimately selected for the final version.


[color=#5f95cc]5. Test Play[/color]

Through multiple stages of planning and in-depth discussions, we completed the Quick Evasion improvements.

As with any feature, we test it before releasing, so we ran a test of the new Quick Evasion.

[table][tr][th]
Quick Evasion Test
[/th][/tr][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f34e9c65b1233945ede799414333d379d83ee4eb.gif[/td][/tr][/table]
Thanks to all the development steps and refinements, the test results were satisfying, and we were able to confidently present the revamped Quick Evasion to you.


[color=#5f95cc]6. In Closing[/color]

After a great deal of planning and discussion, Quick Evasion was first updated on June 11. With the addition of Gewurah in the June 25 update, Quick Evasion became even more widely used.

Despite many challenges in both planning and development, seeing how much you Agents enjoy the improved system has made it all worth it.

Every new feature requires careful planning and collaboration with many teams. It takes time, but thanks to your continued support, we can continue to move forward.

We will keep working hard to provide more convenience and exciting improvements for a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Important Notice] Inactive Account N-Coin Removal
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

To continue providing a smooth and enjoyable gaming experience for all, we will soon begin a system update to manage long-inactive accounts.

As part of this update, unused N-Coins from inactive accounts will be removed.

As stated in our Terms of Service under Paid Services, in-game currencies that remain unused for extended periods may be subject to removal.

▶ Scheduled Removal Date

[color=#FFAC1C] July 23, 2025 at 5:00 AM UTC [/color]
If your account has been inactive or not logged into since July 23, 2024 (1 full year), your remaining N-coin balance will be subject to removal on the above date.
▶ What You Can Do
To retain your N-coin balance, please log in to your Closers game account before July 23, 2025.

[table][tr][th]Please Note[/th][/tr][tr][td]To avoid losing any unused N-coins, please make sure to log into the game itself. Logging into the official website is not enough, as only game login activity will be recognized.[/td][/tr][/table]
 
If you're having trouble accessing your account or believe your N-coins were removed in error, please reach out to us through our Customer Support Page or send an email to: support@closersonline.com as soon as possible. We are here to help!

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

notes.title: [Pre-Notice] Changes to Skill Tickets Due to Skill System Renewal
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Greetings Agents,    

The first phase of the Skill System Renewal is scheduled to be implemented on July 9, 2025.

In line with this update, the sale and acquisition of Skill Tickets will be fully discontinued. Additionally, any Skill Tickets currently in your possession will be changed to unusable items.

Therefore, if you currently have any skill ticket items, please use them all up before the update on July 9, 2025 to avoid any inconvenience.

Please refer to the detailed information below:

[color=#89CFF0]■ [Pre-Notice] Changes to Skill Tickets Due to Skill System Renewal[/color]

Schedule: After maintenance on July 9, 2025

Details:Due to the skill system renewal, Skill Ticket items will become unusable.
※ After the update, Support Skills previously obtained via Skill Tickets will be automatically granted based on character level.Skill Ticket products will be removed from the shop.The following sources will no longer provide Skill Tickets:
[color=#FFE135]Source[/color]
[table][tr][td]

One-shot Growth Lv.95

[/td][td]

NPC shop

[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0]■ Other Notes[/color]
 Skill Tickets in your inventory or storage will not be deleted.
 These items will be updated according to the new system.
 Further details on the renewal will be announced in upcoming notices.
 The schedule for the system update may change, so please stay tuned for future announcements.
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: support@closersonline.com or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

No Clearance Rewards in Easy Mode of Battle Program: Assassin of the Pole and Triss Wrathful Radiance.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dd13df905def8db9a7452b368b8035226fa442a6.png

[color=#ffae42]▶ Other Updates related to the Martyr’s Hill Battle Program [Easy][/color]
 Details on the adjustments are stated in the table below:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd275b307066bd823177940f337ceda96837ce2f.png When proceeding to the next stage (F4) of Martyr’s Hill Battle Program in [Easy] mode, you can enter the next [EASY] mode dungeon.

[color=#5f95cc]System[/color]

[color=#5f95cc]1. Mutant Manifestation Body Improvements[/color]
 Improvements made in contents related to Mutant Manifestation Body
▶ Select Manifestation Body as Preferred Choice
 You can now select ‘Preferred Choice’ in the Manifestation Body List
 Left-clicking the Preferred Choice in the Manifestation Body List allows you to designate Manifestation Body attributes
▶ Manifestation Body Continuous Manipulation
 You can now auto manipulate the Manifestation Body continuously
 If all the manipulation counts are consumed during continuous manipulation, it will auto consume the Perfect PNA Evolution Kit item in your Inventory, Personal Bank and Account Bank
 Auto Continuous Manipulation will stop when the Materials, Gold and Perfect PNA Evolution Kits are insufficient for the manipulation
 Continuous Manipulation will stop if the Preferred Choice is set up in advance
※ Manifestation Body Continuous Manipulation can only proceed after selecting 1 or more Preferred Choice
▶ Manifestation Body Guaranteed Manipulation
 Added Manifestation Body Guaranteed Manipulation
 Gain 1 Manifestation Body Guarantee Point each time you manipulate the Manifestation Body Can be accumulated up to 2000 points
 Guaranteed Manipulation Count will increase after reaching 2000 points Continuous manipulation will stop when the Guaranteed Manipulation Count is increased
 After continuous manipulation, only the highest ranked Manifestation Body is displayed in the attribute list, allowing selection of 1 option you wish for modification
 Guaranteed Manipulation Count can be accumulated up to 100 times Manifestation body manipulation will be unavailable after Guaranteed Manipulation Count is accumulated to 100
▶ Other Mutant Manifestation Body Improvements 
 Mutation Material quantities have been reduced in Manifestation body manipulation

notes.title: The Mystery Edit Challenge! - Discord Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dc34a85212e8d91daabb9b00af825783466253f6.png
 
Event Schedule
From April 7th - April 21st, every Monday at 6:00 AM UTC, ends every Monday at 5:59 AM UTC.
1st Event Image: April 7 at 10:00 AM UTC - April 13 at 11:59 PM UTC2nd Event Image: April 14 at 10:00 AM UTC - April 20 at 11:59 PM UTC3rd Event Image: April 21 at 10:00 AM UTC - April 27 at 11:59 PM UTC
 
Event Rules & ParticipationA mysterious image will be announced in the #edit-challenge-event channel every Monday at the Official Closers Discord Server.Participants must download the provided image.Get creative! Transform the image into something funny, unexpected, or completely absurd.You may use any editing tools such as Paint or Photoshop.Submit your edited image in the #event-entry channel along with 4 requirements:Your Closers NameYour Character NameA title or short caption explaining your editA mid-progress image/photo/video showing the development of your entry.
 
Event Rules[olist]No NSFW, offensive, or highly inappropriate edits. Let’s keep it fun for everyone!No AI-generated or AI-edited submissions.The Management Team reserves the right to remove or disqualify any entry deemed inappropriate, offensive, or in violation of community guidelines.This is a light-hearted event, so please be respectful of other participants' work.[/olist]

Creativity (50%)How original, funny, or out-of-the-box is your edit? Surprise us! Whether it’s absurd, clever, or just plain weird, creativity is the heart of this challenge.Relevance (30%)Does your edit clearly use the provided image and fit the theme of the event? We are looking for edits that stay connected to the source material while still going wild with it.Community Vote (20%)All entries that are posted in the #event-entry channel are open for voting. The number of ❤️ reactions your submission gets will help boost your score. Note: only ❤️ reactions are counted!
Winners Announcement & Giving of Rewards1st Event Image: April 14 at 8:00 AM UTC2nd Event Image: April 21 at 8:00 AM UTC3rd Event Image: April 28 at 8:00 AM UTC

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of the following issues that occurred after the March 19th patch update, which we are currently working on:

 Missing Forum Photos
 Some uploaded photos in the Forums have gone missing after the recent website update. Our team is actively investigating this and will do our best to recover them soon.
 Incorrect Tooltip on [April Fool] Dyeing Ampoule Lucky Pouch
 The tooltip is missing information about the Guaranteed Dyeing Ampoule. You can acquire 2~20 of Dyeing Ampoule or 1 Guaranteed Dyeing Ampoule.

 We have identified an issue where N-coin charge on the Steam platform is currently not functional. Our team is investigating the cause and working to resolve this as quickly as possible.
 Email-Related Functions Not Working at the Website
 Functions that require email sending, such as Create Account and Find Password, are not working correctly. We are aware of the issue and working to restore these functions.[/strike]

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Further updates will be provided once these issues are resolved or when we have more news to share.

▶ Fixed the issue where the Cooldown Time Reduction effect of [Mystic Tempest] was not applied when Harpy character casted [Special Skill : Draw : The Joker Queen]

▶ Fixed the issue where the Enhancement effects of [Wild Claws] and [EX Nephthys's Grace] from a single stack of [Wild Nature Release] disappeared when Seth character stacked [Wild Nature Release]

▶ Fixed the issue of the delay in [Battle Program: Triss Wrathful Radiance] clone during the line "If my sisters could’ve hatched, this is how they’d have looked like..." 

▶ Fixed the issue where the character's appearance was not displayed correctly after applying certain costumes

▶ Fixed the issue where the colors and icons of certain costumes were inconsistent

▶ Fixed the issue where using a dungeon skill within the Legion Program would repeatedly reset the skill when continuous clicking the skill button

▶ Fixed the issue where the 'Proceed to Next Ops' button was not enabled after clearing ‘Junsung Kang Memorial Quest’

▶ Fixed the incorrect dialogue in the J’s Hunter's Night main quest

notes.title: Spring Screenshot Event - Capture the beauty of spring in Closers!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fba762bb8e8503229db24140baec3e92fa8f8fec.jpg

[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
March 7, 2025 UTC - March 31, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
April 2, 2025 UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Reward Distribution[/color]
April 2, 2025 UTC (during the scheduled maintenance)

[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]

▶ Event Theme - All about Spring Season!
Spring is in the air! Capture your character's best spring-inspired look and share a story or description that brings the season to life.


▶ How to submit my entry?
Submit your entry in Closers forums.
 Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin.
 Post your screenshot and message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
 Please ensure that your image entry has a file size of 999 KB or less. You may crop or convert it to JPEG format to reduce its size. Post your entry in the [Spring 2025] Forum.
 Main Category [General Discussion]
 Subcategory [Spring 2025]
▶ Reminders
 Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry, missing info means your entry is invalid.
 Please note that using AI image creation tools may invalidate your entry.
 Follow all event mechanics and rules (see Event Rules below).
[color=#89CFF0]Reward[/color]
A total of 5 winners will receive the following:

[table][tr][td][color=#FFE135]Event Rewards[/color]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]

x1 Omega Equalizer
x20 Splendid Tuning Component

[/td][/tr][tr][td]
 Removal date of items: December 31, 2025 at 9:00 AM UTC
 Winners will be announced on April 2 through the website and the rewards will be distributed during April 2nd maintenance.[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0]Criteria for Judging[/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:
 Screenshot Creativity and Originality (40%)
Showcase the originality and charm of your character's spring outfit! Let your creativity shine with unique color palettes and cozy styles that capture the spirit of the season. Adding effects and edits to enhance your screenshot is a bonus!
 Description/Message (40%)
The story or description you provide should complement your character's spring look. Make it engaging, fun, and connected to your outfit and the spring season. Share a message that captures the essence of your character and the warmth and magic of spring!
 Community Vote (20%)
The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.
 [color=#89CFF0]Event Info & Rules[/color]
 New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
 No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from Closers Online Operation Team.
 Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
 If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
 If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
 Closers Online Operation team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
 Closers Online is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
 Event details, rewards, and schedules may change or be cancelled based on circumstances. Please check the official website or in-game notices for the latest updates. Closers Online reserves the right to final interpretation.
 Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.

notes.title: Sweety Valentine’s - Confess Your Love to your Favorite Character!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e5150f2a050f3bbcb6826bb0f57abddc5fb255b8.jpg

[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
February 7, 2025 at 4:00 AM UTC - February 17, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
February 18, 2025 UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Reward Distribution[/color]
February 19, 2025 UTC (during the scheduled maintenance)
 
[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]
▶ What are the requirements?
Post a screenshot of your favorite Closers character with your confession with a hashtag #Sweety Valentine’s.
Don’t forget to include your Closers & Character Name!
 
▶ How to submit my entry?
Submit your entry in Closers forums.
 Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin.
 Post your screenshot and message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
 Post your entry in the [Sweety Valentine’s] Forum.
 Main Category [General Discussion]
 Subcategory [Sweety Valentine’s]

[color=#89CFF0]Event Rewards[/color]
A total of 5 winners will each receive 1,500 N-Coins, offering even more chances to win than ever before!
 
[color=#89CFF0]Event Info & Rules[/color]
 New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
 Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
 All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
 All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
 No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
 Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
 If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
 You can change or update your entry, and the final entry will be the one submitted before the deadline.
 The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
 The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
 Event details, rewards, and schedules may change or be cancelled based on circumstances. Please check the official website or in-game notices for the latest updates. Closers Online reserves the right to final interpretation.
 Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.

A huge thank you to everyone who participated, and congratulations to the 3 winners for their heartfelt and thoughtful entries!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9265f129570a8505dd14f1e38e593e5cd43f1e22.png
Translated in Google Translate:
Even though I have almost no experience with this game, I'm growing fonder of it with each passing day. I discovered Closers in mid-2020; I spent a total of two months having fun leveling up, trying to understand the garden system as if it were the most important and relevant part of the game (it was something new for me, don't judge me). After that, I took a hiatus because I didn't understand anything. I don't interact with other players, which made it even more difficult for me to understand it, but my interest never died. I came back relatively recently. 4 months, maybe? I must say that I like it a lot more than before. The help, the constant updates and events were key. The best thing about New Year's? That I'm back to stay.
PS: A faithful Lucylover here.

notes.title: New Year’s Resolution – Start Your Year with a New Goal!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/abcc2913542488bba347667664ec2ec906fb978d.png

[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
January 17, 2025 at 4:00 AM UTC - February 2, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
February 5, 2025 UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]

[color=#FFAC1C]▶ What are the requirements?[/color]
Write a minimum of 30 words to share your New Year's resolution. It can be Closers-related or about anything else you like!

[color=#FFAC1C]▶ How to submit my entry?[/color]
 Submit your entry in Closers forums.
 Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin
 Post your message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
 Make sure it is under the [NewYear's Resolution] Tab:
 Main Category [General Discussion]
 Subcategory [NewYear's Resolution]
 Shortcut to [NewYear's Resolution] Forum

[color=#89CFF0]Event Info & Rules[/color]
 New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
 Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
 All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
 All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
 No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
 Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
 If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
 You can change or update your entry, and the final entry will be the one submitted before the deadline.
 The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
 The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
 Event details, rewards, and schedules may change or be canceled based on circumstances. Please check the official website or in-game notices for the latest updates. Closers Online reserves the right to final interpretation.
 Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:
 UTC: January 15, 2025 from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM

Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.
Official Closers Facebook FanpageOfficial Closers Twitter PageOfficial Closers Discord ServerOfficial Closers YouTube ChannelWe appreciate your patience and understanding!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0d3fc07c7453adb3e6a649df6f8ee1ad8ca6b0c5.png
 
[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]

[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
December 31, 2024 UTC


[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]
In this exciting event, we’re inviting all Agents to share your favorite game or patch updates from the Closers World server in 2024.

What updates caught your attention? Which ones made the biggest impact or brought the most fun? Now’s your chance to highlight the changes that stood out to you and left a lasting impression!

[color=#FFAC1C]▶ What are the requirements?[/color]
Participants must provide a title/topic for their entry.Write a minimum of 100 words describing your favorite 2024 update in the Closers World server.Your entry should be in paragraph or bullet form, explaining why this particular update is your favorite and how it impacted your gameplay experience.
[color=#FFAC1C]▶ How to submit my entry?[/color]
Submit your entry in Closers forums.
Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signinPost your message with your Closers Name & Character Name.Make sure it is under the [2024 Favorites] Tab:Main Category [General Discussion]Subcategory [2024 Favorites]).Shortcut to [2024 Favorites] Forum[color=#89CFF0]Sample Entry[/color]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8890ec5f81bc5f952c7d2b6e8cdda34da7ffc8ad.png
 

[color=#89CFF0]Reward[/color]
A total of 3 winners will receive the following:
[table][tr][td]
[color=#FFE135]Event Reward[/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]
 
1,500 N-Coins
 
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Winners will be announced on December 31 through the website and the rewards will be distributed during January 2nd maintenance.[/td][/tr][/table]
 
[color=#5f95cc]Criteria for Judging[/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:
Content & Relevance (40%)The depth and relevance of the entry to the favorite patch update. The entry should provide meaningful and on-topic information.Organization & Structure (30%)The clarity of the entry's structure, including a clear introduction, body, and conclusion. The ideas should be easy to follow.Creativity & Originality (20%)The uniqueness and originality of the entry. The participant should offer a fresh and interesting perspective on the topic, especially if the same topic has already been mentioned by another participant(s).Clarity (10%)The quality of writing, including grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure. The entry should be clear and easy to understand.
[color=#5f95cc]Event Info & Rules[/color]
New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.You can change or update your entry, and the final entry will be the one submitted before the deadline.The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.

[color=#5f95cc]2. Black Market Improvement[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Black Market Search System has been improved.[/color]

 When clicking on each tab in the Black Market, the display method has been improved so that the color of the tab you are currently viewing changes.
 The ‘Character’ filter has been added to the  of the Costume and Accessory category in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs.
 In the Accessory category, the ‘Character’ filter can only search ‘All’.
 The default filter settings for the Costume and Accessory category in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs have been changed.  Rarity: All / Equipped Part: All / Character: All The ‘Favorites List’ button has been removed from areas other than the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs.
 When you click on the ‘Favorites List’ in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs and move to the market or tab, the Favorites List will automatically close.
 The item type filter in the ‘All Search’ category in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs has been subdivided.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5e7f832bc8a0cb2781f0cb291316ee4675a2af27.png
[color=#ffae42]▶ The method of registering and purchasing Black Market items and displaying Purchase History has been improved.[/color]
 When registering items for sale in [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market], the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ in each tab has been changed to be displayed in the ‘Unit Price’. 
 When registering items for sale in [Private Sales Black Market], the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ in the [Black Market] tab has been changed to be displayed.
 If there are no items currently for sale, the ‘Recent Average Price’ will be applied as the selling price per unit when registering items for sale. When purchasing items in the Black Market, the N mark has been Changed to be immediately applied to the ‘Purchase History’ tab without having to re-open the Black Market or click the Purchase History tab.
 The method of removing the N mark in the Black Market ‘Purchase History’ tab has been changed. 
 Before: N mark removed when receiving items with [Receive all Credits / Items] button
 After: N mark removed when receiving all items in Purchase History When purchasing the last item registered in [Black Market] or [Purchase Reservation Black Market], a system message is displayed instead of a pop-up window.
 When purchasing the last item, the screen is refreshed to the previous search screen. 
[color=#ffae42]▶ Some items have been changed to untradeable at Black Market Specification.[/color]
 Items that are currently unobtainable, items that have rarely been traded in the past 6 months, old items, or items with very low necessity have been changed to specifications that cannot be traded in the Black Market.
 Target Item: Malek's Legacy, Skull Queen's Sight, Corrupted Treasure Shard, Magical Horn, Dragon's Broken Blade, Otherworldly Refugee's Horn and more
 For items other than the announced Items, please refer to the Black Market Trade Specification through the Tooltip. 
 Gear Items that were changed to Untradeable specification at Black Market have been changed to Cannot Repackage Specification. 
 All items registered in the Black Market before the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024 have been processed as failure in bidding during the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024.
 Items that have been changed to be untradeable for black market among the items that have been processed as failure in bidding cannot be re-registered after the maintenance.

notes.title: Pre-Notice on Black Market Renewal planned on Nov 20, 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned Black Market Renewal scheduled on November 20, 2024 maintenance.

Please check the following information for more details.
 
[color=#89CFF0]■ Black Market Renew Pre-Notice[/color]
Schedule: During the maintenance on November 20, 2024

Details
[olist] All items registered in the Black Market will be processed as failure in bidding during the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024.
 Items that are currently unobtainable, items that have rarely been traded in the past 6 months, old items, or items with very low necessity will be changed to specifications that cannot be traded in the Black Market after the maintenance.

(Example : Malek's Legacy, Skull Queen's Sight, Corrupted Treasure Shard, Magical Horn, Dragon's Broken Blade, Otherworldly Refugee's Horn and more)
[color=#89CFF0]* Costume Items are excluded from specification changes.[/color]
 In the Item Search tab of the ‘Black Market’ and ‘Purchase Reservation Black Market’, the ‘Character’ filter will be added to the  of the [Costume] and [Accessory] categories, and the default rarity filter will be changed to ‘All’.
 When you select the desired information for rarity, equipped part, and character and press the [Search] button, the currently sold costumes with the corresponding conditions will be displayed in the item list.
 In the main category of the search  of the ‘Black Market’ and ‘Purchase Reservation Black Market’, ‘Enhancement/Tuning Materials’ will be changed to ‘Consumables’, and the subcategories of potions, boxes, and consumables will be added/changed.

 When an item is first registered, the unit price will be changed to be applied as the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ of the currently registered item by default.
[color=#89CFF0]* Applied as the lowest price in each tab of Normal, Private Sale, Purchase Reservation.[/color][/olist]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

notes.content:

November 4, 2024 - November 29, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC


[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
December 3, 2024


[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]

▶ Event Theme - All about Autumn/Fall Season!
Show off your character’s best fall-themed look! Share a screenshot and a story or description that brings your autumn style to life!


▶ How submit my entry?
 Log in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin
 After you logged-in to your account, visit this link: Forum - Art & Media
 Select the "Create" button and provide the following:[olist]
 Input in Title: [Autumn Event]
 Attach your screenshot entry and input your message.
 Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist]
▶ Reminders
 Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry, missing info means your entry is invalid.
 Please note that using AI image creation tools may invalidate your entry.
 Follow all event mechanics and rules (see Event Rules below).

[color=#89CFF0]Sample Entry[/color]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b60b2ec6fc8abaa4d407dc0c1d910fad6e1af6f8.png

My Harpy's look is cozy and ready for fall!

Warm clothes, bright autumn colors, and a soft breeze give me a happy, comfy feeling perfect for this autumn season.

Closers Name: AutumnLeaf
Character: Harpy


[color=#89CFF0]Reward[/color]
A total of 3 winners will receive the following:

[table][tr][td][color=#FFE135]Event Reward[/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]

1,500 N-Coins

[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Winners will be announced on December 3 through the website and the rewards will be distributed during December 4th maintenance.[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0]Criteria for Judging[/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:

 Screenshot Creativity and Originality (40%)
 Showcase the originality and charm of your character’s autumn outfit! Let your creativity shine with unique color palettes and cozy styles that capture the essence of the fall season. Adding effects and edits to enhance your screenshot is a bonus!
 Description/Message (40%)
 The story or description you provide should complement your character’s autumn look. Make it engaging, fun, and connected to your outfit and the fall season. Share a message that captures the essence of your character and the warmth and magic of autumn!
 Community Vote (20%)
 The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.

[color=#89CFF0]Event Rules[/color]
 New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
 Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
 All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
 All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
 No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
 Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
 If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
 If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
 The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
 The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
 Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned removal and change of some sub level dungeons, reward/craft recipe in Purification Ops Area scheduled on November 6, 2024 maintenance.  

Please check the following information for more details.

[color=#89CFF0]■ Pre-Notice on Purification Ops Area's some Dungeons/Reward Removal and Change[/color]
 Schedule: During the maintenance on November 6, 2024
 Details

1.) Purification Ops area's sub lvl. Dungeons will be removed.
