[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Yod’s Headwaters
- Yod’s Lagoon [Contamination Lvl. 1, 3]
- Last Dyke [Contamination Lvl. 2]
[/td][/tr][/table]
2.) All dungeons in the Purification Ops area will be changed to be available without consuming entry materials. The owning ‘Contamination Purifier Capsule’ will be changed to available for sale in the Shop.
3.) Other than visual(costume) items, all the rest of the rewards from the Purification Ops area dungeons will be removed.
 All dungeons' credit rewards will be removed.
 All dungeons' Operation Progress (Report Operation Result) will be removed and sale of Mission Drive Ver.1.0 will be ended at Contribution Shop.
 [color=#89CFF0]Please acquire the reward before the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024, if your Operation Progress is accumulated.[/color] ‘Material/Consumable Item’ will be removed from dungeon clear reward, monster/boss monster drop reward.
 Gear item will be removed from Monster/Boss Monster drop reward.
 [color=#89CFF0]You can acquire Visual (Costume) Item depending on each rate same with existing.[/color]
 [color=#89CFF0]EXP, Contribution, and Event Item drop will be maintained.[/color] ‘Purification Ops Exclusive Material’ Item will be changed to available for sale.
4.) Purification Ops area's dungeon-related quests will be changed. 
 The sub lvl. phrase will be removed from Purification Ops area's dungeon-related quest goal.
 Purification Ops Area's repetitive quest will be removed. 
 Purification Ops Gear, some material item, and credit item reward will be removed from Purification Ops Area Quest Reward.
 The required amount of ‘Contamination Token’ item for ‘Puriciation Ops/Commencing the Purification Ops’ quest will be reduced from 4 → 3.
5.) The craft recipe of ‘Purification Ops Center’ tab from craft UI will be changed.

 The ‘Purification Ops: Gear’ Category, and the craft recipe for Awakended Cube and Gear in the category will be removed.
 Among the craft recipe materials from ‘Purification Ops : Materials’, ‘Contamination Hell Gear’, and ‘Yod’s Sea’ Category, items that consume ‘Purification Ops Exclusive Material’ for craft will be changed to consume other material item or Credit.
 [color=#89CFF0]Even if the craft recipe's material is changed, the craft restriction will not be reset but maintained.[/color] The craft recipe regarding ‘Transcendence Stone Extract’ from ‘Purification Ops : Conversion’ and ‘Purification Renovation’ Category will be moved to ‘Conversion’ Category.
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: support@closersonline.com or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: 2024/2025 Closers Player Council - New Batch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8543ea532eab22280169fecb9fb5c2c47278c9f4.png

Hi Agents!

The recruitment for the 2024 Closers Player Council (CPC) is now over!

A big thank you to everyone who applied! We were excited to see so many of you eager to make the game and community better. Choosing the final members was tough because of all the great applicants

Let's welcome our returning/new Closers Player Council members!

 Aters
 Jay
 Nova
 Ryuusein
 Squall

To the new members, you'll get an invite to our private CPC Discord channel soon, so please look forward to it!

Thank you once again to everyone who applied. Your support means a lot to us!

If you have any concerns or feedback, please reach out through Customer Support. Also, don’t forget to join our Official Closers Discord!

[color=#ffae42]▶ New  NPC has been added.[/color]
 Memorial Quest tab originally was at  NPC has been removed, and memorial quest dungeon entrance is available from new  NPC.

 New  NPC is available after clearing one of the following quests. Hero's Heart, Unwelcomed Guest, Memories of a Dead Man
[color=#ffae42]▶ Memorial Quest tab has been added to  NPC.[/color]

 Craftable Item: Junsung Kang Image Armband, Tina Curtis Image Armband, Battlefield Magician Top Hat, Battlefield Magician Costume, Trainer Suit Costume
 Main Material Item: Statue of Regret and Hope Female Character can craft Battlefield Magician Costume, and Male Character can craft Trainer Suit Costume.
 Crafted item is acquired in the specification of : cannot be traded in Black Market, cannot move to Account Storage, or cannot be repacked.
[color=#ffae42]▶ ‘The Man's Eternal Battlefield’ dungeon has been added to UNION Watch Dungeon Mission ‘Order : Memorial Quest’ target dungeon.[/color]
 Some of dungeon mission reward has been changed to ‘Memorial Box Ver 2', according to the target dungeon addition. 
 You can select and acquire 1 of ‘Statue of Hope’ or ‘Humanity Leading Sculpture’ or ‘Statue of Regret and Hope’ Item by opening Memorial Box Ver 2 Item.

[color=#89CFF0]※ If you acquire ‘Order : Memorial Quest’ Mission Reward between Oct 8, 2024 AM 4:00 ~ maintenance on Oct 8, 2024, you will not be able to acquire the changed reward until Oct 9, 2024 at 4:00 AM UTC.[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ ‘The Man's Eternal Battlefield’ dungeon has been added to Memorial Quest Achievement and Growth Guide.[/color]
 ‘The Man's Eternal Battlefield’ Dungeon Clear has been added to Memorial Quest Achievement.

[color=#5f95cc]3. Dungeon Difficulty Ease[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Some dungeon difficulties have been eased.[/color]
 The stamina of boss monster from 3 kinds of ‘Tragedy of a flame: Encore’ dungeon has been lowered.
 Some daily/weekly dungeon monsters' patterns have been changed and damage has been lowered.

Memorial Fireworks Festival
Join the excitement at the dazzling Fireworks Festival!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b103446a399727724c614b367f35b96c97c973a8.jpg
 
[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
October 8, 2024 at 7:00 AM - November 6, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC
 
[color=#89CFF0]Firecracker Material Removal[/color]

[color=#89CFF0]Common Removal Date[/color]

[color=#FFAC1C]1. Event Overview[/color]

[table][tr][td]
What are [Firecracker]?
[/td][td][Firecracker] is an event item that is only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period and can be acquired from both the Cash Shop and in-game.Using [Firecracker] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What are [Festival Points]?
[/td][td][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points has been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?
[/td][td]The Server Buff applies buff effects to all players and all characters.The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?
[/td][td]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What are some other benefits?
[/td][td]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Troubleshooter outfit (B type) and other exclusive rewards!The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/td][/tr][tr][td]
What determines the ranks?
[/td][td]The ranking is determined by the accumulation of [Festival Points] attributed to each character, with rewards allocated to Ranks 1 through 5.The Dragon Chair for Rank 1–3 is a newly introduced visual item.

notes.title: Trick-or-Treat! Be a Funny Halloween King/Queen!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d39b0ff61af79ad3f26dc1d6118d6de3b07d5151.jpg

[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
October 2, 2024 - October 31, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
November 1, 2024

[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]

▶ Event Theme - All about Halloween!
Capture a screenshot of your character in their funniest, silliest, or most creative Halloween outfit! Feel free to enhance your screenshot using Photoshop. Please also make sure to share a description or story that brings your look to life!


▶ How submit my entry?
 Log in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin
 After you logged-in to your account, visit this link: Forum - Art & Media
 Select the "Create" button and provide the following:[olist]
 Input in Title: [Funny Halloween King/Queen]
 Attach your screenshot entry and input your message.
 Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist]
▶ Reminders
 Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry, missing info means your entry is invalid.
 Please note that using AI image creation tools may invalidate your entry.
 Follow all event mechanics and rules (see Event Rules below).

[color=#89CFF0]Sample Entry[/color]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c2f4ee7464f992c6db8b08d76ffef84ea3c951e6.png

This happens when you're invited to a party without knowing there’s a pool!

Even though I’m in a fancy suit, I’ll add some quirky swimming items to turn it into a "Swim Suit". Nobody's gonna know ;)

Closers Name: McFunny
Character: CheolsuChuckles


[color=#89CFF0]Reward[/color]
A total of 3 winners will receive the following:

[table][tr][td][color=#FFE135]Event Reward[/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]

1,500 N-Coins

[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Winners will be announced on November 1 through the website and the rewards will be distributed during November 6th maintenance.[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0]Criteria for Judging[/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:

 Screenshot Creativity and Originality (40%)
 Showcase the originality and uniqueness of your character's outfit! Let your imagination shine by using unexpected combinations of colors and styles that capture the Halloween spirit. Using effects and edits to enhance your screenshot is a bonus!
 Description/Message (40%)
 The story or description you provide should complement your character's look. It should be engaging, fun, and relevant to your outfit and the Halloween theme. Share a narrative that captures the essence of your character and the spirit of the season!
 Community Vote (20%)
 The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.

[color=#89CFF0]Event Rules[/color]
 Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
 All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
 All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
 No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
 Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
 If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
 If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
 The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
 The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
 Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.

notes.title: Closers Player Council 2024 Recruitment
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5e151aaa71e0569099dddcfdd9f6476f078f58e6.png

Hello Agents!

Recruitment for the new batch of the Closers Player Council (CPC) is now open, running from October 2024 until next year. Previous council members, including those from earlier batches, have been helpful in identifying issues and voicing community concerns. For this new batch, we look forward to welcoming both new and familiar faces!

For those unfamiliar, the Closers Player Council is made up of players like you! As official Closers World admins, we communicate with the council to discuss ongoing concerns, report in-game issues, and assist fellow Agents.

If you feel you can contribute to this community, please feel free to submit your application, which will be reviewed by our team.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/25c9829edaefd8973f53b2dad9f791ce3935f71f.png

All CPC applicants must meet the following requirements and be willing to take on the following tasks.

[table][tr][td]

[color=#89CFF0]Requirements[/color]
 Must be a player on the Closers World server with at least one character at the current maximum level.
 Must stay up to date with Closers World server events and patch updates.
 Should have a basic to deep understanding of Closers Online.
 Must be able to communicate well in English.
 Must have a basic understanding of navigating Discord.
 No in-game infractions within the last 12 months.
 Veteran players of Closers are highly preferred.
 Must not share CPC group discussions or in-game reports outside the group until they are ready to be publicly announced.
 Knowledge and ability to enforce community rules (issuing warnings, muting, or recommending bans if allowed).
 Can look at things carefully, share ideas clearly, and be open and understanding with others.
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

[color=#89CFF0]Tasks[/color]
 Interacts with players and communicates clearly.
 Helps and guides players about Closers, answers questions, and creates a positive atmosphere.
 Sets a good example in-game and on other platforms (like Steam, Forums, Facebook, etc.)
 Knows the community guidelines, can handle conflicts between users, and enforces rules calmly when necessary.
 Engage in knowledge-sharing sessions with other players.
 Assisting players in other Closers community platforms such as Forum, Steam, etc. is not mandatory but it’s an advantage.
 Working together with Naddic staff and other CPC members when needed.
[/td][/tr][/table]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/547398d3c2604a25ab0a866d15cd09dadad1b2d7.png

All CPC applicants must meet the following requirements and be willing to take on the following tasks.
 Keep confidential or sensitive information within the CPC to avoid leaks of information regarding content in-game or player-base-related.
 If there is any action that is considered to affect the game service, there may be arbitration by Naddic.
 Inactivity in CPC activities or Discord moderation may result in reduced benefits (Please refer to the FAQ below).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a92c52d43581b9b192a267ade4e105dcd4d4ac7b.png

Deadline for CPC Application: October 18, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC
Announcement of the new batch of CPC: October 21, 2024 
Term: October 22, 2024 - October 22, 2025 (1year)

[table][tr][td]
You can directly apply through this link
[color=#FFAC1C]Closers Player Council 2024 Recruitment Form[/color][/td][/tr][/table]
 All submissions will be reviewed by the Naddic staff. Once the CPCs are selected, their names will be announced, and the Naddic staff will contact them via Discord.
 Recruitment is for a limited time, and only applications submitted within this period will be considered.
 A maximum of 5 members will be accepted.
 Anyone can apply as long as they meet the requirements and willing to take the tasks. Previous CPCs may reapply for the next batch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6baf2f1836e152104a80246cf28ab8213af0f9c5.png

 If I become a CPC, will I have direct contact with the Naddic support team?
 Yes, we will communicate in a private Discord group with the other Naddic staff.
 Please remember that we can only discuss community or general issues there. For personal matters or player reports, those should still be communicated through customer support inquiries for privacy reasons.
 What does a Closers Player Council do?
 Community Assistance
 All Closers Player Council members will help moderate the Closers Discord server to create a healthy and safe environment for all users. They will also assist or direct users to the proper channels for their concerns.
 Interacts with players and communicates clearly in any Closers platforms (In-game, Discord, Steam, Forums, Facebook, etc.)
 Bug Reporting
 Report anything that has an unintended impact on the experience of playing Closers online. This covers dialogue/texts errors, broken skills/items, visual errors, quest bugs, environment bugs, graphical errors, etc.
 Community Feedback/Suggestion
 CPCs can communicate directly with us about what the player community is saying.
 Gives ideas and suggestions for Closers, like feedback on new updates or events
 Player Reporting Reporting players who displayed inappropriate behavior in-game or on any Closers official sites.
 What benefits are offered to the Closers Player Council?
 Members of the council do not receive special accounts or in-game items. However, they will receive a quarterly incentive during the first scheduled maintenance day in January, April, July, and October. The main benefits are the following:
 X3 ELITE Status (30-Days)
 3,000 Bonus N-coin (Permanent)
 We understand that life can get busy, but if a CPC member is inactive or does not participate in any CPC activities or Discord moderation for more than 7 days, their incentive may be adjusted or not granted.
 Additionally, if a CPC member is completely inactive, they may be removed from the council. We appreciate your understanding.
 Does a CPC have the power to add, change, or remove anything in the game?
 No, CPC members don’t have access to any in-game tools. However, they can share their concerns with us, and we will look into them.
 Meanwhile, CPC Discord accounts will have extra permissions to help moderate the official Closers World Discord server.
 Can the CPCs know about upcoming updates and decide which updates or changes will be applied to the World server?
 Unfortunately, CPCs do not have the authority to decide which updates or changes will be applied in Closers or when they will be released, those decisions are still made by the Naddic team. Yet any insights are valuable, they can share them with us, and we will carefully evaluate those proposals for consideration.
If you have any further concerns or questions, please send an email to support@closersonline.com or submit an inquiry via our website at https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna.

[color=#ffae42]▶ Yoon Ria Character's Polish Skill has been added.[/color]
 Passive Skill ‘Polish’ can be opened and learned when each character's Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent Promotion.
 In order to apply the Polish effect, you must acquire the active skill to which you are applying up to the maximum level.
 When you attack using an active skill with Polish applied, the Polish added attack will be subject to Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase Guaranteed judgment.

[color=#5f95cc]3. Dragon Core Convert Function[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ The function to convert Dragon Core into Core of another type has been added.   [/color]
 You can convert the Dragon Core by consuming credits and ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ or ‘Noble Dragon Core’ through the Upgrade NPC in each town.

notes.title: September 11th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png

[color=#5f95cc]1. New Dungeon [/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ New Dungeon ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ has been added.[/color]
 ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by completing each corresponding quest, after accepting [False Preparation] Quest at Fantasy World : Dream Theater > Town.
 Cradle of Dragons (1 player), Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player): [The Power of the Dragon] Quest
 Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players): [The Two Dragons] Quest ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by  NPC at Fantasy World : Dream Theater >, The end: The world in flames, and Noah's Museum town.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd049d41455c38a7748410224ae404f374b9275a.png

 You can enter ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon, which has a fixed entry limit of 1 player, using the entrance ticket that can be obtained from 4 players dungeon.
 Entrance Material Item: Dragon Queen Astarte (1 player) Entrance Ticket, Dragon King Hecatoncheir (1 player) Entrance Ticket
 You can acquire the additional reward through Bonus Reward System, at ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 4 players Dungeon. (Once per character per week)
 You can acquire New Chip, Boss Accessory and Armband depending on the rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
 You can acquire Material Item and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ Item which are required for New Gear Craft and Upgrade, by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon.
 New Gear: Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip, Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram, Astarte Disc
 Material Item: Shining Dragon Core Piece, Noble Dragon Core[color=#5f95cc]※ ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon, and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon or Drop Reward of 1 player dungeon. 
※ ‘Noble Dragon Core’ can be acquired when opening Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Tradable Extra Core can be acquired with low probability.[/color] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon-related New UNION Watch, Growth Guide Mission, Farming Guide, and Achievement have been added. 
[color=#ffae42]▶ Dragon King Boss Accessory & Illust Armband have been added.[/color]
 Dragon King Boss Accessory 6 kinds and Boss Illust Armband 2 kinds have been added.
 Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be acquired depending on each rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 1 player/ 4 players dungeon.  
 Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be crafted through Craft NPC, by consuming ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit.However, accessories and illustration armbands are obtained as non-repackaging specifications in case of craft.
[color=#5f95cc]2. Bonus Reward System[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Bonus Reward System has been added.[/color]
 Bonus Reward System is a system that allows you to obtain additional rewards equal to the number of times you can receive rewards without having to click a separate button after clearing a dungeon.
 Dungeons with the Bonus Reward System set will display the icon and the number of times you can receive rewards on the lower left of the dungeon image in the entrance UI.
 Target Dungeon: Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players), Castle of Darkness When you hover over the Bonus Reward icon and the number of times you can receive the reward in the dungeon entry UI, a description of the Bonus Reward will be displayed.
 Items and specifications obtained as Bonus Reward will be displayed in the Bonus Reward UI after clearing the dungeon.
 If you have used up all the number of times you can receive the Bonus Reward, the Bonus Reward UI will not be displayed even if you clear the dungeon.
[color=#5f95cc]3. New Epic Core[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ New Epic Core ‘Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’ and 'Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/color]
 4 kinds of New Epic Core have been added, and all can be equipped regardless of character's battle type. 
 New Epic Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added. 
 New Epic Core can be crafted and upgraded by consuming main materials, ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit through Craft NPC. 
 New Epic Core's Required Level is 94 and can be upgraded by Atropos grade.
 New Epic Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement Lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
 New Epic Core 4 kinds Option

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/22936a6c6f8e56ec48671bd81daa6baf11760bdf.png

[color=#5f95cc]4. New Extra Core[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ New Extra Core ‘Fallen Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’, ‘Fallen Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/color]
 4 kinds of New Extra Core have been added and all are equippable regardless of character's battle type.
 New Extra Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added.
 New Extra Core can be obtained from ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon, and details are as follows.
 Acquire by opening ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ depending on each probability that can be obtained from Reign of the Dragon King (4 players) Dungeon Bonus Reward and Reign of the Dragon King (1 player) Dungeon Drop Reward.
 Upgrade Dragon King Epic Core of Atropos grade into Extra Core, by consuming ‘Noble Dragon Core’ that can be acquired from Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Credit. (Extra Core obtained through the upgrade cannot be traded on Black Market or cannot move to Account Storage.) New Extra Core displays effects around the character or monster depending on the triggering effect, when applying it.
 New Extra Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
 New Extra Core 4 kinds Option

[color=#5f95cc]5. New Phase Awakening & New Chip[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ New Phase Awakening Gear ‘Astarte Disc’ has been added.[/color]

 ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be obtained by upgrading ‘Dragon Disc III’ item by consuming main materials ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit. 
 ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be upgraded by ‘Astarte Disc III’ through  Upgrade NPC.
 ‘Astarte Disc’ can't be traded on Black Market Trade and can't be moved to Account Storage.
 When opening Chip Slot, you can equip a new chip that can be acquired from ‘Dragon's Vanguard’ or ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
 You can use the active option by equipping ‘Astarte Disc’ at Skill Slot.
 New Phase Awakening  Option{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/35e5ffbe11d71c5b20ddadb549f9ef99cb8abb29.png
[color=#ffae42]▶ New Chip ‘Dragon Queen Astarte Chip’ and ‘Dragon King Hecatoncheir Chip’ have been added.[/color]

 You can acquire ‘Dragon Queen Astarte Chip’ depending on each rate, by clearing ‘Cradle of Dragons’ dungeon.
 You can acquire ‘Dragon King Hecatoncheir Chip’ depending on each rate, by clearing ‘Paris under Dragon’s domination’ dungeon.
 2 kinds of new chips can be equipped to ‘Dragon Disc’ and ‘Astarte Disc’.
 Craft, Overclock, Inherit, and Transfer are not available for 2kinds of new chips.
 New Chip 2kinds Option{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dadd94aa1f92113ed74768ba5f13b162c7bf5318.png
[color=#5f95cc]6. Dungeon Skill Additional[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Dungeon skills and dungeons where dungeon skills can be used have been added.[/color]
 New Dungeon Skill can be used by acquiring it after playing the target dungeon.
 Target Dungeon: Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player, 4 players) For dungeons where you can use dungeon skills, you can check them in the dungeon entry information window and in the upper right area when entering the dungeon.
 Dungeon Skill can only be used by the Squad Leader.
 New Dungeon Skill Gauge can be acquired when the dungeon gimmick is successful.
 New Dungeon Skill Type and Consuming Gauge{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2048a9c0f96fe641f951f0618dcc07fec51d3331.png
[color=#5f95cc]7. Enhancement System Improvement[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Enhancement System has been improved.[/color]
 Physical/Psi Attack Power, Physical/Psi Crit Damage amount that would be increased when trinket item enhancement success has been increased.
 The Enhancement Rate Increase used to be applied through Enhancement Buff Voucher Item has been applied to the Basic Enhancement Rate. [Go to Enhancement Rate Notice]
 Enhancement fail rate targeting Enhancement +16, +17 grade has been removed.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Guaranteed Enhancement System has been added.[/color]
 Guaranteed Enhancement System is a system where the Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulated in an item according to the enhancement result value, and the enhancement is guaranteed to succeed when trying enhancement after reaching the maximum point value.
 If the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.
 Guaranteed Enhancement Points are displayed in the lower right corner of the Enhancement System UI and in the Gear Item Tooltip.
 Guaranteed Enhancement Points accumulate when enhancement failure is prevented by adding Gear Booster Fortifier or when there is no change in enhancement.
 Guaranteed Enhancement Point is reset when enhancement success/great success or using Gear Booster or Enhancement Transfer Device.
 Guaranteed Enhancement Point is maintained when Enhancement Fail, Black Market Item Trade, Item Upgrade.  
However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.
(ex: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed. Guaranteed Enhancement Point is acquired differently depending on the material item used for Enhancement.
 Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 100pt when using ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’
 Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 130pt when using ‘Lucky Gear Boost I’ The maximum value of the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is different depending on the enhancement level.
 If you have acquired the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum of the current Enhancement stage during continuous Enhancement, continuous Enhancement will end and the Guaranteed Enhancement Pop-up window will be displayed.
 When you try Enhancement in a status that has reached the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum, Enhancement Material/Enhancement Additives/Credit will not be consumed.
[color=#ffae42]▶ All Gear Items' enhancement stage has been expanded to a maximum of 30.[/color]
 Gear effects for the expanded enhancement stages have been added.
 Chip Overclock's maximum level expansion will be applied through future updates.
[color=#5f95cc]8. Unleash Option[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Unleash Option has been added.[/color]
 A new system, ‘Unleash Option’, has been added to some Gear Items.
 Target Gear: Dragon King Epic Atropos Core, Dragon King Extra Core, Furious Dragon Module
[color=#ffae42]▶ The Unleash Option has been added to Furious Dragon Module.[/color]

 The Unleash Option has been added to Atropos grade's Furious Dragon Module.
 ‘Unleash Option’ is activated sequentially when the target gear reaches the enhancement stage guided in Item Tooltip.
 Furious Dragon Module Unleash Option{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b7fead1389a513a28eb8fb8f2a9bdb46d0c7fb6b.png
 ‘Unleash Option’ is displayed below Tuning Option and above Chip Option in Item Tooltip.
 Activated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘light blue’ in Item Tooltip, and Deactivated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘gray’.
 The effect of Deactivated Unleash Option is not applied.
 Unleash Option related game guide has been added.
[color=#5f95cc]9. Yoon Ria Skill Balance Adjustment[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Yoon Ria Characters' some skill balance has been adjusted.[/color]
 Target Skill's some tooltip descriptions have been added and modified.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/df93435b550c8b8017f6bb14c89d4053b86d6ecf.png

notes.content:
Hello Agents, this is Closers team.

We would like to inform you the Enhancement System Rate to provide more trustworthy gaming environment for you all.

[color=#5f95cc]■ Guaranteed Enhancement System Announcement[/color]
 Guaranteed Enhancement Points are acquired differently depending on the fuel item used for Enhancement.If Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.Guaranteed Enhancement Points are reset when Enhancement Success/Great Success, Gear Boosters are used, and Enhancement Transfer Devices are used.Guaranteed Enhancement Points are maintained when Enhancement fails, Black Market item Trades, and item Upgrades.
  However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.  
* Example: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.

If the Enhancement Try Result with Gear Booster Fuel I is Enhancement Stage , you will be able to acquire 100pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fe6f4a4a7c7a6b8dada526a49b83ea1408059ad3.png

notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about Guaranteed Enhancement System and Improved Enhancement Rate, through Enhancement System Improvement during the maintenance planned on September 11, 2024.

Please check the following information for more details.

[color=#5f95cc]■ Enhancement System Improvement[/color]
Update Schedule: during maintenance on September 11, 2024Details[olist] Guaranteed Enhancement System will be applied.
 Enhancement Rate will be adjusted according to the enhancement improvement work.[/olist]
[color=#5f95cc]■ Guaranteed Enhancement System Announcement[/color]
Guaranteed Enhancement Points are acquired differently depending on the fuel item used for Enhancement.If Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.Guaranteed Enhancement Points are reset when Enhancement Success/Great Success, Gear Boosters are used, and Enhancement Transfer Devices are used.Guaranteed Enhancement Points are maintained when Enhancement fails, Black Market item Trades, and item Upgrades.
However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.
* Example: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.
[color=#5f95cc]■ Enhancement Rate when using Gear Booster Fuel I[/color]
If the Enhancement Try Result with Gear Booster Fuel I is Enhancement Stage , you will be able to acquire 100pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/14598f35af987c6ea5d29da733ff39ed95c30c80.png

Submit your fanart featuring Closers in the hottest 2024 swimwear!


[color=#5f95cc]Event Period[/color]
August 21, 2024 - September 30, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#5f95cc]Winner Announcement[/color]
October 11, 2024 UTC


[color=#FFAC1C]Event Mechanics[/color]
Create fanart featuring your favorite Closers characters wearing the latest 2024 Swimsuit Costume: Summertime Resort.


▶ How to Enter?
1. Create original artwork that matches the event theme in these formats:

[color=#FFAC1C]Accepted Formats[/color]

2. Submit your entry in Closers forums.

a) Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin

b) Upload your entry to Art & Media - Event (Main Category: Art & Media with Subcategory: Event).
⮞ Input a Title for your Fanart including your Closers name.
⮞ Attach your Fanart Entry (the completed artwork) by clicking the 'Attach Image' button.
⮞ [color=#c3a3ff]Required for valid entry[/color] Click 'Insert Image' to upload the images showing the progression of your artwork:
[olist]Initial Progress: A sketch or concept of your artwork.In-Progress Stage: A mid-progress image/photo showing the development of your piece.[/olist]

Creativity & Originality (40%)How unique and imaginative the artwork is, and how creatively it incorporates the 2024 Swimsuit Costume: Summertime Resort.Artistic Quality (30%)The overall quality, including technical skill, detail, color use, and visual appeal.Relevance to Theme (20%)How well the artwork aligns with the 2024 swimsuits theme, including accurate representation and effective portrayal.Community Vote (10%)The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.

notes.content:

Yoon Ria’s Welcome Party
Share your warmest greetings and make Ria feel at home!


[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
August 7, 2024 at 7:00 UTC – August 20, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC

August 21, 2024


[color=#89CFF0]Event Mechanics[/color]
To celebrate Ria's arrival, here's a special welcome event where you get to create a heartfelt welcome message for her!

▶ How to Join?

[olist] Write a creative and welcoming message for Ria.
 A total of 3 participants will win: 2 based on criteria (check the criteria below) and 1 lucky random participant.
 Submit your entry in Closers forums.
 Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin
 Post your message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
 Make sure it is under the [Ria Event] Tab (Main Category [General Discussion] with Subcategory [Ria Event]).
▶ Shortcut to [Ria Event] Forum[/olist]
[color=#89CFF0]Sample[/color]

Welcome to Closers World, Ria! ❤️

I was so excited when I first heard the news about you. As a K-pop fan, it’s a dream come true to have a character that represents them! I know it’s been hard for you to sacrifice so much, but I bet it will be worth it!

Let’s rock all sectors with your trusty microphone 😂 Here’s to a new beginning for us all! ✨🎤🎶

Closers Name: Closeria
Character Name: Rialover

 
[color=#89CFF0]Rewards[/color]
A total of 3 participants will win the following rewards:

[table][tr][td][color=#FFE135]Event Rewards[/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]
x1 S Guaranteed D Component: Gear[/td][/tr][tr][td]
x1 T2 Platinum Chip Selectable Box[/td][/tr][/table]Item Removal Date: December 31, 2024 at 9:00am

[color=#89CFF0]Winners[/color]
[color=#c3a3ff]2 Winners[/color] will be chosen based on the following criteria:

 Creativity (25%)

 How original and imaginative is the message?
 The message encourages interaction and excitement among other Agents.

 Clarity (15%)

 The clarity, coherence, and overall quality of the writing.

 Relevance (25%)

 The message aligns with Ria's character and theme.
 Includes references to in-game lore, locations, or other characters that make it relevant.

 Emotional Impact (25%)

 The message is heartfelt/warm, uplifting and welcoming, encouraging a positive atmosphere.

 Community Vote (10%)

 The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.
[color=#c3a3ff]1 Winner[/color] will be chosen randomly
Provided that the rules and mechanics have been followed.
Winners will be announced on August 21 through the website and the rewards will be distributed on the same date.


[color=#89CFF0]Event Rules[/color]
[olist]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.Participants are allowed to change their entries as much as they wish only during the event period.The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/olist]

[color=#5f95cc]2. Growth Guide System[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Growth Guide System has been added.[/color]
  is a system that guides you through various content by clearing each stage's mission consisting of main content.
 When you click the Growth Guide button on the upper right, a dedicated UI will appear.
 When you click the 'Guide' button for each mission, a guide UI window related to the corresponding mission will open.
 When you click the 'Move Now' button for each mission, a UI window required for clearing the mission will open or you will move to the location of the related NPC.

 If the town you would move to is not open yet, the 'Move Now' button will be disabled.
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Some missions cannot be performed with the character Yoon Ria, and you will be able to move and clear it after the upcoming promotion update.[/color] All mission clear rewards can be obtained once per account.
 Even if you have obtained the reward, you can click the 'Guide' button and 'Move Now' button for the mission.  
 The displayed TCP is the recommended TCP for performing mission, and you can check and clear the next stage's mission not clearing the previous mission.
[color=#5f95cc]3. Washing Machine Accumulative Purchase Reset[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ The function to reset accumulated purchases for Washing Machine has been added.[/color]
 [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will be created after acquiring all the accumulative purchase rewards from the Washing Machine.
 When the [Accum. Purchase Reset] button is clicked, the ‘Accumulated purchase reward record’ for the corresponding washing machine will be reset, and rewards can be obtained from the beginning again depending on the accumulated purchase quantity.
 [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will disappear when the accumulated purchase reward record is reset by clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button.
 If clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button, [Current Accumulative Purchase] amount will be deducted by the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement. e.g.: When the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement for washing machine is 800 and the [Reset accumulated purchases] button is clicked after purchasing it 850 times, the current accumulated purchase quantity will be changed to 50.
[color=#5f95cc]4. Script Window Hide Function[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ The function to hide the script window for enjoying quest illust has been added.[/color]
 When you press [V] while the Quest script window is open, the script window will be hidden.
 After the Quest script window is hidden, pressing [V], [X], [Z], or [ESC] will reappear the hidden script window.

notes.title: [Developer Letter] Summer 2024 Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello, dear Agents!

I am the PD of Closers, Hyun-Jun Kang.

Greetings once again through this August Developer's Letter.

In this Developer's Letter, we aim to address any curiosities that our Agents may have by providing additional information about the upcoming summer updates.


[color=#FFAC1C][August 7th][/color]


The 21st new character, Yoon Ria, joins Closers after about a year and a half.

The new character, Ria, initially awakened her phase force early on, underwent some trials, gave up being a Phase user, debuted as an idol, and then returned as a Closer.

The story of how Ria returned to being a Closer from being an idol will unfold through the update on August 7.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/285177ab838878874952086276bff3730efc072c.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Yoon Ria Novice Agent Illustration[/td][/tr][/table]
We have put our best effort into capturing Ria's narrative and personality through details such as taking selfies and gestures where she holds a microphone to sing.

We have meticulously created each motion and effect from scratch to present an attractive character, and we look forward to seeing many players enjoy Closers with the new character.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5ed9fda072495e0729d7e0632090e4baaafc0048.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Yoon Ria Regular Agent Illustration[/td][/tr][/table]
Especially since Ria is joining the Black Lamb team for the first time since Misteltein, we plan to introduce new chemistry with the existing Black Lamb members and showcase another charm of the Black Lamb team.


A Growth Guide will be added to help the New/Returning Agents to get back into the game faster.

For Agents who are struggling to settle in due to the old systems and accumulated content, we have prepared a system in the growth guide. Upon first logging into the game, you can immediately check which dungeons you should go to at your current level, what actions to take next, and move directly to the relevant area with just a click.


[color=#FFAC1C][August 21st][/color]


The update for Yoon Ria's Special Agent and Prime Agent will include the continuation of the story from the International Airport.

You can also look forward to a specially produced ending video for Yoon Ria. We hope you look forward to it!

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/08bde016c7c2272852b334d5af779c2c8b69cc0a.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Yoon Ria Special Agent Illustration[/td][/tr][/table]
Regarding Yoon Ria's skills and promotion configuration, as you might expect, Ria does not have a Task Force promotion.

This means that her Special Agent promotion will include three normal skills and one Special Move, while her Prime Agent role will add two normal skills and one Special Move, similar to other characters.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a5ee4ce33951e70a3d7dedff0b0cb18cea9049a5.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Yoon Ria Prime Agent Illustration[/td][/tr][/table]
We aim to present Yoon Ria’s Special and Prime Agent updates with a high level of quality.


The highly anticipated 'Dragon's Vanguard' update, the prelude of Dragon King, is coming soon.

You will have the opportunity to face the 'Indomitable Gatekeeper,' Andras, and 'Violet Vanguard,' representing the younger years of Astaroth.

A new story and battles involving these characters await you.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/401814be406eb1d8deead4568ab752cec5d59ca2.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d89ac04ccd78703906a36d1d48eb4314dd03e674.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Indomitable Gatekeeper
[/td][td]
Violet Vanguard[/td][/tr][/table]
In 'Dragon's Vanguard,' along with 'DRAGONISH Trans Discs,' announced in 'Closers Channel ON Ep.2', there has been a change to update two types of craftable modules. This update aims to enhance the gameplay of 'Dragon's Vanguard,' allowing players to access new gear more swiftly.

The 'DRAGONISH Trans Disc' will be updated from the existing Trans Discs : Supreme to include on-use effects.

These effects will be available for Trans Discs from levels 4 to 6, while previous levels will receive a set minor increase in stats. Please look forward to collecting these from levels 1 to 3 in 'Dragon's Vanguard' and levels 4 to 6 in the upcoming 'Reign of the Dragon King.'


The 2024 summer swimwear costumes that many Agents have been eagerly waiting for are almost here!

We are giving you a sneak peek at Seha in this costume and hope you’re as excited as we are.
 
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c82b8d4e46c8aff4d223a57ed2670040b2f41e15.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Normal)[/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/824de39a02299c13645cc0169857845e4f26fa66.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Special)[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#FFAC1C][September 11th][/color]


Following the 'Dragon's Vanguard', the main story of 'Reign of the Dragon King' will be updated.

In this dungeon, you will encounter 'Astarte the Dragon Queen' and 'Hecatoncheir, the Dragon King', whom we introduced earlier. 

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b1f61a3ba37a938c77435bac21d14a79b1a7dca4.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Astarte the Dragon Queen[/td][/tr][/table]
The main objective of this quest is to uncover the connections between the new epic monster Astarte and the characters Astarte and Astaroth, as well as the events involving them.

Particularly, figuratively speaking, the previous form of 'Hecatoncheir' can be considered an undead state.

For those curious about his strength if he were alive, this update will let you experience his might and majesty from the era of the Dimensional War, revisiting his memories from the past in Western Europe.

We hope you look forward to how the story of the Dragon King will unfold.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/049bfc6aee5ef34b79ebf2e85e286a4fabbd7814.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon[/td][/tr][/table]
In the , where Astarte appears, the battle will involve preventing the Dragon Legion from intervening to protect Astarte. The battle dynamics can change based on your choices, promising a variety of fun strategic approaches.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b2ec30e64eab2892e11997e18e7feb346325ee80.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon and Astarte[/td][/tr][/table]
In , battles involve breaking the Dragon King Hecatoncheir's shields while removing debuffs. The combat is designed around the basic Closer's fight mechanics of dodging and attacking, with additional gimmick to keep the experience enjoyable and less burdensome.

In 'Reign of the Dragon King,' you will be able to farm Epic Core and Extra Core.

We previously mentioned that a craft recipe for untradable Extra Core will be introduced. This untradable Extra Core will be added to be craftable from Epic Core by ‘Upgrade’.

This will allow you to transfer settings from Epic Cores to the new untradable Extra Cores, improving the convenience of gear farming.

Tradable Extra Cores will still be obtainable through dungeon play as before.


Starting with the Reign of the Dragon King dungeon, a new reward system called 'Bonus Rewards' will be implemented.

'Bonus Rewards' are additional rewards granted separately from regular drops and clear rewards. These are given immediately upon clearing the dungeon under specific conditions that qualify for ‘Bonus Rewards’. Once the limit for 'Bonus Rewards' is reached, no further rewards will be given until the reward count is reset.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/49e9a7b214d900e9496e88542c36db84eba65539.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Extra Rewards System[/td][/tr][/table]
The 'Bonus Rewards' system automatically collects rewards after clearing a dungeon without needing to press the 'Receive Reward' button, making gameplay more convenient. This system will initially apply to the 'Reign of the Dragon King' dungeon and is planned to be expanded to most dungeons that Agents frequently play in the future.

Additionally, this system will also be applied to existing dungeons, with more details to be announced later.

This is expected to alleviate issues where players could miss out on rewards due to unexpected errors or using up all of their Resurrection Capsules before clearing the dungeon.
 

Many Agents have been curious about the renewal of the enhancement system, and I'd like to provide further information on it.

Here is a brief recap of the previously explained details:
[olist]The enhancement buff system will be removed.Enhancement chances provided by enhancement buffs will be incorporated into the base chances.Guaranteed enhancement points will be acquired upon failure or no change in enhancement status.Once guaranteed enhancement points reach a certain threshold, the next enhancement attempt will succeed with a 100% chance.[/olist]
Additionally, I would like to pre-announce the following updates.
[olist]Absolute Gear Booster can be used up to the expanded enhancement range, (up to right before the maximum enhancement level of +30)Failure chance will be removed up to the +17 enhancement level (up to the attempt from +16 to +17)[/olist]
We are diligently preparing to introduce an enhancement system that makes more sense.
 

[color=#FFAC1C][September 25th][/color]


As previously shared on the last Closers Channel ON, the story 'The Man's Stopped Time' featuring Tina and Trainer, is prepared as the third memorial quest.

We hope you look forward to discovering how this previously unknown chapter of their past unfolds.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60e81ce0d3a3351928ea9cb8a78ee88583972b53.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Trainer and Tina's Talkface (Modified)[/td][/tr][/table]
We are also preparing special costumes related to the story of the memorial quest, so we hope you will enjoy it.
 
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ba59b63be89d11a2d2f599165682ebda2faf3840.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Memorial Entry[/td][/tr][/table]
Additionally, a new entry exclusive to the Memorial Quest will be introduced with the update of the third Memorial Quest.


We are also preparing a balance patch for approximately four characters.
[color=#c3a3ff](Note: The number of characters affected may vary depending on the development progress)[/color]

This balance patch will focus on adding 'utility' as the key point and aim to enhance the damage output for some characters.

We strive to ensure that the adjusted characters will show significant improvements in both convenience and damage.


The final update for Ria character, 'Skill Polish,' will be added.

While we cannot reveal which skills will be subjected to the Polish target just yet, we are committed to developing changes that will give you more enjoyable skill combinations to experience.


[color=#FFAC1C][October 8th][/color]


Finally, Teacher Young-Yi returns with the Divine Battle!

Previously, the Divine Battles were hosted by the Dogra and Magra sisters, but this time, Teacher Young-Yi will take over their roles.

We'd like to give you a heads-up that we might also rename the Divine Battle to align with this update.
 
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/50c624a6133a18f2cc7e5f9240d425caad97031d.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Teacher Young-Yi's Talkface
[/td][/tr][/table]
The concept for this Divine Battle event dungeons is 'endless waves of monsters and non-stop barrage of skills.'

We plan to present this fun combat against numerous dimensional monsters in a new style, ensuring the gameplay is optimized to avoid any frame drops. We look forward to your participation and hope you enjoy the new challenges.

Some of the content above is under development and is subject to change upon update.
[The End]
We've mainly shared major content updates today, but we are also working on various other improvements as well.

We will provide more information on the details that have not yet been finalized in future updates.

That concludes the information we've prepared for today.

We are committed to meeting your expectations and ensuring Closers remains a game you’re excited to engage with.

Thank you.
Sincerely, Hyun-Jun Kang

[color=#5f95cc]1. New Character Yoon Ria Pre-creation[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ New Character Yoon Ria's Pre-creation has been available. [/color]
 You can enter and create the character name of the new character Yoon Ria. 
 The voice related to the pre-creation of the new character Yoon Ria has been added. 
 1 character slot provided by default has been added. (21 slots → 22 slots)
 The maximum number of characters has been extended to 29

[color=#5f95cc]2. Character Creation Window Renewal[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ The character creation window has been renewed.[/color]
 Character Selectable UI has been moved to the left upper side.

 Character story will be played when mouse-over on the story UI. 
 The magnified character skill video will be played by clicking the character skill preview UI. 
 When clicking the character promotion stage (Novice Agent/Regular Agent/Special Agent/Task Force/Prime Agent) button, it changes the character selection screen to the Illustration of the promotion selected.
 When selecting the character on the character creation screen, the background music of the corresponding character is applied.

 You can check out the swimsuit-wearing appearance and changed lines of the  and  NPC located in Noah's Museum Town.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bb4ebf3f2dae2950bc22f3ecbb06423543bc6739.png
Some of the reduced credit rewards from lower-level dungeons have been migrated to ‘Mirage Repeated’, ‘Mirage Repeated [V.HARD]’, and ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeons.
[color=#ffae42]▶ The number of entries to the ‘Dragon’s Execution Ground’ dungeon has been consolidated and changed to once per week per character.[/color]
Target Dungeon: Dragon's Execution Ground, Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD], [Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground.
When using [Sector Pass - Dragon's Execution Ground] item, the number of ‘[Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground’ entries and ‘Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD]’ will also increase.
[color=#5f95cc]8. Chip System Convenience Renew[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ Some chip craft methods has been changed : from Craft at NPC  to Craft at ‘Chip Inventory’ window. [/color]
Chip Box Item's all craft recipes have been removed.Target Item: T1 Platinum Chip Random Box, T2 Colored Chip Random Box, T2 Colored Chip Selectable Box, T2 Platinum Chip Random Box, T2 Platinum Chip Selectable BoxChip craft receipt at [Chip Craft] tab from ‘Chip Inventory’ window has been added.Target Item: T2 Colored Chip, T1 Platinum Chip, T2 Platinum Chip, Overclock Chip
[color=#ffae42]▶ ‘Chip Inventory’ UI has been improved.[/color]
Each tab name from the top of Chip inventory UI has been changed to be intuitive.Multiple chip recipes are displayed at once without left/right arrows moving.Up to 3 chip craft recipes are displayed, and if there are more than 4, you can check them using the scroll bar on the right side of the list.The credits, material items, and crafting restriction count required to craft chips are displayed together for one crafting recipe.
[color=#ffae42]▶ With the reorganization of the chip system convenience, some chip-related images and descriptions in the in-game guide have been changed.[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ Changed so that credits are not consumed when Chip Overclock.[/color]


[color=#5f95cc]9. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon related other changes[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area Dungeon-related UNION Watch Mission has been changed partially.[/color]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png

[color=#ffae42]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site area dungeon related crew mission has been changed.[/color]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png

[color=#ffae42]▶ The number of craftable count for some items at NPC  [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab has been reset, as Ancient Dragon Historic Site Dungeon and Chip Renew task proceeds.[/color]
 Item reset list of the craftable count at the existing [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab
 Target Item

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png
[color=#5f95cc]10. Inventory Material & Mission tab Consolidation [Go to Pre-notice][/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ [Mission] tab has been removed from inventory and consolidated to [Material] tab.[/color]

As the removal of [Mission] tab, ‘UNION Slot Expansion : Mission Ver_1.0~6.0’ Items have been changed to unusable.
The attribute of the existing ‘Quest Item’ has been changed to ‘Material Item’.
Some 'Quest Item' that has nowhere to use has been removed through the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.
In case of having 'Quest Item' subject to deletion packed by Gremory's Common/Greater/Special Dimensional Box before the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, it will not be deleted during the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.

※ You can obtain the corresponding item as 'Material Item' by opening the box after the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, and need to remove it directly if you want the removal.
[color=#ffae42]▶ [Character's Temporary Storage] has been added.[/color]
You can check [Character's Temporary Storage] by NPC Storage.
Among the ‘Quest Items’ stored in the [Mission] tab prior to maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, those with usage source have been moved to [Character’s Temporary Storage].
[Character's Temporary Storage] will be maintained until the December maintenance, and will be deleted along with the stored items after the maintenance. (Detailed schedule will be announced later)
[Temporary Account Bank] has been added temporarily along with [Character's Temporary Storage].

※ Please note that [Temporary Account Bank] is a feature added for future use, and is currently unavailable as it is disabled.
[color=#5f95cc]11. Inventory Slot Expansion[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ Inventory Slot has been expanded.[/color]
The maximum slots in the inventory’s [Gear], [Consumables], [Materials], and [Costume] tabs have been expanded by 20 slots each.
(Before) 7x10 → (After) 9x10
Inventory slot expansion is proportional to the opened slots.

※ Accordingly, there is no change in the maximum number of times that inventory slots can be expanded, and you can still use inventory slot expansion items that you own.
[color=#ffae42]▶ The currency consumed when expanding inventory slots have changed.[/color]
For all inventory tabs and slot expansion stages, the currency consumed during slot expansion has been changed to Credit.
[color=#5f95cc]12. Item Sort Lock function[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ Item Sort Lock function has been added to inventory and storage.[/color]
When clicking Item Sort Lock button, the mouse cursor changes to -ing status.
When you left-click an item with a mouse that is in the sort lock state, the item will be in the sort lock state.
Items that are sort lock will have a white border displayed in the item slot.
Items in the sort lock state are not sorted and remain in position when ‘item sorting’ is performed.  
If all items in sort lock state are used and the location becomes an empty slot, the lock state will also disappear. 
If an item in the sort lock state is moved by dragging it with the mouse or stacked with an item of the same type, the sort lock state will be maintained. 
The in-game guide has been updated with the addition of the inventory sort lock function.
[color=#5f95cc]13. Storage Item usage and Item Amount display[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ When using some contents in ingame, it has been changed that items at Storage and Account Storage are also can be used.[/color]
Contents that consume storage items: Crafting, tuning, upgrading, upgrade tree, NPC shop, costume upgrade/conversion/tuning/dyeing, costume fusion, chip slot change, chip craft, enhancement transfer, pet evolution, pet feeding, PNA Upgrades, mutant manifestations, cross material conversion, operation result report, events (capsule draw, Closer Marble, lucky card)

Credits within your account are shared, so if you acquire or use credits with all characters, they will be displayed together.
The credit holding limit in the account has been changed to 200 billion credits.
(Before) Storage keeping and holding limit per character - 5 billion each → (After) Total credit holding limit in account 200 billion
As the credit holding limit in the account increases, the total credit price that can be registered on the black market has increased to 20 billion.
The in-game guide has been updated following credit account consolidation.

The corresponding Item cannot be traded on the black market and cannot be moved to the account storage.
[color=#5f95cc]17. Dungeon Convenience Improvement[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ Some dungeon of ‘Operation : Flame Wave’ difficulty have been alleviated.[/color]
The entry number of players for ,  dungeon has been changed from ‘recommended 4 people’ to ‘1~4 people’.
In the  and  dungeons, the HP of the Boss Monster has been adjusted downward, and some patterns have been changed.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Break Challenge  Dungeon Difficulty has been alleviated.[/color]
‘Infinite Gluttony Beelzebub’ Monster's some attack damage and HP have been adjusted downward.
‘Flying King Beelzebub's Heart’ Monster HP has been adjusted downward.
‘Dermatobia’ Monster's HP has been adjusted downward and teleportation radius has been reduced.
Basic Clear limit time has been changed from ‘10mins’ to ‘5mins’.
[color=#ffae42]▶ Phase Disintegration Debuff that occurs when entering dungeon with lack of gear level has been removed.[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ It has been changed that the player character will not be down in case of being hit by  ‘Mirror Grabber Nitocris’s 1phase attack at  dungeon.[/color]

[color=#ffae42]▶ From ‘Nampo-dong’ Area to ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area, quest dungeon and normal area dungeon difficulty have been adjusted downward.[/color]


[color=#5f95cc]18. Pet Convenience Improvement[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ New Reaction Type has been added to Pet System.[/color]
New Reaction Type ‘No Type’ has been added.
Reaction Type Exclusive Pet can be registered at ‘Pet Information(B)’ > 'Pet Container’.
When registering 'No Type' exclusive pet in Reaction Type Exclusive Pet List, you can do the quick change to 'No Type' exclusive pet in dungeon w'-
Pet exploring the UNION Camp Your Room can't be registered as pet of Reaction Type Exclusive Pet.

[color=#89CFF0]※ Please note that the list of 'Reaction Type Exclusive Pet' registered before the maintenance on Jul 10, 2024 will be reset due to pet convenience improvement work.[/color]
[color=#ffae42]▶ Automatic pet quick change function has been added.[/color]
You can use the automatic pet quick change function by [AUTO] button at Pet Quick Change System from Dungeon Entrance UI window.
[AUTO] button activated : When entering dungeon, automatically change the Reaction Type Exclusive Pet that suits for Boss Armor Type
[AUTO] button inactivated: When entering dungeon, use the currently equipped pet
When entering the boss armor type dungeon of not registered to reaction type exclusive pet, the currently equipped pet will be used.
[color=#ffae42]▶ In accordance with pet convenience improvement work, some images and content have been changed in the in-game ‘Guide - Pet Item’.[/color]

notes.title: Pre-notice: Enhancement System Improvement Plan
notes.content:
Hello Agents, I'm PD Hyun-jun Kang.

In addition to the content revealed in , there are additional matters I would like to introduce to all Agents, hence this message.

For a long time, we have been receiving feedback regarding Enhancement, and our development team has been carefully listening and constantly considering how to improve the Enhancement System to be more convenient.

Based on valuable feedback from Agents, we have identified several key factors that make the Enhancement System difficult:
[olist]The higher the Enhancement level, the greater the burden of attempting Enhancement, yet the feedback upon successful Enhancement is not sufficiently high.There is significant variation in Enhancement efficiency among different equipment types, Trinkets in particular have a smaller advantage in Enhancement.Enhancement buff has become a necessity for Enhancement attempts, therefore putting a significant burden on the attempts themselves.[/olist]
To address these concerns, we will be improving the Enhancement System on September 11, 2024. The Enhancement System is one of the most significant systems in character development, and we will approach its growth with caution.

Through these improvements, the following changes will be implemented:
[olist]Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success ratesIntroduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee systemIncrease in Trinket Enhancement efficiencyAddition of Enhancement Unleash OptionMaximum Enhancement stage extension and the probability adjustment for lower ranges[/olist]
I will provide detailed explanations for each of these topics.

[color=#5f95cc]1. Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success rates[/color]
The current Enhancement Buff system provides probability boosts based on conditions, but since it involves paid items, it also adds to the burden of Enhancement attempts. Furthermore, its limitation is the inability to guarantee 100% Enhancement success.

Therefore, starting with the Enhancement System improvement update on September 11, 2024, the 1.2x probability boost provided by the existing Enhancement Buff will be reflected in the base Enhancement probability. The Enhancement Buff system will be removed, and a new Enhancement Guarantee system will be introduced.

As a preemptive measure, starting from the update on July 24, 2024, we plan to block enhancement buffs from being activated newly and remove existing acquisition paths altogether.

Additionally, any remaining Enhancement Buff Vouchers in possession can be exchanged for items of regular Gear Booster Fuel and Lucky Booster Fuel which are more valuable than its price.

[End of Enhancement Buff Voucher Sales, Unavailability, and Replacement Notice]
Schedule: During maintenance on July 24, 2024End of Sales: Please refer to the Pre-notice: Enhancement System AdjustmentEnd of Use (Unavailability)After the July 24, 2024 maintenance, you can’t activate Enhancement Buffs newly by using Enhancement Buff Vouchers.Enhancement Buffs already activated will remain until the remaining days.Replacement:Enhancement Buff Voucher in possession before the maintenance on Jul 24th, 2024 will be changed to [Enhancement Fuel Selectable Box]The Enhancement Fuel Selectable Box contains the following items: x500 Gear Booster Fuel, x42 Lucky Gear Booster Fuel, and x17 Gear Booster Fortifier. You can choose one of these items.
※ Gear Booster Fuel and Gear Booster Fortifier will be distributed as tradeable items.
[color=#5f95cc]2. Introduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee system.[/color]
Starting with the update on September 11, 2024, we will introduce a new Enhancement Guarantee system, which ensures a 100% success rate under certain conditions. This will become a fundamental feature of the Enhancement System, without the need to purchase additional items.

[New Enhancement Guarantee System]
If the Enhancement result is "No Change," the Fixed Enhancement Points will increase.If the Enhancement result is "Enhancement Success," the Fixed Enhancement Points will be reset. This also applies when transferring Enhancements or using Gear Booster.If the Enhancement result is "Enhancement Failure," the Fixed Enhancement Points that are currently owned will be maintained. If Fixed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum value of the previous Enhancement stage, the excess Fixed Enhancement Points will be removed.
(Example) If 100 Fixed Enhancement Points are accumulated in Enhancement Stage A, even if the stage drops to A-1 due to Enhancement failure, the Fixed Enhancement Points for that gear will still be 100. However, the maximum Fixed Enhancement Points for stage A-1 is 90, so only 90 Fixed Enhancement Points will be retained. Subsequent Enhancement attempts can guarantee 100% success.Fixed Enhancement Points will accumulate separately for each equipment item.Enhancement attempts with Fixed Enhancement Points at maximum value will guarantee 100% success.The maximum Fixed Enhancement Points required for fixed Enhancement of equipment will vary depending on the Enhancement stage."Great Success" will not occur when attempting fixed Enhancement.Through this approach, we aim to provide clearer feedback for Enhancement attempts.


[color=#5f95cc]3. Increase in Trinket Enhancement efficiency.[/color]
As Trinkets have lower Enhancement benefits compared to other types of equipment, we will increase the Enhancement benefits of this type of gear, which has had lower Enhancement motivation issues due to their lower benefits.
Increase in Physical/Psi attack increase for each Enhancement stage.Increase in Physical/Psi critical damage for each Enhancement stage.	The Trinket enhancement stat increase is applied to all gears, including the current gear.By increasing the benefits of Trinket Enhancement, we aim to improve the lower motivation for Trinket Enhancement.


[color=#5f95cc]4. Addition of Enhancement Unleash Option.[/color]
In areas where feedback has been felt to be lacking even if the enhancement stage has been increased, we plan to provide a clearer advantage of enhancement increase through the ‘Enhancement Unleash Option’.
Unleash Option is a gear-unique option that is activated at a certain enhancement stage or higher.Unleash Option is activated in a fixed option, not in random.Each gear item will have different unleash options.Unleash Option will be introduced starting with  gear that will be added after the September 11, 2024 update.No attributes (stats) will be deleted or lost due to the addition of the unleash optionThrough these additions, we hope Agents will feel the feedback on the Enhancement stage increase. We will continue to update and actively contribute to character growth.


[color=#5f95cc]5. Maximum Enhancement Stage extension[/color]
In addition to the improvements mentioned above, the Enhancement stage will also be extended to +30, providing long-term growth goals to become stronger characters.
The maximum enhancement stages will be extended to +30.The success probability for Enhancements below +25 will be increased.In addition to the increased base probability due to the removal of the Enhancement Buff, probabilities for certain ranges will be further increased.The new Enhancement Guarantee system will also be applied to stages 26-30.The existing Enhancement Transfers can also be used in new Enhancement stages.
Through these improvements, we will make every effort to prepare and provide reasonable and continuous gameplay goals for everyone.

This concludes the content of this Improvement Plan.

We kindly ask for your support as our development team diligently prepares for the Second Half of the Year Update.

Thank you very much.

Details:

notes.title: Lovely Days with My Pet - Win 1,000 Ncoins!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b0c9dd0dff4fb593051131dc288753b18d457f8c.png

[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
June 7 – June 23, 2024 9:00 AM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Winner Announcement[/color]
June 26, 2024

[color=#FFAC1C]Event Mechanics[/color]

▶ How to Participate?
 Take a screenshot of you with your favorite pet!
 In a few sentences, show your appreciation and why they are special to you. The more thoughtful it is, the better your chances to get picked!

Sample

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5c103953acf8db73d2e8c36d2f5dba47853d9de5.png
I chose Mini Jina because she has been my companion for countless dungeon runs! She makes me feel like I'm undefeatable, even if the weather's bad, I always have a good day with her!

▶ Reminders

 All participants should input their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry, or the whole entry will be invalid.
 Screenshots must not be edited outside of the game (no Photoshop or other editing software to enhance the screenshot).
Character names don't need to be visible, and there are no specific dimensions required. Get as creative as you want!
One entry per participant, using one Closers account for each category. 
Make event mechanics and rules are followed (see Event Rules below).
▶ How to submit my entry?
[olist]Log-in to your Closers account to our official website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin
After you're logged-in, click [Forum] > [Art & Media] > [Event] Tab
Upload the screenshot of your choice and post it to the [Event] Category
 Participants are allowed to edit or change their screenshot entries as much as they wish during the event period
Include [Lovely Days with My Pet] on the Forum post title
Remember to add your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist]
[color=#FFAC1C]Criteria for Judging[/color]

▶ Pet Appreciation Description (40%)
 How well the description conveys your appreciation towards your pet.
 The clarity, coherence, and overall quality of the writing.
▶ Visual Appeal (40%)
 The overall aesthetic presentation and effort put into showcasing the pet.
 Clarity, quality, and resolution of the screenshot.
 Skillful use of in-game graphics and settings to enhance visual appeal.
▶ Audience Impact (20%)
 The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.
[color=#FFAC1C]Rewards[/color]
1,000 N-Coins for a total of 5 winners.[olist]Winners will be announced on June 26, 2024 (Wednesday) through the website, SNS, and their screenshot entries will be featured on the Closers forums.[/olist]
[color=#FFAC1C]Event Rules[/color]
[olist]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.Entries suspected of using third-party applications such as Photoshop or AI to manipulate the screenshot image will be ruled out. Cropping the image is acceptable.The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/olist]

notes.title: New Seoul Fireworks Festival + CMC Support + Closers Day + MORE!
notes.content:
New Seoul Fireworks Festival ♬ 
Only good things await you at this Festival!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a98b201c97571a469bdc7a4d106c763dac8d94ef.png

[color=#89CFF0]Event Period[/color]
May 22, 2024 - June 19, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Event Material Removal[/color]
June 19, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC

[color=#89CFF0]Common Removal Date[/color]
December 31, 2024 at 9:00 AM UTC


[color=#FFAE42]1. Event Overview[/color]

[table][tr][td]
What are [Fireworks]?
[/td][td][Fireworks] are event items that are only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period.Using [Fireworks] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What are [Festival Points]?
[/td][td][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points have been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?
[/td][td]The Server Buff applies buff effects to all players and all characters.The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?
[/td][td]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/td][/tr][tr][td]
What are some other benefits?
