[New Seoul branch] Wheel of Trinity, request for test driver.

Hello. This is the UNION New York Branch.


Team Black Lambs of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wolfdog of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wildhüter of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Rattus of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION


Considering the aforementioned Closer teams’ performance and achievements they have been selected as the test drivers of , the auto-maneuver type phase-charged bike.

Wheel of Trinity is a part of the  which has been led by the UNION in secret and is one of the replicas reproduced by analyzing and reverse engineering the technology of Dimensional monsters.
Therefore, much of its performance, operation, and versatility are still unknown.

At this time, we are sending 20 bikes to the main office of the New Seoul Branch, so please carry out the test following the instructions of built-in AI.


That's all for now.
Please do your best to contribute to the advancement of humankind.


Vice President of the UNION New York branch.

Hildegard Veerman 


[hr][/hr]


“What on earth is this? I’ve been to the promotion test and a letter from a higher-up is waiting for me?”

“I-I’ve got the message just now... the Vice President seems to be leading some kind of a project.”

“I see. And did the Temporary District Chief say anything about it?”

“Yes. Only that we’d need to get on with the tests as the memorandum says.”

“Ah, I’m sick and tired of all the secretiveness... I always think that it would be great if they’d at least tell us something before giving orders.”

“Machines that have been made by analyzing the technology of Dimensional monsters... what’s it gonna be like?”

“That, we’ll get to find out from now on. But before that, we should explain how it is to the kids...”



“Yeehaw! The wild motorbike appears! I’m sure I’ll think of a great joke if I ride on this!”

“Impressive! A tricycle moving by itself! Is there a ghost in it?”

“S-silly you. What makes you think it’s a ghost? It says there’s an AI on it!”



“... Those three troublemakers. Already on them, having fun. What if it explodes or something?”

“E-explode? There’s no way the Vice President would send something so dangerous...”

“Let’s examine those machines for now. It just started saying something.”

“Yeah. Whatever funny stuff that motorbike has to say... let’s hear it out.”













Hey… Boy and girl…

Language packs off during shipping... Very inhumane...

Anyway, you must be... the Team Wildhüter of the Germany Branch? For real? Really?

Nice to meet you... I am ...

Wheel of Trinity? That name is untrue... Blue Rider is the name of my soul...

You Team Wildhüter... I’ve heard from my first driver...

We riders... AI that evolves by setting our first drivers as our role models...

That’s why our personalities and languages are alike... very sorry if this confuses you...

Anyway, my first driver mentioned that... you will make me perfect...

The  was made to analyze Dimensional monsters’ ships that were captured during the war with reverse engineering... 

We are the by-products of the research... The Wheel of Fortune and Reverse Wheel that you know of were made in such ways too...

But the analysis was not perfect... and as a result, the Wheel series and we were born with limitations...

However, we are types that learn and grow... able to level up with the drivers...

So you... should be my teammates...

With these superior reverse three-wheels, it’s able to break through any rough terrain... 

The built-in phase-charged engine enables traveling faster than a jetliner...

Then you’ll be like... a streak of meteor! Kyahahahahah!!

 



“Wow, that’s some evil-sounding laughter! Just the same as Wolfgang!

“What? When did I laugh like that? Also, that’s a woman’s voice, in the first place!”

“The first driver that the AI mentioned... who could it be? Does anyone in our team know about it?”

“Sure... If we met her, we would be sure to know her. If it was such a wei... I mean, a unique person.”

“Just speak it out: weird. It seems that the person is a speed maniac as well as an eccentric.”

“But... is anybody surprised? That's the Reverse wheel... Wheel of Fortune was made from Dimensional monsters’ technology...” 

“I kind of had such an idea. Such over-technology doesn't just fall down from the sky.”

“I-is it okay? I mean, I was on it all this time and all...”

“Yeah. It does make you think. Still... the ship is not the villain. It’s the dimensional monsters who are bad.”

“Okay, enough with the small talk. On the higher-ups’ request, let’s do the testing.”

“We’re gonna ride on that? Then, Seth will take the one on the far left! That looks the cutest!”

“Cu-cute? But, they all look the same...”

“Ah! How could you do that!? I was the one who saw the one on the left first!”

“People, don't rush it. There are 5 of them anyway, one for each of us.”

“Yeah. Besides, I’m more worried about my partner. Can you really drive that thing?”

“Of course. After lots of training, I’ve become pretty used to machines. I can even click on the mouse.”

“Uh, yeah... that sounds swell... anyway, it’s got an AI so I guess you’ll do fine.”

“Ohh! Will you look at that! This tricycle can really go fast!”

“Huh? Seth already took off! Teach! Now it seems I can only go onward, too!”

“S-Soma? Just wait a second! Ahh? Already gone so far?!”

“Hey, don’t just run off thoughtlessly...! Bah, those troublemakers... never a quiet day for them.” 

“Look on the bright side. At least, the kids seem to like the new equipment.” 

“*Sigh*, yeah. We gotta test them anyway... let’s go then.”

“Fufu. All of you’re so motivated. I’ll be wishing for all your safe return, then.”

“Safe return... that sounds rather sinister, Alice...”

[New Seoul branch] Wheel of Trinity, request for test driver.

Hello. This is the UNION New York Branch.


Team Black Lambs of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wolfdog of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wildhüter of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Rattus of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION


Considering the aforementioned Closer teams’ performance and achievements they have been selected as the test drivers of , the auto-maneuver type phase-charged bike.

Wheel of Trinity is a part of the  which has been led by the UNION in secret and is one of the replicas reproduced by analyzing and reverse engineering the technology of Dimensional monsters.
Therefore, much of its performance, operation, and versatility are still unknown.

At this time, we are sending 20 bikes to the main office of the New Seoul Branch, so please carry out the test following the instructions of built-in AI.


That's all for now.
Please do your best to contribute to the advancement of humankind.


Vice President of the UNION New York branch.

Hildegard Veerman 


[hr][/hr]

“Wow... everybody, come see these bikes. Aren’t they the coolest?”

“There’s a pigeon as well.”

“M-Mirae. That’s no pigeon; it’s a state-of-the-art drone.”

“Hm... I’m not very okay with this. What kind of experiment is the UNION planning to perform on us this time?

“Right, I felt uneasy too, so I’ve done a check-up. But it’s totally a failsafe, safety-wise. Rather than that...”

“Rather than what...?”

“The technology used on these bikes, they’re all so incredible!” Especially this phase-charged engine that enables traveling at the speed of an airliner, the unique frame structure that can change its form in certain situations, and the balance of the mounted suspensions are superior! Not to mention the installed AI which has been designed to imitate the neural network structure of a human brain and could self-study with no additional data input...!”

“Soohyun Min’s eyes are shooting sparks! It’s Soohyun Min, the mecha-loving version!”

“Still the one getting totally lost in such stuff.”

“... Anyways, I guess all that means it’s safe.”

“Huh? Wait... there’s this flashing light on the bike. Perhaps it has something to say?”

“... You’re right. Maybe we should hear them out?”


 









Hey… Boy and girl…

Language packs off during shipping... Very inhumane...

Anyway, you must be... the Team Rattus of the New Seoul Branch? For real? Really?

Nice to meet you... I am 

Wheel of Trinity? That name is untrue... Purple Rider is the name of my soul...

You Team Rattus... I’ve heard from my first driver...

We riders... AI that projects our first drivers as our role models...

That’s why our personalities and languages are alike... very sorry if this confuses you...

Anyway, my first driver mentioned that... you will make me perfect...

Us riders are unstable by nature... the downgrade of the Dimensional monster ship that has been captured during the war... 

And the owner of that Dimensional monster ship is assumed to be the Machine King...

Reanimator Origin... The Machine King's Legacy... Human over there, you made contact with that legacy, am I right...?

Such people... may be able to help with my upgrade.

So you... should be my teammates…

With these superior reverse three-wheels, it’s able to break through any rough terrain... 

The built-in phase-charged engine enables traveling faster than a jetliner...

Then you’ll be like... a streak of meteor! Kyahahahahah!!





“What the... is its personality supposed to be like this?”

“I think it’s the influence from the first driver. She used to be an agent of our branch, widely known as a big-time speed maniac.”

“Used to... so she’s not an agent now?”

“Yes. She got assigned by someone above. Now she’s been assigned to another institution.”

“Hm~ that’s too bad. I would have liked to know her; she’d be good with deliveries...”

“Suji Jeo. That's not the point now. Didn’t you hear it mentioning Machine King's Legacy?”

“Uh... yeah, I did hear that, but what about it?”

“Something that Annabelle said. She said she could sync with any kind of battleship as long as the data got transmitted.”

“Yeah. And that’s how she crossed over the dimensional pressure, which is supposed to be very hard.”

“That’s right. And it was the Origin Wheel, restored by the UNION, that she used as a beachhead.”

“Ah... that reminds me, her name has"Wheel" in it, too. Same as Reverse Wheel and these bikes...”

“They’re known as the Wheel series. This Wheel of Trinity is one of them.”

“Temporary District Chief?”

“I don’t think this could be a coincidence. The Machine King’s technology is being spread around, and also for humanity restoring it.”

“Do you mean, it was introduced on purpose? So that we would provide a reason for invasion?”

“Or, it has a collaborator. This project was originally run by Michael von Kiske.”

“... Either way, I don’t feel up to testing them. Don’t get too close, Suji Jeo.”

“Uh, um... but our guys... why did Team Rattus agree to perform the testing?”

“Mirae was the one. Saying that something to ride would be a great help for working as an Errand Runner.”

“Mirae said that? That fool... ... No one can stop her, I guess.”

“... So that’s how things are. In that case, I’ll go with the test, too.”

“Wha--at? What’s gotten into you, Aeri?!”

“Because I will not admit defeat as the Errand Runner of Suji Jeo.”

“Ah... I know who that is. You’re talking about the logistics agent of our New Seoul Branch, right?”

“That’s right! She used to take us for rides! Those were fantastically fast!”

“And fantastically dizzying, too...”

“I-I see... I’ve heard that she was some kind of a speed demon...”

“Anyway, boss, if Ran did it, I guess we can trust it? To take the test request?”

[hr][/hr]


“Hey Boomer! What's this now?”

“Just as the memorandum says. It’s something that Vice President Hildegard requested specifically of our team.

“Automated maneuver type phase-charged bike. Now that’s something you can crave for.”

“Reproducing Dimensional monsters’ technology... isn’t that kind of dangerous?”

“Don’t worry. The fundamentals of how Vulture makes weapons are pretty much the same.”

“Yeah. Collecting the remains of Dimensional monsters and putting them to good use is one way of reverse engineering.”

“But... if that was all, they wouldn’t have requested a test like this, either.”

“In other words, they’re hiding something from us? We’d better be careful.”

“... You say so, but you’re already in your racing suit, Harpy.”

“Fufu. It fits me well. Can you drive this thing with a two-wheeler license?”

“You can only drive a three-wheeler with a Class 1 for small vehicles. Class 2 regular or motorcycle license is good for a three-wheeled bike. But the main driver of Wheel of Trinity is the AI and you’re acknowledged as mere passengers, so the license is...” 

“………”

“………”

“... Boomer. You know this stuff, don’t you? Could it be that you were into motorbikes?”

“No chance. I only studied them since my teammates will have to perform tests on them.”

“Uh... how about we quit talking and check them out for ourselves?”

“Yeah. Hyde has completed the setting, so let’s get there already.”











Hey… Boy and girl…

Language packs off during shipping... Very inhumane...

Anyway, you must be... the Team Wolfdog of the New Seoul Branch? For real? Really?

Nice to meet you... I am ...

Wheel of Trinity? That name is untrue... Red Rider is the name of my soul...

We riders... AI that projects our first drivers as our role models...

That’s why our personalities and languages are alike... very sorry if this confuses you...

Anyway, the first driver mentioned that... you will make me perfect...

Us riders are unstable by nature... the downgrade of the Dimensional monster ship that has been captured during the war... 

The reverse engineering analysis wasn’t perfect... As a result, a deteriorated copy like the Wheel series as you know of...

This was originally... Michael von Kiske’s project... is currently on the run...

But... Lady Hildegard retrieved them and readjusted them...

Dimensional monsters’ tech, indeed... There are insecurity issues, but I hope for your understanding...

But, we are types that learn and grow... able to level up with the drivers...

So you... should be my teammates...

With these superior reverse three-wheels, it’s able to break through any rough terrain... 

The built-in phase-charged engine enables traveling faster than a jetliner...

Then you’ll be like... a streak of meteor! Kyahahahahah!!





“What is this? Could it be Ran Sunwoo?”

“Even the fact that it hungers for speed is the same!”

“Ran Sunwoo’s clone... Don’t tell me that her brain is... in this thing?”

“I don’t think Vice President Hildegard would have sent something like that to us.”

“Yes. Also, if it was something like that, she’d have disposed of them except for samples for researching.”

“But... I do feel a bit queasy, knowing that it was a project led by Michael.”

“... Analysis completed. All clean. There are no traces of any human-tissued transplants.”

“Tina? What did you just do?”

“Nothing much. I simply connected to the machine’s AI to scan its interiors.”

“And I hope you made sure of security before connecting? There might be risk factors such as control codes.”

“Don't worry, Trainer. I had double, no, triple security measures ready.”

“Fufu. Then, how about let’s go for a mindless ride? It seems that the other teams are doing the same thing.”

“They’re getting their own bikes out with them. Hyde, can you drive?”

“Sure, lady. Any kind of vehicle that exists on earth.”

“Tsk... I don’t feel like it. It had to be an AI that’s a copy of Ran Sunwoo...”

“Huh? What’s the matter, Nata? All the others are going, but you’re lagging behind?”

“Oh right. Nata used to be scared of Ran Sunwoo’s driving, right?”

“Kuh... W-who the hell was s-scared?!”

“Huh? But I recall you screaming on every ride...”

“Keep quiet, just get going! The game is on between you and me, zombie woman!”

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - August 16th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:

UTC: August 16, 2023 at 5:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC
PDT: August 15, 2023 at 10:00 PM - August 16, 2023 at 3:00 AM PDT
GMT+7: August 16, 2023 at 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

Official Closers Facebook FanpageOfficial Closers Twitter PageOfficial Closers Discord ServerOfficial Closers YouTube Channel
We appreciate your patience and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or, email us at:
support@closersonline.com

New/Returning Event Mission and Reward Improvement

New and Returning player Support Events are being upgraded!

New/Returning Event Improvement Overview

We are focusing on Reward Renewal QOL, so players can constantly achieve New/Returning Mission and focus on the latest farming content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bf75622e4c3ad82979559256a53b05e8e9317c74.jpg

Main Improvements


Give Gear when achieving Level and New/Returning Mission (Gate Wave, currently Main Farming) 
Support character growth by providing dungeon play support Item, and tuning Item when achieving New/Returning Exclusive UNION watch Mission.
Relax/Ease the stress of clearing missions by making the player acquire the gear for the contents quarter only with achieving the level and the challenge mission (Guide Mission_Clear each Dungeon once). 
For players who already were in the Original New Returning Event (before MA on 8/16), the reward claim history will be reset.
The Rewards from the Original New/Returning Event (before MA on 8/16), can be claimed with the new version when login after MA on 8/16.
For players who already were in the Original New Returning Event (before MA on 8/16), 30 days will not be extended but the period for the Original New/Returning Event will be maintained.

notes.title: Pre-Notice for Mock Battle Renewal on Aug 16th
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance that Mock Battle content will be reorganized through regular maintenance on August 16th.

With this reorganization, it is possible to select the difficulty level when playing mock battles, and the score calculation method is amended. As a result, the mock battle weekly play and reward claim schedule is temporarily adjusted.

Please refer to the following for more details.

Mock Battle Renewal Details

1. Renewal schedule: After scheduled maintenance on Aug 16th
2. Details:

2.1) Changes on Mock Battle

 A difficulty selection function is added to the Mock Battle entry UI.
 Mock Battle clear score calculation method is changed.
 Mock battle scores are calculated based on the time required to defeat the boss and additional scores for each difficulty level.
 If you clear a higher difficulty level, you can receive a higher additional score.

2.2) Mock Battle Schedule

We would like to inform you of the weekly ranking reward collection period according to the mock battle play period.

notes.title: Notice of Abusive Gameplay Suspension
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that upon thorough investigation, a player who has recently brought about some issues, will be imposed a 30-day game ban for abnormal program usage and suspicious gameplay. 

This comes after a series of offenses committed, including but not limited to the following: 
Promoting and boasting to the community on the usage of macro-botting and programming 
Repeated use of botting after first offense on June 28, 2023 UTC
Multi-account sharing exploitations leading to second offense on July 14, 2023 UTCAs such, the player, who currently ranks first in the Fireworks Festival Ranking Rewards, will not be given the first-place reward, and the following five ranked players will be awarded accordingly.

We strongly inform players that even with circumstantial evidence, any use of macro-botting, hacking, and unauthorized third-party programs, resulting in abnormal gameplay, is strictly prohibited and banned in Closers World. 

We urge players to refer to our game policy at the following links: https://www.closersonline.com/eula and https://www.closersonline.com/terms-of-service

We have also received feedback within the community and have decided to reinforce the internal policy, especially for Unauthorized Third-Party Programs usage. 

From hereon, any accounts found to conduct Unauthorized Third-Party programs for game-enhancing purposes, will be handled as such:7-day Game Ban for 1st offense
30-day Game Ban for 2nd offense
Permanent Game Ban for 3rd offenseFurther, any exploitation that causes abnormal gameplay or functions to manipulate the game will be imposed an immediate permanent game ban.

We endeavor to safe keep and provide all players with a better game environment in the future.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding. 

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.title: Pre-Notice for Unique Costume Trade Renewal & Fiber Item Integration
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Hello Agents, 

We would like to inform you that; to improve the convenience of costume trades, during scheduled maintenance on Jul 26th, 2023, ‘the number of times that can be repackaged for unique costumes will be changed to 99’, and along with that, ‘Phase Fiber' and ‘Greater Phase Fiber' will be integrated into ‘Phase Fiber'.

As the available counts of repackage increase, for those who have ‘Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume]’ before the maintenance on Jul 26th, 2023, the corresponding item will be exchanged into Quality Assurance Seal which has a slightly higher rate of the selling price. 

Please refer to the following for more details. 

1. Schedule: After maintenance on Jul 26th, 2023 
2. Details 
The available number of Unique Costume repackaging will be renewed into 99 times.   Even if you have unique accessories obtained from the ‘Unique Costume Accessory Full Set Box’ in the event that runs before the maintenance on July 26th, 2023, the available number of repackaging will be changed to 99 times. After the maintenance on July 26th, 2023, if you use the ‘Unique Costume Accessory Full Set Box’ obtained from the event, you will be paid as a unique accessory with Untradeable specifications. (It will be paid as a Untradeable specification in future events.)‘Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume]’ will not be used when repackaging. When using owned ‘Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume]', it is changed to obtain 20* 'Quality Assurance Seal' per 1. ‘Phase Fiber’ and ‘Greater Phase Fiber’ are integrated into ‘Phase Fiber’.   The ‘Greater Phase Fiber’ you have will be changed to ‘Phase Fiber *2 Box’.  Contents and products that use/obtain Greater Phase Fiber will be changed to ‘Phase Fiber’ in proportion.

Thank you for your understanding.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to:
support@closersonline.com

Contents

►New Promotion for Aeri, Black Hands

 New promotion for Aeri,  has been added.   The promotion for Aeri ‘Black Hands’ is available through ‘Black Hands’ Episode at  ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater’ sector. ‘Black Hands Costume Box(3 days)’ is given when clearing Aeri ‘Black Hands’ Episode. Aeri has managed to make that strength as her own through trials in the Fantasy World.

By killing the family to grant the family's last request, 
skill [Special Move : The 7th Magical Bullet] can be used.

Also, whenever you use the errand boy's special move, the move that strengthens depending on the skill level of the skill [Special Move : The 7th Magical Bullet],
[Sniper’s Gaze] attack is activated

[Skill Options]

- Guaranteed Crit. Damage[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Fireworks Festival (Big Renewal)
notes.content:
Fireworks Festival (Big Renewal)
Acquire festival points and firecrackers to get more buffs and more rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9dd656a4b5cc7a74ef74ea352b2afc81fe49af69.jpg

Summer Vacation Fireworks Festival
Many sparkling events and rewards!

Event Period
June 21, 2023 - July 26, 2023 UTC

[table][tr][td]What are [Fireworks]?
[Fireworks] are event items that are only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period.
Using [Fireworks] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.
[Team Fireworks], on the other hand, will provide Personal buffs!

What are [Festival Points]?
[Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points have been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].

What is a [Firework Buff]?
It’s a server buff that applies buff effects to all players and all characters. 
A [Firework Buff] is stacked up to level 10, and will give better buff effects as the level goes up. 
All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.

What are some other benefits?
You can also receive a powerful personal buff from [Team Firecrackers].
Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain a Cosplay Cafe outfit or boosters!
The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/td][/tr][/table]

Types of Fireworks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6a6044614b1b2a12074ff235ed1bbf96d8c48751.png
All firecrackers are untradeable, cannot be sold and cannot be moved to Account Storage. 
All event fireworks will be removed on July 26, 2023 at 7:00 AM UTC.
Fireworks from the Cash Shop will not be removed and can be used again during the next Firework Festival event.

Fireworks Ranking Rewards
The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9fe5a367dd86c81867bd1e8dfa1b3a14b24ac204.png

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:

Contents

►Updates for Aeri character
New character Aeri has been added.5th character of Team Rattus, ‘Aeri’ has been added.
Aeri character can be created from 67 level and max level is 86.Aeri’s max level will be expanded to 88 during next MA.Aeri character can play from Scrapyard to Busan – Nampo-dong.

Aeri’s character class is consisted of Errand Runner and Hireling(1st promotion).
Planar Gate, Planar Gate: Purification Ops Center, Fantasy World: Dream Theater are available.
Union Camp(Your Room, Garden) are available.
UNION Arena will be available later soon.Aeri Skill List:[table][tr][td]Class[/td][td]Skill/Cube Name[/td][td]Details[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Swamp Demon[/td][td]Aeri can use the power of poison as well as the power of water by merging with a demon. 

You can use Hydraulic Jump, which jumps higher when you hold down the jump key, 
and while in the water, Submersion which has the same effect as combat dodge will be activated. 

Use the power of water to acquire [Bangwool], and use the power of poison to install [Deadly Poison Plate] that lasts for a certain period of time. 
All [Deadly Poison] attacks hit with [Fixed Damage] + [Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase]. 

When using basic attacks, when pressing [Down] direction key, you can use [Bangwool] to attack with Splash. 
When using certain skills, [Poison], which continuously deals damage to enemies, is activated. 

The attack of Demon-shaped Bangwool is not affected by Aeri's actions 

Function : Splash 
- Recover MP 15%  

Function : Poison Plate 
- [Buff : Swamp] activates when being on [Poison Plate] 
- Duration : 20secs 

Buff : Swamp 
- Total psi Attack 5% increase 
- Critical damage 150% increase when Back Attack 
- Psi Critical damage 35% increase 
- Duration : 5secs[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Special Skill : Poison Recharging[/td][td]Creates a poison explosion that leaves a sheet of deadly poison. 

[Skill Function] 
- Guarantee Condition: Back Attack 
- Converts 5 [Bangwool] to 5 [Deadly Poison] 
[Poison Knife] stack is created if skill is used 
- When using a ground dash attack while holding [Poison Knife] stack, [Attack : Poisoned Blade] is activated 
- Deadly Poison Plate created 

Attack : Poisoned Blade 
- Consumes 1 [Poison Knife] stack 
- Acquire [Buff : Blade of Deadly Poison] when attack activates 
- Increase damage as much as the skill level of [Basic Attack Training], by adding to Poison Recharging 

Buff : Blade of Deadly Poison 
- Total psi Attack 10% increase 
- Critical damage 20% increase when Back Attack 
- Duration : 10secs[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Raindrop[/td][td]Fires an arrow with a flat waterdrop and pops it.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Raindrop: Advance[/td][td]Enhancement 
Increases Damage by 10% 
Requires: Raindrop Advance(LV.3) or higher[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Raindrop: Expert[/td][td]Enhancement 
Critical damage 5% when Air Strike 
Requires: Raindrop Expert(LV.6) or higher[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Raindrop: Master[/td][td]Enhancement 
Targets that suffer damage have a 15% reduction of Crit Damage Resistance for 10 seconds 
Requires: Raindrop Master(LV.10) or higher[/td][/tr][tr][td]Errand Runner[/td][td]Magical Bullet - Twister[/td][td]Shoots an arrow while tumbling, then appears from behind the enemy and slashes them with a dagger of water. 

[Skill Function] 
- [Chasing Arrows] tracks and attacks the closest enemy within range behind the character 
- If [Chasing Arrow] succeeds, it moves to the enemy that was hit and uses [Wet Blade], 
and if it fails to track the enemy, it is used in place

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:


UTC: May 24, 2023 at 5:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC
PDT: May 23, 2023 at 10:00 PM - May 24, 2023 at 3:00 AM PDT
GMT+7: May 24, 2023 at 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7

Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.
Official Closers Facebook FanpageOfficial Closers Twitter PageOfficial Closers Discord ServerOfficial Closers YouTube ChannelWe appreciate your patience and understanding!

[table][tr][td]Closers Name: 0kiki0

Transitional Tuning Tips

Gearing is a long and complicated process, but one of the most important systems to get familiar with is Tuning. Platinum status can help immensely by raising the minimum tuning grade from C to B on most gear. Knowing how to approach Tuning in general is key to ensure that you are making the best usage of your resources. On non-best in slot(BiS) gear you can be more lenient with mediocre tunes, as you’ll eventually replace them with gear more worthy of an investment. Items such as Guaranteed S Components, Equalizers, SS-C, etc. should generally be saved for current BiS gear.

Tuning all of your gear to the ideal stat lines is one of the most important things to do. It’s better to have an A or B grade tune on a relevant line rather than have an S grade tune on a useless line. You can see what to tune for on each gear piece by referencing the top TCP players of your respective class via the Rankings tab in the menu.

Even though you should generally try to tune for S grade lines, sometimes that isn’t always realistic. You’ll often run out of tuning count and have no more equalizers. As long as you have an A or B grade tune on a relevant stat, you’ll generally be okay. In a scenario where you have to settle for less than S, you should be aware of what tunes are okay to have lower grades on. Using an S-C Component to preview the differences in stat values between tune grades is very helpful.

TL:DR – Save those guaranteed S components for the strongest(BiS) gear! You’ll be fine using A or B grade tunes for the most part on transitional gear.[/td][/tr][/table]

2. /hi or /qq this emote command is useful for skip Character animation if you have animation long in starts fight useful on speed run to kill some boss in mock or etc dungeon ( Can’t skip animation boss ) but you can skip Character animation and use skill skip animation boss no need to wait boss show animation finish. [table][tr][td]Closers Name: GameDead

Additional Rewards using Reset Timers
Dimensional Doppelgangers is a sector that offers 2 daily runs and is a great way to get additional valuable resources for your character. You may find that a lot of days offer very lackluster rewards, but days such as Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday offer a great way to gather resources such as fuel for enhancing, phase fiber for costume enhancement/crafting and Malek crystals for credits. On these specific days, you can utilize a specific method to obtain more runs for each of the days that offer better rewards.

To perform this, you simply need to enter the sector before reset, clear two times and stay inside the dungeon until after reset. After reset occurs, a message will pop up and the sector entries will be reset. You will be able to retry the sector and go in an additional 2 times for the higher value sectors instead of using your clears for other sectors which provide lower rewards.

In addition to timing daily reset for additional clears, a similar method can be performed for conquest cooldown. Conquest cooldown can be reset early and depending on the time left it will cost additional credits. Since the cooldown timer is not reset alongside the rewards and the reset credit cost is linked to cooldown time, this method can be used to provide a way to get unlimited rewards within the cooldown timeframe at a relatively low price. This method is very powerful especially for sectors with very long conquest cooldown, such as Beelzebub V2 for crafting phase wings and Asmodeus V2 sectors to craft Asmodeus full bodies which have a cooldown of 1 week.[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]Closers Name: Laststation

General tips about invincibility/i-frames
Check out the images for examples of each tip.

Tip#1: Extending Your I-frame Duration:

To extend the duration of your invincible state let the animation of your skill play out by simply not pressing any keys. This technique is useful on characters with visually short skills such as Soma’s Destruction Strike and Harpy’s EX Sonic (Down) to get as much invulnerability time as possible.

This concept also applies to skills with Damage Reduction as well.

Tip#2: Lingering Invincibility:

Eunha’s, Mirae’s, and Cheolsu’s Enhanced Basic Attack and some skills like Harpy’s Fortuna Revelation have a special property where you retain i-frame even if you were to cancel into another skill. Try and experimenting to see which skills of your characters have this.

Tip#3: Dodge + Invincibility The game allows you to combine both actions to reposition if you need to get yourself out of a bad situation.

May Discord Event
Join in on two community challenges this month for a chance to win 5,000 N-Coins and more!

Location
Closers Official Discord Server

Schedule

Fan Art Gala

 Send in your latest fan art photos! Pen, paint, digital graphics or even photoshopped art, it’s time to get creative!
 Conditions for valid entry:
 At least one Closer character is featured in the picture
 All entries must be submitted on the Discord Channel #fan_art_gala, along with the player’s Closer name and featured Character name (case-sensitive). Entries are limited to once per account. If multiple entries were submitted from the same account, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.

Criteria for judging:

 50% Creativity and Execution
 50% Audience Impact - ‘❤️’ votes in Discord
(Any other Discord reactions will not be counted)
Rewards: 
Five Winners - 5,000 N-Coins, Key Cap Goods, Art will be featured in Closers World’s new website’s 
All Participants - x1 Lucky Gear Booster Fuel (non-tradeable) 

N-Coins reward will be given during May 24, 2023 maintenance while keycap goods rewards will be delivered following a separate notice.
Lucky Gear Booster Fuel will be given after the winner’s announcement on May 19, 2023 UTC. This item expires on December 31, 2023 at 9:00 am UTC.

Event Rules

 One entry per Discord account and Closers account.
 All participants including those who didn’t win must adhere to the event’s rules and procedures for the participation reward.
 All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
 Entries should be submitted in image form only, such as PNG or JPEG (GIF, Video, etc. will not be valid).
 All participants should include Closer and Character Names when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
 No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
 Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
 If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
 If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
 The Naddic team can remove non-related entries or discussions in the event channel.
 The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
 If you have any inquiries, concerns, or reports, contact us at support@closersonline.com.

notes.title: Known Issue Notice - APR 14th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of the known issues that was found in-game:

String Error in Dungeon Mission

 The clear condition of The Holy Place of Ocean King says “once” instead of “twice”. This will be corrected in the next scheduled maintenance. 
Missing Item Information on Pet Transmitter [Mini Bastet Pickup]

The item information of the corresponding package may not list all the components. But, the package has the intended component and pets for Pet Transmitter [Mini Bastet Pickup] are available.
Optimize Rendering Option Automatically Switches Off

 The option to “optimize rendering” is a function that has been included with the update of DirectX 11. The button on the Settings no longer controls the function as it is automatically applied. As such, we plan to remove this button and option from Settings, which will be informed in a separate notice.
Spring Shop Banner Display

 The Spring Shop is no longer available and is incorrectly displayed.  This will be removed in the next scheduled maintenance. 

Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Hello Agents,

Following an increase in bugs and issues found after the April 12 maintenance update, we will be postponing the temporary server maintenance by an hour to the following schedule:


UTC: April 13, 2023 at 6:00 AM – 8:00 AM UTC
PDT: April 12, 2023 at 11:00 PM – April 13, 2023 1:00 AM PDT
GMT+7: April 13, 2023 at 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT+7

The following issues will be worked on:

1) Mirage Re-enactment Dungeon displayed at Fantasy World: Dream Theater (Reverse) will be removed.

2) Spelling error on the Pet Transmitter in the [WILD] Mini Bastet Pet Final Special Package will be corrected.

3) Character Blackout Preview at Union Shop will be corrected.

4) Babel Program Error in Rewards will be corrected.
Players who received the incorrect main rewards will be sent the correct items at the next regular maintenance.

5) Missing Costume Image in Costume Book will be corrected.

6) Additionally, several string will be fixed.

Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.title: April 13 Temporary Server Maintenance
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

April 13 Scheduled Temporary Maintenance

Hello Agents,

This is to inform you with the following concerns that occurred after the April 12th update. To correct the issues that will be mentioned below, we will be having a temporary maintenance at this schedule by time zone:
UTC: April 13, 2023 at 5:00 AM – 7:00 AM UTCPDT: April 13, 2023 at 10:00 PM – 12:00 AM PDTGMT+7: April 13, 2023 at 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM GMT+7 
1) Mirage Re-enactment Dungeon displayed at Fantasy World: Dream Theater (Reverse) will be removed.

The Mirage Re-enactment Dungeon was incorrectly displayed at Fantasy World: Dream Theater (Reverse) and entry was allowed.

This will be closed during the temporary maintenance and be updated in the next maintenance.

2) Spelling error on the Pet Transmitter in the [WILD] Mini Bastet Pet Final Special Package will be corrected.

As compensation for the inconvenience, 30 Agate of Genesis rewards will be provided in addition to the temporary maintenance reward.

Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.title: April 12th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
April 12th Update Patch Notes

Contents

► Crew Dungeon Renewal
Crew dungeon's required occupation rate has been alleviated. Crew dungeon occupation rate by stage has been alleviated to half of the previous level.Crew daily/weekly mission dungeon has been renewed.Some of crew daily/weekly mission dungeons have been removed/added.Obtainable task, reputation point, crew activity point when clearing mission dungeon have been changed.
► Boss added to Mock Battle
Boss monster has been added to Mock battle. 
WILD boss for Mock battle, 'Malek the Shackled' has been added.Mock battle boss's rotation order has been changed.
► DirectX 11 Update
DirectX 11 has been updated. 
Maximum frame has been increased from 60fps to 120fps by DirectX 11 update.Please update 'DirectX 11' version for smoother playing, as the game will not be available with the version below 'DirectX 11' after today's update.** Check my PC's Direct X version** Update 'DirectX 11' versionScreen setting 'HDR function' has been deactivated temporarily.

"Instantly leave Investigation Group" function has been added.
[Instantly leave Investigation Group] button will be activated, once clearing the investigation group core dungeon more than once.'Abandon Reward' button has been added to Investigation Group form UI.
► Changes on Legion Program
Legion Program new dungeon - WILD has been added.Legion Program has been restructured.Some of Legion Program's dungeons' difficulty has been adjusted.
► Skill System Improvement
Skill level adjustment UX has been improved for your convenience.

Renewals

Renewals in Closers
Some updates to take note of!

Crew Dungeon Renewal and Legion Program

Crew dungeon’s required occupation rate by stage has been alleviated to half of the previous level! Some crew daily and weekly mission dungeons have been removed and added. Obtainable tasks, reputation points and crew activity point when clearing mission dungeon have also been changed.
A new WILD dungeon will be added to the Legion Program, which will also be restructured and have its difficulty levels adjusted!

Skill Level Adjustment

 Skill level adjustment UX has been improved for your convenience!

Microsoft DirectX 11 Deployment

 DirectX 11 will be updated to allow for the maximum frame to increase from 60fps to 120fps!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Notice for DirectX 11 Update

Hello Agents

We would like to inform everyone that Microsoft DirectX 11 will be updated during the regular scheduled maintenance on April 12, 2023 UTC.

Therefore, we advise all players to install and update their programs for normal game executions after the update. Additionally, the update has called for a temporary deactivation of the HDR function.

► Microsoft DirectX 11
After the maintenance on April 12, it will not be possible to run the game with lower versions of DirectX 11. 

Check your computer’s Direct X version here.

Install the latest version of DirectX here. 

► Temporary Deactivation of HDR
The HDR function found in Options > Screen Settings will be temporarily disabled. 

We have confirmed that the effect color and shapes will look abnormal and irregular depending on the game screen, dungeon location, luminous intensity effect, applied effect and more when the HDR function is operating. This is caused by the incompatibility of several functions of the codes after converting the HDR development code from DirectX 9 to DirectX 11 versions. 

As we are concerned that it will cause great inconvenience to Closers’ gameplay, we will apply a temporary deactivation and will re-design the code in the future to reimplement the HDR function. 
 
We apologise for any inconvenience caused and will make notice of when it will be reactivated. 

Thank you for your understanding.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered
notes.content:
We appreciate all the Agents who took the time to ask questions, provide comments, and offer suggestions.

The discussion topic, along with a brief summary of your questions and our answers, can be found at this site.

Words can’t express how grateful we are to everyone who joined us for the Dev Q&A session this season.


► Website Renewal

Is the update to the official website still being worked on?
On the last update roadmap video, it was said that the server will be renewed. May we know the current status of the updates you have yet to implement on the website?
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

We appreciate your enthusiasm about the renewal of the official Closers World website.

The newly redesigned website is on its way, with improved functions and appearance. Our plan is to update it by May 2023, and if there is any news, we will notify you in a separate notice.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Contribution Shop & Housing/’My Room’ Concerns

Can the Contribution Stop items be updated?
Certain things are no longer worth purchasing (examples are +12 gear booster, +13 gear booster, Busan’s materials, and Hyperclocked Equalizer).

Can the Housing rewards list be updated?
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

You’ll soon be able to get the items that you need through the updated Contribution shop and My Room rewards.

To begin, the closest schedule for the Contribution shop renewal is planned for sometime in April 2023. The precise schedule for updates will be shared in later announcements.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Dungeons/Sectors

1) Do you have plans to reduce the amount of dungeon’s entry and multiply the rewards according to the amount of the entry?
There are too many things to do in this game now. People with a lot of characters had to play nonstop for a whole day or two to complete all of the weekly dungeons.
2) How about removing the repeatable quests and increasing the dungeon rewards?
Or make the dungeon drop specific materials that can be exchanged on repeatable quest (similar to the Doctor’s Research Note quest that need ‘Gremory’s Research Note’ from Gremory’s Central Laboratory dungeon).
Certain repeatable quests (mostly Gremory dungeon quests) are made to give us more materials that we need. However, it’s a bit of a hassle to move to ‘Planar Gate’ when everything is on ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater >>’. I’m sure that many players do not like to waste their time collecting materials from quests.
3) The Purification Sector, Tindalos, and Harpas should be able to have more than one run without Elite or Platinum.
Yod and Nitocris only have two tiers, so one run a day makes sense. It also makes sense that the sectors found under Contamination Hell, OF – Surface/Reversed, and Yod’s Sea only have one run a day because of their unique situations.
4) Can we please get an official statement on dungeon entry ticket refund policy upon encountering bugs, disconnects, and other issues?
But in my case, Astaroth, the final stage boss, did not appear at the end, and when I sent a ticket with logs and a video explaining what happened, I got a long email about the problem and a final “no” for a refund. In the end, these situations both halt the game progression.
5) Can we gain the ability to open the pet menu when within dungeons and in the raid lobby?
Pet switching is needed quite often these days, so you should be able to do it whenever you want.
6) Do you have plans to update Endless Elevator content?
Some of the rewards are kind of outdated and it’s not that worth to do.
7) Instead of per-entry sectors, why not allow unlimited entries to sectors that do not offer rewards?
But only after you’ve claimed, say, one or two rewards (such as what we can see on Gremory sectors or purification). Then it will lock up, and you’ll have to wait until the next reset.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) We are currently preparing improvements to the rewards and/or entry requirements for a number of dungeons, such as Dragon’s Execution Ground, Gremory’s Dimensional Gate Sector, and so on. We appreciate your patience while you wait for further updates.

2) Thank you for giving your thoughts in regards with the repeatable quests and dungeon rewards. Please be aware that we will conduct an internal review of the situation.

3) Thank you for your valuable suggestion. Restructuring of dungeons, however, could have unintended consequences like increased abuse, so we’d like to keep things as they are for the time being. I hope you are able to understand this point, which is that it is challenging to have adjustments made so long as there are no flaws or problems that affect the gameplay.

4) We apologize for any disruptions or difficulties this may have caused. We understood that the number of entries is reduced due to issues such as bugs or disconnections during play. We later posted an announcement regarding this (Dungeon Issues Update) informing users to submit their logs through Customer Support.

Users who are experiencing this issue could submit their latest “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder and with other details through Customer Support. Once the complete data has been gathered, we will provide a free pass ticket.

We appreciate your patience as the development team is continuously working to prevent any inconvenience caused by bugs or disconnections.

5) We understand that it would be convenient to be able to use the pet menu in dungeons and the raid lobby, but due to the complexity of the systems involved, we are unable to provide a firm answer at this time. We ask for your understanding.

6) We regret that there haven’t been any updates to the Endless Elevator content in quite some time.

We acknowledge that the current level of reward requires effort and resources not just due to the difficulty of the material but also due to the process of gaining it.

The development team has verified that many players who regularly play in Endless Elevator content and receive rewards have lower combat power than the current main content level, while players with strong combat power are accumulating rewards relatively easily. Also, some of the rewards have been confirmed as being beneficial in the game’s current state.

Given the various TCP levels of the players and the difficulty of obtaining the rewards, it is incredibly challenging to renew the reward at this point. In the future, we will consider the placement of the Endless Elevator contents as well as the dungeon redesign.

7) Thank you for sharing your idea, and this is understood to be a recommendation to fulfill the dungeon clear event requirements. Please understand that we must impose a dungeon entry limit in order to prevent abuse and to maintain farming balance.

In the meantime, you can contact Customer Support if you run into any problems due to bugs, etc., and we will assess the situation and potentially provide a dungeon free pass ticket.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Crafting

1) Since we now have the new enhancement rate (100% up to +13), can we get a craftable +13 booster?
It is somewhat inefficient to craft +10 and then do the enhance again, and I see no reason why a +13 booster shouldn’t be craftable.
2) I don’t know if this is already planned, but Busan, Beezlebub, Yod’s Sea (chest crafting), Centum, and Asmodeus should all have their endgame gear crafting nerfed because they are all out of date.
Centum You could probably leave them alone for now, but the rest should be nerfed since BB and Asmo are outclassed by Belphegor, Closers World is about to get Beast King, and Busan and Yod’s Sea are severely outclassed by Belph, Searing Winds, and even Centum and Asmo.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) We appreciate your feedback. Currently, there are no plans to implement the reward design that is obtained by repeated craft, such as Gear Booster +10. However, any future developments in this regard will be announced.

2) An update is scheduled for April to allow players to obtain the ‘Endgame Gear of the Content’ after completing the quest for the old content. We’re hoping this will make playing Closers easier and more enjoyable for Agents.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Items/Materials

1) Can you turn Essence of the Seabreeze, Promptitude bug lump, and Hell fire bug lump into useful material in the same way that you did with the Reanimator?
These are examples of useless materials in the game’s current content.

2) Are there any plans to bring back the Custom Parts – Circuit Distortion as the content to obtain it has since been discontinued?

3) Is there a way to find out when the server might get the QoL changes for converting centum bugs to fortress of night and the full gear box for the Asmodeus prequest?

4) Since the 3rd (Special Agent) and 4th (Task Force) promotions have been going on for a long time, it’s time to reduce the amount of materials they need.
It will help people who play more than one character but don’t have enough money or materials for 3rd or 4th promotion.

5) We can currently store a maximum of 30 Awakening Capsules through right-click consuming the item. Please increase the limit.

6) Will Naddic provide content that is actually worth going over and beyond for maxed enhance gear?
We’ve seen what KR has in store for the new Babel Tower. The rewards for something that suggests 80m+ TCP are fairly meager. Why not create side content that provides resources?
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) Giving old farming materials new alternative use is a challenging topic to explore, thus we avoid this strategy as much as possible because it is difficult to think about how to offer fresh value to existing farming resources. This is so that the design won’t be force you to play older contents as more top farming contents are added. Furthermore, bringing extra value to old farming materials could force you to replay old content over and over.

2) The Custom Parts – Circuit Distortion is provided as a show-off of the (Old) Team Challenge, and there are no plans to make it available through other channels for the time being.

3) That is not planned, however we will evaluate the possibility in terms of smoother content entry and character development speed.

4) We are working on an update that will reduce the required period for the fourth promotion. The relevant announcement will be made in the near future.

5) Your suggestion is appreciated. We’ll keep that in mind for potential implementation.

6) A new area (New Seoul Branch Command Center) and the conquest program are coming in August 2023, as you may have seen in the Roadmap video. This will have a total of 30 stages by its difficulty, so hopefully this will be an opportunity to deliver appealing special rewards to all Agents!

We will try to continue doing what we can to meet your high expectations by offering opulent prizes in the future.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Past Dev QnA Concerns

1) When presenting the new Q&A, could the team at least go back to some of the old ones from the last Q&A and give an update?
I’m referring to the topics currently being discussed or concluded so that some of us will know what to discuss about next. Some examples are the updates of the Divine Battle, the improvements to Trinkets and Amplifiers, and updates regarding to the Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device.


2) With the recent release of the Ash subjugation program, as well as the short time between this raid and the Beast King raid, this no longer appears to be the case.
Also, in addition to this point, new players will be unable to access the new raids when they are released.
Reference: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered: Characters Related Concern category
Question: Is having multiple characters for farming the intended approach?
Dev response: We think that the amount of time spent on the different parts of the game could lead to gaining better rewards, and this is especially true when using more than one character.

Please think of each character as one of the many different pieces of content that are included in Closers, and consider that playing a number of them is one of the more enjoyable and gratifying ways to enjoy Closers.


3) In the Purification Sectors, it was said that the item that serves as the key to get in will be taken away. This is false even in KR where it has not been completely removed.
Reference: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered: Dungeons/Item Drops/Rewards category
Question: Is there any help provided to newer players to help them proceed through dungeons as their gears are prerequisites to the latest raids and dungeons?
Dev response: In the Purification Sectors, we are going to take away the item that serves as the entrance key. Thank you for your insightful comments. Please keep in mind that the actual update to the World server will take a while to finish.

We are quite grateful for the thoughtful concerns regarding the new players’ gear farming. In the near future, there are plans to implement an update that will make it possible to receive a full set of gear that is equivalent to those earned by completing legion commander quests. We have the hope that new players will have an easier time overcoming the hurdles.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) Thank you for proposing this to us. Although it would be challenging to revisit each topic, be assured that we are taking into account and evaluating each Agent’s entry, whether it was submitted to the old Dev Q&A or the new one. While it may be challenging to provide a concrete answer in some cases, you can rest assured that we will keep you informed of any developments.

2) Depending on the player’s preferences, there may be differences, such as playing with only one character or playing multiple characters. Ultimately, we strive to reduce as many hurdles as possible so that everyone may enjoy Closers to the fullest, and we also promote content that allows you to play as many unique characters as possible.

3) Rather than merely altering the item “key”, the final equipment reward for the content has been added when the quest is completed. This will allow the content to be passed at the same time as the quest is completed and encouraging further character development. We will also have the same answer for a similar entry question.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► DirectX 11

I believe that Closers World will receive the Direct X11 update very soon, but my question is how it will be implemented when it is still in development on the Korean server?
Massive frame drops made the game unplayable for weeks after it came out on the Korea server, and it’s still not done as there are plans to improve the quality of the graphics.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

We want to release the Direct X11 update alongside the additional improvements that Closers Korea service has had. 

We are doing everything we can to improve the overall playability of Closers.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Crew

1) Confirming if there are plans to update on how crew points are earned


2) Suggesting to include other sectors such as “Machine King’s Strategy Analysis Lab”, “Battle Program: Another Lucifer”, or “The Holy Place of Ocean King” to the crew missions
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) In order to achieve positive outcome for the Crew feature, we are working on an update for Crew points and Crew rewards. More information will be supplied in a future announcement.

2) Thank you for your suggestion. We are already planning an update for new sectors to be added in Crew Missions. Be on the lookout for this in upcoming updates.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Localization

1) Some of the user interface elements and terminology used on the Korean server don’t convert well to the World server. Will there be any adjustments made so that they do make sense on the World server?
Here are some of the examples where the World server differs from the Korean server: 
– On the Korea server, the number of stamina consumed is shown next to the level requirement in the Dungeon Select menu, but on the World server, it is just an empty section.
– On the World server, the letter “M” in the equipment border means “Psi,” but on the Korea server, it means “Magical.”
– The letter “C” stands for “Combination” from a full body costume.
– The character UI says “Receiver”, but when you hover the item, it says “Amplifier”.
– In the game guide website, Crew is indicated as ‘Circle’. (note: we have updated the game guide into ‘Crew’ and removed the word ‘Circle’)
– Not to mention that there is a QoL change on Rare/Unique costumes in the Korean server as well, which shows the first letter in the top corner of the costume. However, since Rare is now called “Signature,” will it stay as R there and not S?


2) How about a language switcher/option for the next time we merge servers so that there isn’t as much of a language barrier and everyone who was merged in can keep their names?
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) In the case of UI and terminology localization, we are improving gradually with each update, but we realize that it takes time to get things just right and that you may not notice the progress right away.

Please accept our apologies if you encountered any localization issues while playing on the Closers World Server, and it would be greatly appreciated if you could report them to Customer Support or with our Closers Player Council so that we can either fix them immediately or include them on the list to be updated during the scheduled maintenance.

We will continue to provide more appropriate and localized updates and demonstrate our efforts as a result.

2) There are currently no plans for a server merge or additional language support in the future. If there is any new information, we will notify in a separate notice.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► PNA

1) Could developers consider the possibility of making the mutant tab an account-wide section?
Because, at least from my player’s point of view, doing everything over again in another character is pretty tiring, this is a request that would make things a little easier


2) For normal PNA, the update requirements for Offensive, Defensive, and Utility should be nerfed.
Because that’s still ridiculously expensive for no reason, even with Special, Amplifier, and now Mutant PNAs.


3) I also think that the requirements for updating your Special strains should be nerfed.
Because that’s still very expensive. By lowering the requirements for the Normal and Special PNA strain updates, we’ll have more resources to use to buff our Mutant strains.


4) Mutant PNA be considered for the whole account.
Have it locked by level and quest, but once the quest is completed, have the already-established levels for each boss type carry over to other characters on the account. As said, it’s hard enough to level up each strain solo, so this will help some extent.


5) Can we have all the mutations damage % activated on stat display instead of only showing 0% for the others?
This is important for raids where you can’t even open the Mutant Menu. Most of them use auto-apply, so why not just have all mutations at once? Include the passives on each mutation bar, which should also be on all the time in dungeons like Ex DEG and future content.


6) We still do not have PNA Exp factored into the weekend buffs
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) The development is underway to change the mutation level to account bound. More information will be given in a future notice.

2) It is part of the content which will be updated in April.

3) It is also a part of the content that will be coming in April.

4) This is in development and working it out in a positive note. We’ll notify you as soon as we have news to share with you.

5) Due to ‘mutation optimization’ based on mutation level, it is hard to apply all mutations to stats.

6) We will consider adding the PNA Exp to the weekend buff. Please keep an eye out for future event announcements.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► For New Players

More quality of life updates and player support beyond what is currently available and adjust the content of the World server to fit its current state.
Even though TCP gaps between new and up-to-date players are to be expected, there has been a constant influx of rushed players into the 12-player raids since Beelzebub came out. This makes it harder to clear these raids, and a new one is expected to come out next week.

There have been a number of ways to help newer gear, such as jump boxes and bug lump converters, but what Naddic has in store hasn’t been enough to solve the problem. The amount we receive is also invariable to KR, and it’s tough not to compare servers because content difficulty is not adjusted downwards to response to these kinds of situations.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

As noted in an earlier query, an update is planned for April to obtain the ‘Endgame Gear of the Content’ when clearing the quest of the old content. It is our sincere desire that this will make your experience with Closers more enjoyable and efficient. Please wait for the announcement for more details.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Skills

1) Are there any plans or ideas to make skill cooldowns less dependent on ping or make them client-based?


2) There are still no forced conditional triggers for a lot of skills from different characters.
Are there any plans to add them to skills that provide DPS but don’t have them?


3) Pet skill being activatable in dungeon with “B” instead of putting on a skill slot or have a function where it autoactivates so it’s not wasting a skill slot.
Extremely tedious to switch them or makes things worse when forgotten to do so.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) Cooldown and other features that could be abused or benefit in abuse are processed through the server side.

We plan to keep things as they are in the future by taking into consideration the abuse problem that has been occurring elsewhere recently through game client falsification. We ask for your understanding that this choice was made to prevent abuse.

2) We believe it is one of the most enjoyable aspects of Closers battles.
Furthermore, with your grateful opinion, we will continue to monitor the situation and consider adjusting if the conditional output is too powerful.

3) It is difficult to deliver a clear answer whereas reorganizing the UI structure and improving hotkey customization must come initially. If there is any relevant information, we will notify in a separate notice.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Enhancement Transfer Device

1) Please consider an urgent change to make it a 100% free transfer at -1, as suggested in the previous Q&A.
The uncommon version can only be bought once a week, which doesn’t make sense since you can’t sell it, and the premium version has never been for sale (except for a 50% discount on Black Friday). As the gear replacement rate is higher than it was a few years ago, it can be hard to protect high enhancement levels. The item is also less likely to be used by newer players due to content-bridging or less min-maxing involved.


2) Will there be an enhance transfer device that doesn’t have a -1 penalty?
I and other players who try to keep their enhances up to date would rather not have to re-enhance to make up for getting new gear. Before you say no or that you will consider it, please understand that this is a long-overdue request.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

We are mindful of different viewpoints regarding the utility of enhancements and the difficulty in obtaining Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Devices.

However, as stated in the previous Dev Q&A, due to circumstances, we are unable to support it at this time.

We will look into other ways to provide and add any benefits, including promotional aspects, such as the previous Enhancement 100 times package.

We hope you’ll have patience with us as we try to explain that modifying the game’s fundamental mechanics is a complex field that might take a long time and a lot of research.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Gamepad/Controller

1) Is it possible to set at least Item Quick Slot 9 and Item Quick Slot 0 to the gamepad?
It would be nice if other options that are currently on default could be modified for Gamepad.


2) Will Closers get more Controller support in the future?
The Selfie Mode, A/B slots, and keys for 9 and 0 are not usable with the Gamepad HUD / with a Controller.
It isn’t even possible to bind those Keys to a different button in the settings, despite the fact that a regular Controller has plenty of unused buttons (like the D-Pad or the right analog stick)
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

We appreciate your inquiries. We are aware of the difficult nature of using the controller and are looking into ways to make it more user-friendly, considering that it will take some time to develop new features that can cater to the needs of the players. If any relevant information becomes available, we will make a separate announcement.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Enhancement

1) Why does it cost so much fuel to enhance at slightly higher levels each time when there is such a large likelihood that there would be no change at all?
It’s one reason why it’s hard for a lot of free-to-play players to get to higher tiers of enhancements, especially since the max level of enhancements keeps going up.


2) Are there any plans to make enhancement easier, either by lowering the number of fuels needed per try or by increasing the no-fail enhancement beyond +15?
Which in my opinion is outdated, with how high the max enhancement is getting. The latest content for the Korean version of the game “Conquest Tower” has very high requirements and is almost impossible to complete without spending money to improve your character through enhancement.


3) Is there still no consideration to reduce the counter needed to activate the enhance voucher?
The question itself is self-explanatory. 250 is too high.


4) The original cap of +17 and system overhaul made it appear possible for free-to-play players to achieve the highest possible enhancement level, but new level cap expansions have changed that sentiment.
When you replace gear, you lose any gains you made, and it’s hard to get the materials without spending money.

I disagree with Naddic’s approach to the issue of alt characters, as they demand the same amount of effort to maintain as your primary character.”
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and experiences with the enhancement system. Similar to how we mitigated the period of the Enhancement Buff Voucher before, we will make an effort to lessen the burden of enhancement while maintaining the game’s overall balance. All your inputs with regard to the enhancement have been taken into consideration, and we are looking into ways to make it more user-friendly and gratifying.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Closers Updates Concerns/Inquiries

1) Aside from KR’s “Brand New Closers” update and the contents of the letter, is there anything else that can be shared that is being worked on?
In PD’s letter, he says that he is committed to making the needed changes and improvements.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) There are several factors to take into account, including the language, the value of the goods, and differences in product sales methods because of legal aspects. As of right now, there are no plans in place to merge servers with other countries. What we can share with you is that we intend to work on making the existing global server more active. Thank you for your valuable comments, and if anything is determined, we will certainly notify in a separate notice.

2) Internally, the restructuring of costume lockers and functions is still under development.
We will work hard to bring you the good news you have been waiting for.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Character
When will this server release new character Aeri?
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

As revealed in the Roadmap video, Aeri, and Aeri’s follow-up updates, are scheduled for during May ~ July.

Please anticipate the details that will be presented soon.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Costumes
1) When will this server release 3rd Unique (Wheel of Trinity) costume?


2) Full Set boxes from previous reruns of Washing Machine or even new releases should be updated whenever the costume set is shown again.
For example, the “Holy Night Bunny” costume set. I have a full set box that I want to use for my future character Aeri.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

1) We are preparing to update it as soon as we can. Please stay tuned for any future announcements related to the 3rd unique costume.

2) It’s difficult to support this suggestion to preserve the worth of new character costumes. We apologize for not meeting your expectations with our response.

[/td][/tr][/table]

► Closers Economy Related
To what extent is Naddic working to enhance the game, both in terms of attracting new players and boosting the existing player base and economy?
Naddic needs to get with the sales team and revise the pricing to better fit global as its population is clearly not sustaining the current intended model.
[table][tr][td]

Dev Response

We are taking action in a variety of different methods, such as publicity to attract players and improvements so that both newly joined players and existing players may continue playing Closers without difficulty. In the future, we will make greater efforts to improve the quality of the gameplay environment for all Agents.

We keep a close watch on the server economies on a country-by-country basis and make adjustments as deemed necessary. In the event that you share your perspective with us regarding this matter, we will look into it in great detail.

[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

You can get your burning questions answered by the Closers World Development team themselves!

You may reach the Closers World devs by posting in the #dev-q-and-a channel on Discord with any questions, comments, or recommendations you may have.

Don’t miss this chance, and please remember to keep it constructive and clear. Comments that aren’t relevant to the topic at hand or that contain insults of any kind ought to be removed.

[table][tr][td]

How to Submit Your Entry
Join in the official Closers World Discord server:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png


Then post your questions, feedback, or suggestions for the Closers World Developers,
in the #dev-q-and-a channel.

Tips/Reminders:
To clearly identify your entries, please list the topic followed by its associated details.If possible, we would greatly appreciate it if you could include bullet points and images, if they are available. Example:Topic: Costume InquiryDetails: Are there any plans to re-release the Spring Fairy costumes in the future?
We will collect this data starting February 17, 2023, until February 23, 2023, at 8:00 AM UTC.

In March 2023, the list of entries and Developers' responses, along with the first roadmap video of the year, will be published on the official Closers website.

[/td][/tr][/table]
But please keep in mind that you are always welcome to give your feedback and suggestions to Customer Support via support@closersonline.com or https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna if you miss to submit your contribution.

We always appreciative the countless submissions we have received during our past Dev Q&As, and we appreciate your unwavering support!

notes.title: Dungeon Issues Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention some issues related to the dungeons. Please read the following topics below for details:

Disconnection after using Ultimate Skill
We’ve received reports that after using a character’s Ultimate skill, players are being kicked out of the game (with the message “Connection to game server lost.”).

At this time, we have observed that this occurs intermittently. As we do our investigation, any information you can provide, specifically the log files, will be greatly appreciated.

Please provide the following information if you have recently experienced a connection loss while using the ultimate ability:
 Your “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder. Kindly provide the log file with the time of disconnection was recorded.
 Name of the dungeon were you got disconnected
Please forward this information to https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or support@closersonline.com once you’ve finished gathering these needed data.


Invisible Astaroth Bug
It has been reported that Astaroth is not spawning or is invisible by the time it should appear to have been defeated. Also, we have observed that it doesn’t occur everytime. We continue to investigate this situation and appreciate your patience.

Meanwhile, please provide the following information if you have found that Astaroth is currently not spawning or is invisible during your dungeon run:

 A full screenshot or video of that you encountered this bug during your dungeon run. The ‘/time’ or the time and date, as well as your character’s name should be clearly seen. Your “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder. Kindly provide the log file with the time that you encountered this bug.
Please forward this information to https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or support@closersonline.com once you’ve finished gathering these needed data.

If there are any updates, we will post them on the official website as soon as they become available.

Thank you for your cooperation and please do not hesitate to discuss with us for any other concerns.
