[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]Other changes on the list along with the overall rate adjustments
► Changes on Washing Machine Accumulative Purchase Reward
New Reward Thresholds are added: ‘250’, ‘500’, ‘700’‘SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear’ is earned as pouch (Tradable)
► Convenience Improvement – Crew
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/619f91125836f6160a7cf66746181419019ccd3d.png

Crew UI is changed.Disband/Leave Crew button is moved to the right side of Your Rank.Go to Crew Hangout button is moved to where Disband/Leave Crew button was.Crew Veteran has an authority to approve a member joining.Crew Veteran can approve a member to join.Crew Veteran can see Join Crew Request tab in Crew info window.A notice is added for Join Crew Request.When there is a request to join a crew, a crew icon appears on the lower right corner.Crew Veteran or higher can see the icon.When clicking the icon, Join Crew Request tab opens.When there is a request to join a crew, ‘NEW’ icon appears on the left in Join Crew Request tab.Search Crew function is improved.‘Crew Rank Point’ is added to the conditions of Crew search.‘Crew Rank Point info displayed in Crew search UI takes time to get updated.The way to save Crew News is improved.Max 100 News can be saved.Info displayed in Crew News is fixed.
► Random Character Image System
A new system is added: Character images acquired show randomly.
Selecting multiple character images in Character Image tab will show a random image out of them.Once character images are selected in Town Tab, a random image out of them will show when entering Waiting Room, a town, a different channel, and closing a dungeon.Once character images are selected in Sector Tab, a random image out of them will show in case of dungeon loading, squad, UI AND HUD.Click Mouse Right Button to select a character image while Mouse Left Button is for preview.Clicking ‘Reset Selection’ under Image/Pack UI, your pack of selected images is reset and the default image will show.When being on a queue of UNION Arena(PVP), 1 random image will show, and a same image appears on the loading for PVP entering.When applying an image package, all emotes, sound, etc included in the pack will be applied together.Deselecting a selected package doesn’t deselect its character image.When entering a sector or UNION Arena, the order of images is randomly decided, and using Special Move in that sector will show images in that decided order.Character Images for Town/Dungeon that were equipped before May 11 are reset.
► Legion Program Improvement
Legion Program’s dungeon difficulty is adjusted.Legion Program’s overall dungeon difficulty is lowered.The difficulty of mechanics from Legion Program dungeons is lowered. Legion Program – Black Hole Bomb in MACHINARY dungeon now appears in higher waves.Legion Program – Sniper in MACHINARY dungeon is now located near to the middle.Legion Program – Water Drop in DEEPSEA dungeon now has a slower speed.Legion Program – The screen range in DEEPSEA dungeon is changed.
► Convenience Improvement
How to show Skill Level is changed.The way to show + Skill Level from gear, costume, tunning, etc is changed.For + Skill Level from any options, a parentheses will appear next to the level to display its additional skill level. 
ex) Lv.14 (10+4) EX Exceed PulseSkill Level-Up from general Level-Up shows as it is now.‘Skip’ function is added for an item that opens.Clicking ‘Enter’ when opening an item, it opens right away while ESC cancel the opening.Several Mission Objectives are improved for Black Lamb/Wolfdog/Wildhüter.As the missions are changed, much faster mission clear is possible than before.
► Selfie Mode Improvement
The screenshot quality of Selfie Mode is improved. Lamb/Wolfdog/Wildhüter.Checking off HDR in Screen Setting will be applied to Selfi Mode, too.Checking off Anti-aliasing in Screen Setting will be applied to Selfie Mode, too.A function to spin a specific emote is added to Selfi Mode. Lamb/Wolfdog/Wildhüter.Mouse Left Click during Selfi Mode can spin a specific emote.You can use Spin for ‘Figurine Standing : Cosplay Café emote in Selfi Mode, and it will be applied to the other emotes later.
► Gear Farming Improvement
Farming for some gears is improved.Crafting Machine in Busan – Nampodong can craft ‘Transcendent Locust Hell’ gears directly.The number of Scorpion Core Chip that drops from ‘Battle Program: Misook Jang ’ is reduced(16 -> 8) due to the above change.Required amount of Credit is lowered when crafting Speedster Module, Blue Inferno Trinket.The number of ‘Symbol of Affection’ in Box with Memory of Flood that can be earned from Audience with Legion Commander : Ocean King Asmodeus is changed to 5.
► Last Minute Notice System
A notice system for durational items is added.
When there are items that are about to be expired soon in Inventory or Storage, the system lets you know through Pop up or item UI.The notice appears in case of Login/Logout a character, and moving to Waiting Room.When you have durational items that have less than 1 Day or 7 Day in Inventory or Storage, a pop up will let you know.Checking off ‘Don’t want to see it again today’ in Last minute notice pop up will cease the notice for that day, and this applies per character.
► Direct Shop
Direct Shop system is added.When clicking a material item that is required in NPC ‘Vending Machine’, a list of items that can be bought with the material directly opens.When Ctrl + Alt + Mouse Right Button on an item for Direct Shop in Inventory, it directly goes to the shop.The list of item for Direct Shop can be checked by the following way.Direct Shop Items : The Direct Shop hot key appears in the item tooltip.Other Items : No Direct Shop hot key info in the tooltip.Direct Shop can be used in hub only and is not available in Your Room/Garden/Crew Hangout/Dungeon.Direct Shop doesn’t support opening inventory, selling items or re-purchase items.

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (Part 2)
notes.content:
Click to return to Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (Part 1)

______________________________________________________________

►Contribution Shop
Can we get an increase cap on the weekly Contribution limit or make Dungeon Missions in Union Watch not able to count towards the weekly limit since it is possible to reach the max limit in 3-4 days with just three charactersCan we get purchaseable double talisman and if possible PNA stabilizer on contri shop?
Dev Response
The max contribution limit was increased in the KR server this year. This means that the World server will also have that update during the future patch. Please stay tuned in our website for further updates regarding this.

We see that PNA leveling is essential for players, therefore, we will positively consider adding more helpful items to the Contribution Shop.

______________________________________________________________

►Future Updates I
Is it possible to have 5th character in Rattus team in the future?
Dev Response
We will check all possibilities since it is great to have a 5th character in Rattus team. If that day comes, please welcome the new character once he/she is released. Stay tuned to Closers!


►Future Updates II
In the last Q/A you talked about collaborations, but there is still no indication of anything, can you give us a clear answer about this?
Dev Response
There are no collaborations at this time, but once we have an update, we will definitely share this great news to all.


►Future Updates III
Suggestion: Universal Hub
Dev Response
We are taking into consideration for having a universal hub in Closers. However, the hub is a challenge for us to implement in-game since it is a place where we should accommodate a lot of characters all at once and in one place. For the meantime, please enjoy the event towns that are currently available in-game.

______________________________________________________________

►Details in Feature
Luck stabilizers in potion-limited Commander Raids (Meet Lust King, Machine King Confrontation)Will you permit the use of luck stabilizers in these raids?
Dev Response
Update as of May 3rd:

We would like to clarify that the drop rate for items is very low in commander raids to keep its rare value. As an alternative, and a much faster way to get those items, is to craft them. Therefore, we will keep it as it is now. Please use Luck Stabilizer in other dungeons where it can make full use of it.

______________________________________________________________

►Inflation in game
Are there any plans to curb inflation? With the private BM coming out, I’m expecting the number of credits kept in reserve to decrease, which may (at least in the short term) result in higher prices elsewhere. Did Naddic have any plans to address this?Due to inflation that global has, i feel like global shouldn’t really copy exactly every changes that are Korean server is getting and should alternate the amount of credits/entries earned because I recently found out that they also change the amount of entries for the IF dungeon to just 3 instead of 6If I remember that the PD has said along the lines that “it’s to balance out the economy ” but this is based off the Korean server. so that this logic wouldn’t balance out with globalDid the developers also think that this decision is also appropriate to global and that is there any plans on changing the economy in any shape or form?
Dev Response
It is expected that additional credit spending will come as the Private Black Market feature will be added to the game soon. We anticipate that this will contribute to stabilize the amount of credit in game.

We appreciate your time to share your point of view regarding the IF dungeon. Making the entry limit into 3 for IF dungeons is necessary for both KR and World server to ease the inflation.

Overall, we will keep on monitoring the economy of World server and see what our next course of action will be.

______________________________________________________________

►Chip System Renewal
Are there plans to revamp the chip system? (Most notably the amount of EXP and the amount gained per level)
Dev Response
During the April 6th update, there was a renewal for the Chip System. It is mainly focused on reducing the amount of EXP required for overclocking.

______________________________________________________________

►Difficulty of Gear Spec-up
Are there plans to make gear transitioning easier? (As in more methods that doesn’t require paying to transfer tunes and enhancement)
Dev Response
We added an Enhancement Transfer system to provide an easier option for players to change gears.

We will also come up with other ideas to lower the difficulties of farming such as launching a Machine King Instant Transcendence event.

______________________________________________________________

►General Inquiries I
Disbursement of entry passes for future farming events to be mandated
Dev Response
We are currently providing sector passes as many as we can and we will continue to provide more of it in the future. For now, you may get them through in-game events. We kindly suggest checking the event announcements on our official website about where and how to gain passes.


►General Inquiries II
Equalizer change
Change equalizer to rarity based like fabric treatments so that older equalizers can utilized for newer content
Dev Response
We ask for your understanding that as of the moment, we will keep the current system where Equalizers are split by level to keep its original design.


►General Inquiries III
More empowered state effects I think it is worthwhile to have something besides armbands offered as craft/achievement/chain discount reward and it also adds to cosmetics. Something that could be of suggestion is to have empowered effects from Irina onwards or the legion commanders
Dev Response
We will certainly consider the suggestion for the Empowered State effects. We also believe that it would be a great addition to the game’s design.

______________________________________________________________

►Game Features I
Has there ever been any consideration of adding the ability to skip cutscenes/death animations after everyone has seen it at least once?
Dev Response
If you are referring to the cut scenes and the death animations of boss monsters, we will consider the ‘skip’ feature positively.


►Game Features II
Would it be possible to implement a setting to select specific sectors to activate triggers and/or auto-use item slots on so that players don’t have to manually toggle every time they want to have them on/off?
Dev Response
Thank you for sharing your idea of having On/Off triggers. Since there are too many dungeons in-game, this feature will not be considered at this time. We ask for your understanding regarding this matter.


►Game Features III
Are there any plans to make a multiqueue system, where a player could potentially queue for more than one sector at a time?
Dev Response
We understand that it takes time to complete a squad during queuing and having an option to join in multiple queues would be a great idea! We will refer to this suggestion for Closers’ future development planning. For the meantime, we have updated some parts of the squad system for improvements.


►Game Features IV
Something I want to add is that the game should try to be more ‘in your face’ with vital game tutorials.
From the recent returning event my observation and discussion with crew members + general public was that there have been a lot of people asking how to unlock trigger slots
Dev Response
Thank you for sharing with us your observations and actual feedback from players who returned from playing Closers. We will keep these details in mind while we are completing the Tooltip renewal that will be applied in our future patch.


►Game Features V
Is there a reason CMC tickets are only purchasable when there is a CMC event active, while the CMC tickets themselves can be used during any CMC event?
Dev Response
We appreciate your inquiry and feedback regarding CMC. It is intended to make CMC Tickets only available during promotional periods and it is not designed for stacking up. We ask for your understanding that we will maintain its limited-time purchase since this event provides quite a lot of benefits.


►Game Features VI
Could there be some way to transcend our Asmo gear to Machine King gear?
Dev Response
In order to facilitate a smoother gear transfer, we currently set up an event for an instant transcendence.

During this event period, players can transcend a Lusty Infinite Trinket to Sloth Infinite Trinket instantly!

You may check out this link to find more information about it: Machine King – Belphegor


► Game Features VII
More usage for sliver hero plate coin in the future
Dev Response
We see to it that some wants to have an alternate use of Hero Plate Coins. We hope for your understanding that there are no plans to expand its usage in the future.

______________________________________________________________

►Community
Are there any plans to recruit more CPC members in the future?
Dev Response
Yes, we consider opening a recruitment for additional Closers Player Council members in the future. Further details will be announced on our website or on our social media channels.

______________________________________________________________

Once again, thank you for the unending support to Closers Online!

If you miss out sharing your feedback and suggestions, you are always welcome to message us through our website support or email us to support@closersonline.com.

See you all next time for another Q&A session!

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (Part 1)
notes.content:
Thank you to all Agents who shared their questions, feedback, and suggestions!

Below in this webpage, you will see the topic along with yourquestions, and theanswers of our Devs.
We sincerely appreciate all entries for this Q&A session!

►Rewards for Veteran Users
Can veteran players get some kind of rewards as well and not just the new/returnee player? At least something to motivate current players to continue playing Closers?Will there be events for veterans who have been playing the game for years?Will veteran players or players who have been playing daily get Bai/Mirae/Luna Daki since returnee and new players are getting them.
Dev Response

First of all, we sincerely appreciate your continuous support to Closers, and we hope that you all stay with us as more updates are yet to come!

The New/Returned agent rewards are designed to help new and returned players settle down and to quickly enjoy playing with veteran players. Veteran players will also feel a similar need when trying new characters in a different account or coming back from having a break in playing.

We wanted all to know that we recognize the worth of your time in playing Closers. Various events from each update is one of the benefits for those who are playing the game frequently. For a meantime, we put our best effort into providing fruitful events in every patch update, such as buffs or rewards that are useful for your characters. You can check out the 2022 Closers Roadmap for the main updates that you can look forward to.

We will consider the “Dakimakura” on a positive note as an in-game event reward. We’ll be finding the right schedule when we can release this. Please look forward to it!

______________________________________________________________

►QoL Update
Can QoL updates from KR be brought earlier to WORLD server instead of waiting for a few months?Can we get QoL faster (for now bankable asmo gears, nerfed busan and tiamat are enough imo)?When can we expect the important QOL updates to global?Talismans account-based update when will come to CLOSERS World?Is there any chance in future mutant could be account bound?Will it be possible to make costumes inside the costume locker have images, effects, etc. so we could still distinguish it without having to equip the entire set.
Dev Response

We understand your sentiments about the QoL updates. We ask for your understanding that all updates are added successively per region, and it is difficult to update a specific feature ahead of schedule given the current structure of the game.

We seek for your patience that some of these updates may take a while since we are making sure that it is stable on our server. Yet we will try our best to apply those contents as early as possible for the convenience of the players.

For the Talismans, these are already combined with Premium Buff, so these are now account-based. Please enjoy this buff in the game!

As for the Mutant PNA, instead of making it account-based, we have a plan to add a system for this in the World server. The idea is to select a mutant type where you can focus on increasing its EXP which will make it more convenient for leveling up mutants.

And lastly, we are considering a new system to improve our current locker features, such as having a way to contain more costumes and options to use set effects.

______________________________________________________________

►Black Market
How did developers made it possible to implement this (Private Black Market) system and wouldn’t the system still have a lot of drawbacks or is it that developers has some policy changes that this system possible later on in the future?Is there a reason the BM is extended to include private trading instead of updates to direct trading? What is the reasoning for adjusting BM to support direct trades, instead of adjusting private trading to allow for trades of “black market only” items?With the private black market coming, do you plan to remove lower price limits for items?
Dev Response

Thank you for getting back with us regarding the Private Black Market. In our previous Q&A, we mentioned that we cannot receive your personal information due to legal restrictions, which it is still does.

But since this is one of the most requested features from players, we decided to have an alternative way to make it possible in World server. However, to manage this, we need some precautions:

1) The Private Black Market will have more strict regulations
2) We will keep an eye on those accounts with bad records and with the same IP connections
3) We will monitor any malicious activities or other activities that are negatively affecting the gameplay or community

We wanted players to experience trading with more convenience. Therefore, instead of the direct trade which is made with an old system, we will focus on putting more resources to improve the Black Market.

We currently have no plans to remove the lower price limit since the purpose of it is to preserve the item’s value. However, we will keep on monitoring this by collecting feedbacks and see what the best course of action for the given situation would be.

______________________________________________________________

►PVP
Is there any plans for another arena/pvp balance? is there any chance rattus and future character is playable for pvp?Are there any plan to make all pvp reward better (daily/weekly/crew war) or at least scale better for max lvl player?Is it possible to bring back or remake old 3v3?Is there any plan to bring back team challenge in the future revamp?
Dev Response

We would like to confirm that we have plans and discussions to find an optimal way to improve the current PVP system. We will also include the Team Challenge system during these discussions.

______________________________________________________________

►Healing Skill
Another thing to consider is giving every character a decent healing skill so they can survive on par with other characters. Characters such as Seha and Yuri doesn’t have any HP healing skills, whereas Violet only has FM2 as her only healing skill, and the heal itself isnt that strong compared to Sylvi’s Magnetic Infusion or Tina’s EX Sharp ShootingCan we get healing skill for every character?Seeing that in raids like Lust King and the soon to come Belphegor where they restrict potion usage and limits resurrection, all characters should have equal opportunities to heal.
Dev Response

Thank you for the suggestions for the healing skill. We understand that it would be useful in situations, but since Closers Online is a genre that requires a lot of hand control and skillful combat, it is crucial to keep the skill only for some intended characters in order to keep the character concept.

However, we will let you all know if in any case there will be further updates about this suggestion.

______________________________________________________________

►N-Coins/Price
Reduce fort cost from ncoin shop or just make it easier to get.Look into reducing package costs (espc 10k ncoin packages), these packages are pretty expensive and contain items not really fully worth 10k outside of the ss tuner.The prices of outfit pack or pieces are not that satisfying especially packs such as steampunk.
Dev Response

We appreciate each of your feedback regarding the prices of the shop items and packages.

For the fortifiers, we will find more options for players to obtain it in-game.

As for the packages, some users are satisfied with the current packages because it offers items that they need with big discounts, while some of these packages or items that are included may not meet their expectations. We ask for your understanding that these items have individual value, and you can get the most of it during package sales. We will come up with more ideas where we could offer useful items at various price points.

______________________________________________________________

►Platinum Service
Since the box updated like 2 years ago, can we get the better reward that follows the current content?There are still Hyperclock Equalizers, things that aren’t used much if any as most gears are now Lvl 85++ for most endgame ones.A suggestion to remove that so that the chances to get other items get buffed.Daily Platinum reward and Housing Washing Machine needs an update.
Dev Response

We sincerely appreciate your feedback regarding the Platinum service. We are glad to announce that we will refurbish the daily rewards as a whole. Please stay tuned for further details in our official website once the information is ready.

______________________________________________________________

►Washing Machine
The accumulative purchase of washing machines, 500 pull for 1 box?The washing machines still offers old outfits, can those be moved in the store?Are there plans to revamp the Washing Machine system? Such as having more team based washing machines or removing some of the less desired items. (Res Caps, Talismans)Will costumes in Washing Machine get only one colour type instead of three colour variations? since it is difficult to get specific colour type and for a specific character with all other items that we do not need are mixed into the gacha pool.
Dev Response

The items that came from the accumulative charge/washing machine purchase rewards are additional item/s that you could get for free along with your actual shop purchase. This is designed as a bonus from what has been spent in the game, and it is a gift of appreciation for your enthusiasm for Closers.

We understand your concerns regarding some of the old outfits in the Washing Machine. After further consideration, we plan to sell some of the old costumes to the in-game shop for direct purchase in our future updates.

As for the Team Washing Machine, we currently have this promotion from time to time. Then recently, we are offering a single type color for new costumes to get the specific type that you wanted more easily.

Furthermore, we also plan to refurbish the contents of the Washing Machine. Please look forward to our future offers too!

______________________________________________________________

►Game Launcher, Login
Will we ever be able to use other browsers to log in? Example: opera gx.
Dev Response

We ran several tests on logging-in from various web browsers and found no issues, including executing the game launcher.

We also ran a test using an Opera Gx browser and there were no issues encountered in our side. However, if you are experiencing log-in issues or encountered a web error, please contact us via Support, and we’ll help you further.

https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or email us to: support@closersonline.com

______________________________________________________________

►Stand-alone Launcher
Is it possible to add a login-in through the launcher itself instead of opening a default browser?When we will be having a stand-alone client?
Dev Response

I am afraid to say this but currently it is difficult for us to provide a stand-alone launcher, and I am sorry to inform that we have no plans for it at this time. We seek your understanding regarding this.

______________________________________________________________

► Invalid Parameter Handler
Are you aware of the launcher bug (invalid parameter handler) and if so when will you fix it?
Dev Response

We are currently having a hard time reproducing this error. In order to aid us with our investigation, we needed the Launcher Logs from a player who is receiving this kind of error.

If any user is currently experiencing this issue, please contact us at https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or email us to: support@closersonline.com.

______________________________________________________________

►Craft
As for fuel earning since with the “demotion” of beelzebub becoming a regular sector instead of a raid which leads to less fuel earned by regular players, I suggest a way to craft fuel with Sea Breeze, as it does not have a use after centum gear is complete.The discount system that KR has for crafting was declined to be implemented. Has there been a change in sentiment since then, or any opportunity that it will still be implemented?I suggest more options to convert bug lumps into area accessory set so players can potentially get the best in slot accessory.
Dev Response
As of the moment, we ask for your understanding that we do not have plans to increase the additional use of Essence of the Sea Breeze including the crafting discounts. Rather, we will discuss other designs to make farming more convenient for players.

What we suggest for getting the accessories, is to use dropped items from dungeons starting from the next main story area, White Night Fortress.

______________________________________________________________

►Event & Promotion I
There should be more event outfit variations and not just yukatas and other outfits that is only available for few characters.Every regular or special promotion outfits in-game should be obtainable in missions or available for 1-time crafting similar with the task force.Do you have any plans to rotate out specific rewards in the Monthly Attendance on a more frequent basis?
Dev Response
We will give more opportunities for players to receive costumes as a reward from events. Also, we’ll consider of finding different methods to let others have a chance to receive their own costume.

And as for the monthly attendance, we will renew the item rewards continuously.


►Event & Promotion II
In the current farming event a lot of the rewards aren’t useful (in particular the SMD for 500 runs) and Global gets the over tuned version of Legion Program where only a few are capable of clearing the whole thing.
Dev Response
We appreciate your time to share us your feedback regarding with the current rewards gained through farming and Legion Program.

We will come up with more beneficial events for World server in order to support players to gain essential items and needed materials to get through in dungeons clears.

______________________________________________________________

►Enhancement
Consider a rework of any aspect of the enhancement process.Any limitation to enhancement caps (i.e +17 max for whole server) or reduction in fever time threshold would be appreciated if it can be looked intoThe devs could create a more expensive Enhancement Transfer Device from Ncoin shop that doesn’t have enhancement penalty. With this implemented, they can make the regular -1 cheaper.For the buff voucher, I’d suggest for lower fail counts in order to enter fever for certain enhancements. Such as 50 for 16, 100 for 17, and so on.
Dev Response
Back then, there were many restrictions. Although there have been improvements, we are aware that there are still difficulties left.

Even though we didn’t have plans to offer a transfer service, we push the idea of creating the Enhancement Transfer system as we wanted to support players in preserving most of their gained assets.

In general, next generation gears are upgraded versions of the previous ones. If we’re transferring the same enhancement level to the next tier gears, there will be a spec-upgrade without investing, which causes the power inflation. Due to this reason, we hope for your understanding if we are unable to make adjustments to the current conditions of this system. Furthermore, we’ll continue to run enhancement events that can be taken advantage of, and to seek plans for improvements of the system.

As for the concerns regarding the buff vouchers, we will examine possibilities on how to improve the Enhancement Buff Fever system.

In relation to this, the Enhancement Buff was revamped, therefore, from 2 hours it is now 30 days. This is a chance for you to enhance your items with enough time.

Also, we are providing Pet Cores which are needed to enhance pets. Players will be able to obtain it through various methods such as from events. We keep on finding ways for players to easily obtain it.

______________________________________________________________

►Enhancement Success Chance for Level cap Expansion
I suggest for every +2 cap we get for maximum enhancement, the rates should be increased so that the guaranteed success would be half of the current cap.Is it possible to increase the enhancement chance for +11, +12, +13 and +14 since the enhancement cap has already increased to +20.
Dev Response
We have increased the default enhancement success chance as the enhancement level cap was expanded. Furthermore, we will continue this kind of update in our future patches.

For further details regarding this adjustment, please visit this site: Enhancement Success Rate Increase

______________________________________________________________

► Trade & Gift I
Please make Elite tokens untradable, where we can move it to the bank instead of being bound to character.
Dev Response
Since Elite Tokens are account-based buff, you may use it from each of your characters. However, we do understand your concern with the inventory space which we will be discussed further.


►Trade & Gift II
Are there any plans to allow gifting of the premium packages for new characters in the future?
Dev Response
We know that Premium Packages are very important to new characters. Therefore, we will take it into consideration of gifting Premium packs during the next character launch.


►Trade & Gift III
Will there be giftable options to expand inventory space/character slots?Can the “x1 Gear/Consumables/Material Slot Expansion Full Set” package be tradeable permanently without a limit on how many can be bought? Inventory space is a giant issue and it’d be really nice to have some other way to buy this from others.
Dev Response
We understand that gifting feature plays an important role of supporting other players in Closers. As for the suggestions to make the inventory and character slots giftable, we will review this for further consideration with a positive note.

Also, we appreciate the suggestion in making the said package tradable and make it as a regular item on sale. To make it more convenient, we will consider making slot expansion items to be sellable, giftable, and tradable among users.


►Trade & Gift  IV
For the new/returnee support box gears, could it be tradable in the scenario where we would like to level alts using that gear? It’ll make it easier for new players to partially complete their teamwork buff so their TCP could be higher.
Dev Response
The Support Box is meant to be used for the New/Returned characters only. We will keep the current setting that we have designed.

However, we understand that some players also wants to catch up using their alt characters. Therefore, we will come up with other ways, such as releasing supporting events or having a system that will help level-up alt characters with ease.


►Trade & Gift V 
Will there be a way to trade N-Coins between accounts in the future?
Dev Response
Sadly, N-Coins trading is not possible and there are currently no plans for it. We hope for your understanding.

______________________________________________________________

►Costume
I suggest to delegate mixed-type costume set to N-coin shop while type A/C to be retained in washing machine.Is it possible to either allow older pieces to be bought directly for N-coin? Or at least to have more than 2 washers available at the same time.I suggest having outfit packages for characters, since some characters have many options available.I suggest Eye Colors/Contact Lenses to be permanently available, I think more customizations will always be a popular thing, eye colors have always been hard to get.Suggestion to have more task force outfit packages. Like the ones available to Triaina Rebellion characters that are individual pieces rather than an outfit cover that aren’t part of the task force free pass package.Suggestion to have a way to obtain permanent versions character’s job advancement outfits.Any plans to make the Signature Costume – Cybernetics set available to Luna – Lucy ?Update N-coin shop with older outfits that don’t have portrait and has been not seen again for like 1 to 3 years.
Dev Response
We truly understand all your sentiments about having difficulties in having costumes or costume types that you specifically wanted. We will try our best to find more desirable ways to offer costumes based on these feedbacks.

Thank you for your suggestions to delegate mixed-type costume set to N-coin shop, permanent eye colors, and character promotion outfits. We are glad to see that players are interested in getting various looks for their characters. We will take these into consideration and hopefully set out stunning costume options.

Regarding the Task Force Outfit, it won’t have the similar function as the Triaina Rebellion. The Triaina Rebellion outfit was designed to have multiple pieces, unlike with how the Task Force outfits were created. We hope for your understanding regarding this matter.

As for the Cybernetics suggestion, it will be difficult to extend its functionality to Lucy. However, we will take into consideration having more new costumes for Lucy.

We know some of you would like to own outfits that we have released in the past. We also wanted others to have a chance to acquire those. Please stay tuned in our official website as we will gradually release sales of these outfits!

We are always open to feedbacks like these in order to understand how the community feels. Please contact us via Website Customer Support or email us to support@closersonline.com for any suggestions or feedback.

______________________________________________________________

►Mock Battle
I have seen how recently mock battle was updated in the KR server to be a race to kill the boss instead of a race to do as much damage in certain time. This greatly concerns me and other players for when it may come to our NA server.Possible to make another type of mock battle that doesn’t rely on the player being “Overgeared” and more of “Skill based on how player utilize the character”?Can we get more rewards for Mock Battle such as Gear Booster Fuels, Gear Booster Fortifier, Equalizer, etc. Since there is no real incentive for players to play it besides the Union Membership Point which is already a small amount.
Dev Response
We sincerely appreciate your time for sharing a detailed experience and feedback about the Mock Battle system. We designed the Mock Battle with a fast-paced gameplay where players could easier see the results and can compete under a simpler record.

We ask for your understanding that there’s no plan to add the old system again, however, we will review any feedbacks that we will be receiving then decide what we should adjust for the next season.

The renewal of the Mock Battle and its rewards will be implemented on June. Please do not hesitate to share with us your thoughts during the experience of the renewed system.

______________________________________________________________

►Extra Gear
Please look into buffing ex gear drop rates proportionally to our playerbase compared to krIs there any chance that we’ll get drop rate increase for floundering and mfloundering dungeon again?Any plans to disclose the box drop rates or increase the rate for the uncommon items slightly for the server?
Dev Response
The default drop chance for Extra gear was substantially buffed considering the number of users in World server. Regarding the drop chance, we will set up a plan to run an event related to this in the future.

______________________________________________________________

►Dungeon I
I see that you guys already nerfed the story of Black Lambs, Wolf Dog, and Wildhuter so we can leveling faster. But i still see dungeons that excluded from story is still around. Maybe we can call it useless dungeon. Why you don’t remove it instead?
Dev Response
Every dungeon is required to be played for the story in order to get immersed in the lore and/or to complete quests.

However, if you could provide us the name of the dungeons that you are referring to, we will review it further with the team.

We kindly request to send it via Support Inquiry or email us to, support@closersonline.com.


►Dungeon II
Can we get f2p farming dungeon? I don’t see any reason why you nerfed IF dungeon entry into 3, im sure it killed f2p credit source.For IF dungeon, we could have the same system, but buff the credit/drops rate by 2x once again, seeing that when it went from 6×2 runs to 3×2 runs the drop amount has been doubled, but when it became just 3, no buffs had been applied.
Dev Response
We understand your concerns with the IF dungeon entry limit. These were adjusted because the value of farming was too much.

However, items that are dropped from these dungeons can be sold to earn credits starting from the next main story area, White Night Fortress.


►Dungeon III
About the legion program is too hard for some certain character / class who need proc back atk manually. It is quite unbalanced for these player such as mine (Seha).
Dev Response
We are always open to receive feedback and suggestions for issues or concerns related to the character balance.

We kindly suggest to share with us which characters and specific skills that you think that is too strong or weak, then we can have it reviewed.

You may send us a message through our support via website: https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ Or email us to: support@closersonline.com


►Dungeon IV
Will there be more mechanic focused bosses in the future? (Something to encourage more teamwork and improvement of their characters)
Dev Response
We know that Agents are up for some challenge, and we understand that mechanic-focus bosses would boost the players’ combat capability and to have some exciting dungeon clears.

Since the time that the Machine King update has been released, we are finding ideas to add gimmicks or mechanics to dungeons. Please stay tuned in our website for any updates regarding this matter.


►Dungeon V
Is there a possibility of adding Gear booster Fortifier to give player more incentives spam 12 man raid after they finish gearing to keep improve there gear
Dev Response
Thank you for your suggestion regarding the Gear Booster Fortifier. We are glad to inform that we will run an event to provide this as a reward, however, we ask for your patience since it is not on the schedule yet. Please stay tuned!

______________________________________________________________

►Pet
Can we have a universal pet skill hotkey?Can you make every character able to equip same pet?Same deal with the Pet Enhancement system, you need to spend a lot of materials just for a minimal boost + a spare copy of said pet. Is there any plans to revamp that too?
Dev Response
Thank you for sharing your suggestion for a universal pet skill hotkey. We also believe that it would be easier to utilize the skills of the pet if we have this kind of feature, therefore, we will put it on the table and will consider this idea positively.

However, as for equipping the same pet suggestion, we’re afraid that it is not doable at this time. A character can only equip one pet at a time. We ask for your understanding that we will retain this real-time usage.

We appreciate your feedback regarding the Pet Enhancement system. We are providing Pet Cores which are needed to enhance pets through various channels such as in events. Furthermore, we will keep on finding ways for players to easily obtain it to level pets at ease.
______________________________________________________________

►Localization
Again this is more regarding localization, are there any plans to improve it for those that enjoy reading the lore?Only suggestion i have is having more clarity in the skill/skill cube tooltips, especially for earlier characters. whether it’s in the skill’s general description or one of its skill cube tooltips, sometimes certain characteristics arent described properly.
Dev Response
We will keep making effort for a better localization for players to enjoy and get immersed in the lore.

Thank you for sharing detailed feedback about the character skills and skill cube tooltips. This kind of information is important to us, and we are continuously analyzing the character skills efficiently. We are also happy to let you know that we have a scheduled plan for renewing the Skill Tooltips in June. Please look forward to it!

______________________________________________________________

►World Server Exclusive Features
Can you tell us what’s the exclusive world server content that you guys planning?Are there any plans to revamp perks of playing on Global?Please share with us on any works in progress to improve World Server (outside of any QoL from Korean server)
Dev Response
We understand your anticipation for exclusive features in World server. Since the last QnA session, we’ve thoroughly examined different aspects and concluded that it would be better to integrate our resources for the game stability and quality of characters & dungeon. This will be applied to Closers itself and not only to a specific server region. As we continue to manage the World server, we will release more events that aim to be enjoyable for the players.

______________________________________________________________

Click to continue to Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (PART 2)

Hello Agents,

We would like to announce the known bug that appeared after the latest patch update.

Missing ‘New/Returning’ Player tabs in UNION Watch

New Option Cube is added.Names of Option Cubes are changed.Option Cubes that were previously owned are changed into a box, and once used, you will get new cubes.Option Cubes that were previously owned will be re-obtained as new cubes with new but similar options to the previous stats.Options Cubes that were equipped on Skill are changed into new cubes with similar options and stored in ‘Cube Inventory’.Due to the changes on Option Cube, some related items will have different names.‘Cube Inventory’ is added.
‘Cube Inventory’ contains acquired Skill Cubes and is shared by all characters in an account.If you use Skill Cube in the inventory, it moves to ‘Cube Inventory’.Skill Cubes that are stored in ‘Cube Inventory’ cannot be traded.‘Cube Inventory’ cannot open in dungeon and UNION Arena.Character Skill window’s UI is changed.
Option Cube slots are removed from Skill Mastery part in the UIWhen a skill reaches a certain level, Option Cube slots appeared beneath Skill Mastery. (except for Common Active skills)Option Cube can be unequipped from Skill, and it moves to Cube Inventory.New ‘Awakening Cube’ is added.
‘Awakening Cube’ has different effect and stats when equipped.‘Awakening Cube’ can be obtained by box opening, crafting or conversion just like Option Cube.When there are two or more factors that can awaken a skill, the one by Awakening Cube is applied with priority. (EX. When both ‘Gear’ and ‘Awakening Cube’ give a same Awakening Effect to a same skill, the effect from ‘Awakening Cube’ is prioritized.)‘Skill Cube Conversion’ System is added.
Skill Cube Conversion System lets you convert 3 Option Cubes of same grade to get a new cube.Acquire a new cube with unwanted cubes.A new cube from Conversion moves to ‘Cube Inventory’.Changes on how to acquire Skill Cubes
‘Planar Gate ’ Crafting Machine has ‘Awakening Cube’ Craft List in ‘Operation Purification Gear’ tab.Craft Restriction is added to some Option Cubes in the Special Sector tab in ‘Planar Gate’ Area Crafting Machine.Previous Option Cube Craft is removed from NPC Shop and the new Option Cube list is added there.‘Legion Program’ Dungeon Reward contains Option Cube Box.Normal Dungeon doesn’t drop Option Cube.
► Chip System Improvement
Some new Chip Craft recipes are added.
A crafting recipe for Origin Chip is added to ‘Chip Inventory’.2 recipes for Origin Chip Box x1 are removed from Crafting Machine in ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area.Crafting Restriction of T1, T2 Color Chips are removed.Specifications of some materials that are used in crafting Chip are changed.
The following material items can now be stored in Account Bank
Ancient Dragon’s EyeMemory of BetrayalTraitor’s YokeWhen overclocking a chip that is equipped in Module/Trinket, the amount of stat increase slightly rises.When changing chip or slot type of gear, the same color slot as that slot is not available.You can adjust the cinematic system of mission dialogue through ‘Option’.
Sound settings in Option can mute a cinematic sound for a mission by clicking Master Sound or Effect sound.Turning off Screen Shaking Effect can remove the effect in mission cinematic.
► Enhancement System Renewal
Enhancement Level is expanded for some gears.
As new Gears are added, some Enhancement Level is expanded up to +22 for some gears.Target Gear: Lust Extra Grade Gear, Machine King Epic Gear, Machine King Extra Grade GearAs the Gear Enhancement level is expanded, the maximum Chip Overclock is expanded to +22.Several specifications of the ‘Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device’ are changed.
‘Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device’ has an expanded range of Gear Enhancement Level to cover.Previous: Transfer Enhancement Level of +11 ~ 20 New: Transfer Enhancement Level is available for +11 or higher.
► Improvements on Dungeon
Changes in Fly King/Glutton King Investigation Group
[Legion Commander Audience: Fly King Beelzebub] and [Legion Commander Meeting: Glutton King Beelzebub] Raid Dungeons are removed from the investigation list.Through ‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’, you can play Fly King/Glutton King Raid Dungeons.Fly King/Glutton King Raid Dungeons are changed to 4 member dungeons.Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons can be entered through ‘Legion Commander Subjugation Supporter – Leblanc’ in ‘Dream Theater ’ Area.When playing Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons, same rewards are given as the Investigation Group gives.When playing Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons, previous Investigation Group Achievement can be achieved.‘Matrix Dive’ is added to the reward list of Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons.Recommended TCP is 2,600,000 with x4 Resurrection restriction.Entrance Level 85, Gear Level of 130 with unlimited entriesSpecifications of Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons are as follows:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f688178a00d792aab6768332813eddd86f2a5c7d.png

‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’ has a different set of available missions.
As Fly King/Glutton King Investigation Groups are changed, ‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’ has different set of available missions.When playing ‘Ocean King Audience: Pure Lust’ mission, ‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’ appears on ‘Dream Theater ’ Area.Crafting Specification of ‘Glutton King Page Selection Box’ is changed.
Crafting Machine in ‘Dream Theater ’ Area requires different material for Glutton King Page Selection Box in ‘Beelzebub: Meeting’ tab.No other materials are needed except Glutton King Page to acquire a page you want.Fly King/Glutton King Investigation Group List is removed from the upper quick menu. The required number of task to achieve ‘Beelzebub Core Investigation’ Achievement is reduced.
► Improvements on Investigation Group
An option to give up Investigation Group reward is added.
After playing Investigation Group, an option to give up reward is added in order to avoid being forced to acquire rewards by accumulated Points.When giving up rewards after clearing Investigation Group, acquired points are reset.When giving up rewards after clearing Investigation Group, the count for claiming reward remains, you can gather points again by re-grouping Investigation Group.‘Contaminated Troop Basher’ that spawns in ‘Yod’s Headwaters’ dungeon appears more early.Entrance Time Limit is removed from ‘Contamination Hell: Overflowed [Reverse/Surface]’ dungeon.Daily Entrance Limit is removed from ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site: Heart and Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle’ dungeons, and the limit is changed to 2 time per week. (including Nightmare dungeon)Daily Entrance Limit is removed from ‘Gremory Science Facility’ dungeon, it is changed to 3 times per week. (including Mild dungeon)HP of monsters is changed in a mission dungeon, ‘[Nightmare] Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart.‘Transcendence Dust’ is added to S rank clear reward of ‘Mutation: The Temple of the Ocean’ dungeon.SSS Rank, SS Rank Rewards of [Legion Commander Meeting: Lust King Asmodeus] Investigation Group are changed.‘Transcendence Dust’ is replaced with ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’ in SSS Rank, SS Rank Reward of Investigation Group.Several patterns of [Nightmare] Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart dungeon are changed.
In a pattern of ‘To regain a lost name… and old glory…!’, the real body of Tiamat staggers after defeating its clone.In a pattern of ‘To regain a lost name… and old glory…!’, Tiamat clone’s HP is adjusted.Fly King/Glutton King Beelzebub Dungeon is changed: 4 member fixed -> 1 ~ 4 members.
As the above change in Fly King, Glutton King Beelzebub dungeon, monsters’ HP is changed.In Asmodeus Audience/Meeting tab in Dream Theater  Area Crafting Machine, a daily craft restriction is removed for Transcendence Stone.The description for how to acquire is changed in Glutton King Page Item Tooltip.The effect of [March of the Legion] active buff of Legion Commander Trinket is changed.A description is on Misteltein’s ‘Magic Lance Fenrir’ Skill.A description is added: ‘When using Enhanced Magic Lance, Fenrir’s Fang x3 stack is acquired.’ When using ‘Magic Lance: Muspelheim’ skill, the number of Fang stack of Magic Lance Fenrir skill is changed to 3.In a pattern of [Heh heh! What a wonderful test subject!] of Flying Gremory Monster, the damage taken outside of safe zone is reduced.For Rattus, in Gangnam District Map – The War Mall dungeon, some unique monsters are removed.
PART 2

notes.title: Pre-Notice: Private Black Market Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png

April 6th Private Black Market Update
One of the most requested updates is finally here! One-on-one trades will be at ease once the Private Black Market will be available in Closers World.

Mark your calendar, as the release for this update will be on May 11, 2022.

Here are some early sneak peeks about this update.

Private Black Market Conditions

We know everyone is looking forward to this update and wanted everyone to try this opportunity. Therefore, a Free Private Sale Ticket will be provided to your account once per day.

[strike]However, there will be limitations applied to prevent abuse of this new feature. But, if there is at least one character that meets the said conditions, the rest of the characters in the same account can get access to Private Black Market.[/strike]
Please refer to the latest change to this link: Private Black Market Conditions Update

Required Character Level: 90The character must be over 7 Days old (168 hours or longer)The number of dungeons cleared: 300 times
Long Awaited Projects!

Anticipate another roadmap release and a new season for Dev Q&A! We are happy to share our plans for Closers World with you all soon!

Roadmap Release

There will be an upcoming announcement of a new Closers World roadmap which is scheduled in the mid of April 2022!

Naddic Dev Q&A

Feedbacks and suggestions are truly important to us, and we love to see more of your ideas. Therefore, another Dev Q&A session will now start!

If you have questions, constructive feedback, or suggestions that you wanted to ask and say to the Closers World Developers, post it on the  Official Closers Discord Server in the #dev-q-and-a channel.

You may join to the Closers World Discord server by clicking on this image:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png

The development team will answer the frequently asked questions and concerns from the Closers World community! Please remember to be specific in order to make it easier to determine what you truly want to share with us.

The Q&A list will be announced in the Closers Official Website soon by the end of April.

Please note that the #dev-q-and-a will be closed on this schedule by time zone:
April 6 at 5:00 PM PDTApril 7 at 12:00 AM UTCApril 7 at 7:00 AM GMT+7
However, if you miss the chance to share it in Discord, you may still send it via Support inquiry to https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or send us an email to support@closersonline.com.

Thank you and we look forward to your messages!

Lucy Dark Command, Arcade Girls, & Leisurely Morning Costume
Get consumed by darkness. The Lucy Dark Command is now here in Closers World!

Chill out with your comfy getup until it is time to dress up with a ravishing Leisurely Morning attire or a rocking gamer look with the Arcade Girls costume!

Dark Command – Lucy
Get ready to be buried in a coffin and get consumed by Darkness. Lucy Dark Command will consume the remaining light.

Lucy can now use Dark Synchro Fiber for converting costumes to Dark Command signature costume. You can get Dark Command Accessory through Leisurely Morning Washing Machine.

Legion Program is added.Legion Program contains dungeons of various armor types of monster (currently INSECTAN, DEEPSEA, MACHINARY armor types opened)Can enter with a character of level 88 who cleared PNA Mutant mission.Must clear the mission from Dr. Bona Choi and can be entered at Gremory’s Dimensional Gate.Difficulties of some dungeons are lowered.Legion Program dungeon has 10 waves of monsters. Can move on to the next wave after killing certain amount of monsters. If monsters still remain after the time limit, the dungeon closes. The more waves you clear, the more rewards will be given, and they are obtained at once when the dungeon is cleared. Can obtain ‘Tesseract Gene’ as reward from the dungeon and it can be used to buy various items from Vending Machine. When clearing a dungeon of Legion Program marked as ‘Today’s Mission’, you will get additional reward.

notes.title: February 16th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png

February 16th Update Patch Notes

Contents & System

► Improvements On Game Level Design
You can now level up your characters of Black Lamb, Wolfdog and Wildhüter more conveniently.Black Lambs/Wolfdog Team
EXP from the main mission stream before Busan Nampo-dong area has greatly increased.Wildhüter Team­Mission flow of the main stream missions of Season 1 and Season 2 has been improved.Difficulties of some dungeons are lowered.
­In Yod’s Sea, the amount of monster HP to be boosted by the number of squad member is decreased.The amount of monster HP in UNION Division HQ Ch. 2 and UNION Tower is decreased.For some monsters, ‘Damage proportional to HP’ is replaced with Direct Damage.
[table][tr][td]Affected Dungeon[/td][/tr][tr][td][table][tr][td]

 Subjugation Program: Irina
 Battle Program: Hoffman
 Subjugation Program: David
 [Subjugation] Abyssal Throne
 Battle Program: Wolfgang[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]
­For some dungeons, recommended Total Combat Power and recommended item levels are lowered along with the monsters’ stats.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a353cc8f191bd088ea33e90c46c7e029bc9f4854.png
Specifications are changed for some dungeons.
Daily Entry Limits are integrated throughout IF dungeons in ‘Dream Theater [Reverse] area.Resurrection Limits of dungeons in ‘Planar Gate – Deep Layer’ area is removed.The prerequisite mission for Battle Program: Misook > Dungeon is removed, and the entrance condition is changed as follows:Character Level 86 or higher‘Scarlet Scorpion team – Data utilization’ mission clearedPlayer number limit is set to ‘Single only’ for Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart, Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle Dungeon.The prerequisite to enter Ancient Dragon Historic Site [Nightmare] is changed.
When clearing the mission, ‘Another Nightmare – Proof of Theory’, you can access to [Nightmare] dungeon.Mission rewards are changed for some dungeons.
When opening The SSS reward, ‘Fly King’s Treasure Box (He)’, you can now select 1 trigger out of the box.Gears that you select from early mission rewards were changed for Black Lamb/Wolf dog/ Wildhüter.Some mission rewards now give you full set gears:
Target gear: Verita Brigadier/Innocent, Hunter’s Night Epic gear, Demons’ Night Cosmic Trinket, Elite Trigger, Contamination Hell Trinket SetCraft list in Crafting Machine is changed/added/removed. ‘Hunter’s Night’ area’s crafting machine now requires more materials to craft ‘Scavenger’s Gold Treasure Chest’. When crafting ‘Pet Food’ through ‘Hunter’s Night’ area’s crafting machine, the available # to craft is now 3 -> 2.‘Traitor’s Yoke’ is added to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’s crafting machine. Crafting machine in Divine Battle will no longer craft costume box. Seabreeze Tree Seed is added to Housing’s crafting list. The requirement of accepting the entering mission to go to Dream Theater – Reverse area is lowered.The prerequisite mission for ‘Over the Curtains’ where you can enter Dream Theater > is removed. At level 85, all characters can accept ‘Over the Curtains’ mission. The Dungeon for [Nightmare] Tiamat mission is changed to mission only dungeon.
►Changes on Missions
Ordinary Missions of Black Lamb/Wolf dog that are removed due to the questline improvement are now recovered as ‘Sub Mission’. Agents who already cleared those missions before they are deleted cannot clear them again. But you can access to the story in the operational journal. Summarized story page is added to Operational Journal. Whenever each main story is cleared for each area, it appears in the summary page. For Supplementary area story, it appears in the summary page when entering the area. 
►New Costume Slot – Footprint
New Costume slot, ‘Footprint’ is added. When equipping Footprint effect, the character’s walk, run, and jump leave its effect on feet. Footprint effect vanishes after some time, and disappears when the character is not moving. Footprint effect has no tuning option and it is obtained as 3-star only. 
► PNA Mutant – 3 Types Unlocked
HUMAN / MACHINERY / ANGELIC
► Improvements on Loading Interface
Loading screen when entering a dungeon is changed. The loading tooltip info remain the same. But the space and size of Character Portrait Image is changed. As character Image size is changed, designs of all visual frames are changed. [Character Customization]-[Frame] UI is changed. 
► Black Market Improvements
Black Market has some improvements in its functions.
When closing Black Market UI, the search history is reset.The searching cool down for Black Market is now 5 -> 1 second.When registering items on Black Market, items under evaluation shows ‘Evaluating’ in remaining time.Favorites function is included in Black Market.
If you click a star on the upper right side in Black Market UI, Favorites pop up window opens. You can search items by [SEARCH] tab to add to Favorites, and the search shows every result that include the search word. When you click items searched by [SEARCH] tab, it shows all registered items for sale, and you can add them to Favorites by using Star icon. In (List) tab, you can check all added items in Favorites, and up to 10 can be registered. When clicking an item in (LIST) tab, it shows all registered items on sale currentlyBlack Market Guide is added.Tips for Favorites is added to the existing Black Market guide.
►Selfie Mode
You can now take a picture of your character ingame through Selfie Mode. Click ‘Selfie’ button on the right side in character UI. While using ‘Look at the camera’ function in Selfie Mode, character motions are restricted and it switches to default waiting motion. There another function in Selfie Mode UI that helps you take the shot without being bothered by other characters or NPCs. Functions in Selfie Mode are as follows. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6a36c34f1927edc45264cb1045ec24da4f342d90.png
► Seha/Sylvi character face model improvement
Seha/Sylvi character face model is improved. Seha/Sylvi character face Locations of accessories that are equipped on face are changed. 
► Convenience Improvement
Game Play of some dungeons is improved. The pop up that appears when clicking ‘Retry dungeon’(F2) in Yod’s Headwaters/Yod’s Sea dungeons asking if you want to go to hub is removed. Convenience Improvement on Direct Tuning When doing Direct Tuning and getting SS Tuning option, the re-try button is deactivated. Convenience Improvement on consecutive box item opening You can now input the number of box items for consecutive opening. ‘Skip (Enter)’ is removed from consecutive box opening. The consecutive box opening is faster now. Personal/Account bank now have more default slots: 25 -> 35 All dungeon entries have their button to end conversation not applied, and an extra button to close is added. A function is added to turn ON/OFF the warning message when your Contribution point is max. ‘You cannot earn any more Contribution Bonus’ in the settings. In case you cannot earn Contribution Bonus anymore, Contribution Bonus mark in Dungeon UI will be changed. 
EVENTS

► Level 88 Jumping Event
Event Period: February 16, 2022 Maintenance ~ March 16, 2022 Maintenance
► 4th Year Anniversary 2nd Dungeon Clear Event

► Other Info 
If you have points/rewards to retrieve from UNION Pass, the icon on the upper right corner will have shining effect. ‘Soma passive skill now has ‘it is not affected by Attack Speed’ in its tooltip. ‘Additional PNA EXP’ buff is added to ‘UNION Support buff’ located in the bottom of Teamwork Buff UI. Seth’s common entering animation of dust effect doesn’t appear if equipped with Signature/Unique costumes. Visual effect of spawning Mini Asmodeus pet is lowered. PNA Stabilizer in ‘Gremory’s PNA Support Box Ver.2’ has now unlimited duration. The max value of Hit combo and Skill Chain Combo are expanded. Cheolsu’s [Mercy] – Ricochet skill detail info now shows damage per hit for Flubber and Enhancement – Flubber. When acquiring Sexy Tindalos image armband and Yod image armband, they are now obtained as packaged. Camera move when entering is deleted from [Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King] and [Mutation: Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King]. Damage immune time when entering is deleted from [Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King] and [Mutation: Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King]. Camera move when getting out from [Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King] and [Mutation: Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King] is deleted.Lighting of character/background is fixed.
The issue that a character looks strange due to a strong backlight is fixed.Lighting will continue to be improved.Effects of some Enhancement level for Mini Asmodeus are changed.
