notes.title: SEPTEMBER 8th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png
  
SEPTEMBER 8th Update Patch Notes

Contents & System

▶ PNA System Renewal & Gremory’s Science Facility
New Dungeon Gremory’s Science Facility has been updated.

[table][tr][td]Dungeon Name [/td][td]
Level

Requirement 
[/td][td]Recommended TCP [/td][td]Gear Lv. [/td][td]Entrance Restriction [/td][td]Entrance Day [/td][/tr][tr][td]Gremory’s Science Facility [/td][td]88 [/td][td]15M [/td][td]160 [/td][td]Once per character per day [/td][td]WED/THU/SAT[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gremory’s Science Facility: Mild [/td][td]88[/td][td]6M [/td][td]150 [/td][td]Once per character per day[/td][td]WED/THU/SAT[/td][/tr][/table]
Gremory Science Facility can be entered through Gremory’s Dimensional Gate at Planar Gate.Gremory Science Facility opens on every WED/THU/SAT.Gremory Science Facility requires ‘Doctor’s Crisis’ quest clear.Gremory Science Facility related achievements and titles have been added.New dungeons will be included to crew reputation.New dungeons will be included to EX channel bonus.Quest dungeon Gremory’s Class: Degree Course has been added.Operation/conquest Progress reward has been added to Gremory dungeons.Some dungeons will not provide PNA EXP anymore.Crew dungeon, Commercial/ Guro/ New Seoul/ Gangnam Circuit, Legion Commander dungeons.Some dungeons will newly provide PNA EXP.Ancient Dragon Historic Sites, Subjugation/Battle Program dungeons.Amount of PNA EXP from some dungeons have adjusted.Planar Gate, Planar Gate: Deep Layer, Dream Theater, Dream Theater (Reverse).Methods to obtain PNA genes have been changed.PNA Random Boxes are not obtainable from quest reward, NPC shop and dungeon clear reward (excluding first clear drop) anymore.New PNA Box has been added to Vending Machine General Support Shop tab.Components of some PNA Random Boxes have been changed.Evolution success rate of all PNA genes has been increased by 10%.Name of some PNA genes have been changed.Stats of some PNA genes has been improved.PNA EXP increase has been added to Lore Talisman and Extreme Fighter buff.

▶ Monster Armor Type Reorganization
Monster armor type has been reorganized into 9 types.Armor type options for some gears/set options/titles have been removed or modified.Armor type options for chips/PNA amplifiers have been modified.Armor type options for some buffs have been modified.New armor types have been applied to existing dungeons. Dungeon UI will show according to armor type of the dungeon.
▶ PNA Mutant System
PNA Mutant System has been updated.Click ‘MUTANT’ tab on the top of the PNA UI to use Mutant system.Each Mutant provide specialized stats for each armor types. Only one Mutant can be activated at a time.When Auto Apply of Mutant system is ON, the Mutant will be automatically activated according to the dungeon you enter.Level of Each Mutant will be increased according to PNA EXP gained by characters with PNA level 80 or higher while active and can be grown up to level 20.Mutant system can be used after completing the ‘Mutation Gene’ quest.Each mutation carries a ‘variant‘.Each mutation has a ‘variant‘, and with achieving certain level, the ‘variant slot’ will be opened, and you can equip the variants.There are several variants in the specified mutation level, and you can select and equip one of the variants in the same row.Each variant has a grade, and the higher the grade, the higher the variant’s stats.When a variant achieves a certain level, an additional ‘mutation optimization bonus’ will be applied.Restructure Mutation system that changes the grade of a variant has been added.You can increase the grade of a variant through the ‘Restructure Mutation’ button in the Mutant UI.A certain amount of ‘mutation material’ will be consumed when the variant level is raised, and the required amount varies for each variant type and grade.‘Mutation materials’ can be obtained by synthesizing PNA enhancement materials and evolution materials and can be obtained with a certain probability when clearing the Gremory Science Facility dungeon.The more you repeat the synthesis of PNA enhancement materials and evolution materials, the more the required number of materials increases, and it resets at 4:00 AM UTC every day.

▶ Babel Program 40th Floor Expansion
Max Floor of Babel Program has been expanded from 30th to 40th.Entrance time per character has been changed from 6 times per a week to 7 times per a month.Reset schedule of Babel Program has been changed from weekly to monthly.Monthly reset will happen on 1st of every month at 4:00 AM UTC.
▶ Character Skill Balance Update
Some character’s skills have been adjusted. Please check the details in the provided link.Common Passive Skill[table][tr][td]Transcendental Power (Passive Skill)[/td][/tr][tr][td]1) All armor type damage increase option will be removed.
2) Physical/Psi Power will increase by +10 per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Power +100)
3) Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus will increase by +2% per skill level (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus +20%)
4)Attack Speed will increase by +0.5% per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Attack Speed +5%)[/td][/tr][/table]
▶ UNION Watch Renewal
UNION Watch became account content.If the highest-level character in the account is level 20 or higher, the UNION Watch UI is displayed at the top of the character status window.UNION Watch missions are determined according to the level of the highest-level character in the account.UNION Watch and Contribution system have been integrated so that the Contribution UI is no longer displayed.UNION Watch Missions has been categorized.You can select the mission category in the upper left corner of the UNION Watch UI, and missions and rewards are shared by all characters in the account.Daily Mission: This is a mission that can be progressed daily, and the mission and rewards are reset at 4:00 AM UTC every day.Weekly Mission: This is a mission that can be progressed on a weekly basis, and the mission and rewards are reset every Saturday at 4:00 AM UTC.Dungeon Mission: This is the same mission as the mission provided in Contribution system, and the mission and rewards are reset every day at 4:00 AM UTC.UNION Watch Reward has been renewed.UNION Watch clear achievement has been changed.Previously: Achievements can be progressed when all UNION Watch missions cleared.Changed: You can proceed with the achievements when you acquire UNION Watch bonus rewards from daily/weeklyExchange items have been updated to UNION Watch tab in Vending Machine.Lucky Phase Token is now movable to account storage.
▶ Teamwork Buff Renewal
Teamwork Buff System has been renewed.Click the Teamwork Buff button in the character information list at the bottom to display the UI.You can place the character created in your account in the team buff slot.Your team’s points increase as much as the level of the placed character.If team of the slot and the placed character matches, additional points will be obtained.Only characters with higher promotion than regular agent/crew or resolver can be placed in the team buff slot.Stats are determined according to the points acquired from each team, and the currently applied stats can be checked in the Stats window.After placing the character in the team buff slot, click the ‘Apply’ button to complete the placement, and the added stats will be reflected in the Total Combat Power.
▶ Name Tag System
New decoration – Name tag has been updated.Name tag system is for decorating your character’s name displayed on the top of your character model.Name tag system is applied per character, not per account.Name tag can be set in Skin Pack–Illust–Name Tag menu.Name tags cannot be individually selected for each category – Hub, Dungeon and UNION Arena. The selected name Tag will be displayed in everywhere.You cannot use the same name tag ticket while holding the permanent name tag.
▶ Enhancement System Changes
Enhancement Success Rate has been greatly increased.Duration Time of Enhancement Buff Voucher has been extended from 24h to 30days.Enhancement Buff now allows enhancing +13 or above gears only.
▶ Investigation Group Convenience Improvement
Some improvements have been made for the convenience of the investigation group.Crew Channel of the created investigation group is displayed on the Find Investigation Group page.If crew channel of the selected investigation group and your character are different, you can jump to the corresponding crew channelCharacters in other crew channels now can be invited to the investigation group.The invitee can directly jump to the crew channel of the investigation group.If the character invited to the investigation group is not in hub, has joined another squad, or has not cleared the required mission, invitation failure pop-up will be displayed.If the character invited to the investigation group is displaying another UI, the invitation failure message will not be displayed.
▶ Transcendence Stone Convenience Improvement 
Some transcendence stone extract crafting has been added. Transcendence Stone Extracts of the Ocean King / Locust Hell/ Old Castle have been addedThe names of transcendence stones/extracts in the Matter Mixer and the order of the crafting list have been changed.The names of transcendence stones/extracts have been changed to make it easier to understand the corresponding transcendence level and gear type of the item.
▶ Chip System UI Improvement 
If there is insufficient credit for chip crafting, the credit will be displayed in red.UI will clearly show how many chips you are crafting and the crafting count.When overclock EXP decreased with the chip transfer, an alert will be displayed.+0 gears cannot be registered to Chip Transfer UI with an alert.
▶ Locust Hell Farming Difficulty Mitigation
Notice: This will be applied during the Centum City update. We ask for your understanding.
▶ Trigger System Improvement 
You can access the trigger pop-up through the Mission Map for all dungeons.You can use Trigger menu without going back to hubs after clearing dungeons.‘Trigger Preset’ feature has been added.
▶ TCP Calculation Changes 
Defense Penetration options are reflected to the Total Combat Power calculation.Defense Penetration options have been added to some gear set options.Fierce Dimensional Beast / Verita Trinket Set / Despair of the Unknown Closer.
▶ IF Dungeon Changes
IF dungeons now share their entrance restriction.IF dungeon entrance restriction has been loosened.IF dungeon entrance restrictions have been decreased to 50%.EXP/ PNA EXP/ Credits from IF dungeons have been increased to 200%.Amount of drop items from monsters in IF dungeons has been increased to 200%.Number of clear rewards of IF dungeons has been increased to 200%.

notes.content:

Greetings Agents,

We will be having our server maintenance for Closers on this schedule:
[strike]UTC: August 18, 2021 at 07:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC[/strike][strike]PDT: August 18, 2021 at 12:00 AM – 3:00 AM PDT[/strike][strike]GMT+7: August 18, 2021 at 02:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7[/strike]
Update

⮞ We would like to give an update that the maintenance has been adjusted to this schedule:
UTC: September 8, 2021 at 05:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTCPDT: September 7, 2021 at 10:00 PM – September 8, 2021 3:00 AM PDTGMT+7: September 8, 2021 at 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7
Please be advised to log-off from the game before the maintenance starts.

During the server maintenance, we will apply new events and updates! Keep an eye on our website or social media sites for more news.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered
notes.content:
Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered

Hello Agents! 

Thank you for patiently waiting for the responses of our Developers. As we have announced on Q&A with the Closers World Devs!, please know that we have compiled the most common concerns and topics with the highest emote votes in the Discord channel. 

Below in this webpage, you will see the topic, your questions, and the answers of the Dev! We sincerely appreciate your unending support!


▶Topic: Content Gap between Korea server and World Server/Roadmap

Questions
Can you close the content gap between Global Server and KR?Is it possible to decrease the amount of time of content updates in KR to global?Is there any chance we get a roadmap?Will there be a roadmap release so that the community will know what updates will happen in the future?Answer

The content update schedule of Closers World server is based on the stability and content consumption of players within the server. We always try our best to bring improvements and contents from the Closers Korea server that can easily be implemented in the World server. 

Some contents may take time to be launched to the World server. The more complicated the content, the more time that we need to stabilize it before adding the patch. We humbly ask for your patience while we are carefully settling the outcome of the game patch.

Also, some updates may not be feasible to the World server. All Closers servers have differences in game contents and considerably with their own server economy. If we see that the World server economy is not yet ready for a specific update, it may take time for us to decide to include it.

This August 2021, we will be announcing the Closers World Roadmap that covers updates between September 2021 to March 2022. In this arrangement, you will be able to see the plans that we optimized for the World server. We will put our best efforts to provide better contents and service for Agents who are enjoying Closers in the World server.

Please keep an eye out for updates on our website and social media pages. 


▶Topic: Character Balance Patch and Patch Update

Question
When will the next balance patch release?Answer

We regularly check the character skills balance and try to adjust it where we aim for improvements in leveling. 

However, since we have 18 or more characters, it will take us for a while to set equal strength to every character considering that each of them has its own concepts and skills. 

Please know that we are mindful and cautious in terms of the skill balance, we will slowly make improvements towards a better gaming experience. 

We would like to ask your understanding that sometimes we are not able to apply a series of KR balance patch all in one patch update due to the game structure. We will try to adjust updates that we will apply in the future.


▶Topic: KR Server Collaborations

Question

Will we have any collab event in the future like the Hatsune Miku one?
Answer

Unfortunately, we are not allowed to provide collaborations contents outside countries included in the agreement.

We hope to provide a new collaboration for all Agents worldwide. We will work hard to grab those chances!


▶Topic: Character Jump Event

Question
Are we likely to get more jumping events like KR?Answer

Please look forward to another Character Jump Event around the 2nd half of 2021!

Also, we will gradually bring great events from the KR server, and of course, independent events designed for the World server including those that we have launched until now.


▶Topic: SP Gap between Teams

Question

About the gap of SP between Rattus and Other Teams, will Naddic adjust the amount of SP book to make it fair for other teams (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, and Wildhuter) Thank you.
Answer

We can’t directly confirm if we will be adjusting the amount of SP books since there are other ways to obtain skill points. However, our team will look for ways to balance the SP between the teams in Closers.


▶Topic: Skill Localization + Similar to KR Localization

Questions

Is there any plans for the localized terminology such as Seulbi (sylvi) and Magical (psi), etc

Will J skills name stay as they’re currently or will they be changed to their KR names? Hundred Fists -> Omega 3 Rush
Answer

We have found that there are some old skill localization errors and we have fixed it during the scheduled maintenance. We aim for a good quality localization, and we continue to look for those errors to correct them.

This is not limited to localization issues but also with other bugs that you have encounter in-game. The bug reports that we receive from Agents have helped us a lot to speed up the process to fix bugs and reducing these kinds of issues. We highly appreciate it if we could ask a bit of your time to report the bugs that you have encountered to our Customer Support (https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or email: support@closersonline.com).

Also, we have received several requests to change some localized words to make them similar to the original names in the KR server, especially Sylvi. We ask for your patience as we will have further discussions about this and if there will be any updates, we will make a separate announcement.


▶Topic: Community Page or Forums

Questions

Is it possible to add a community page within the main website where players can put up questions, suggestions, guides, free board posts as well as art page?

Do you plan to have an official forums where players could post guides, discussions, and post suggestions and could receive a feedback?
Answer

We understand the importance of the forum feature to the World server community. We would like you to know that we have been preparing it, however, we are not certain when we will be able to launch it.

Rest assured that we will make an announcement once we have any updates about this feature.


▶Topic: Closers World Market/Cash Shop Prices

Questions

Can the cash shop price be adjusted to fit the global culture and cater to larger audiences?

Can the prices of N-Coin and events be revised to be friendlier to the majority, instead of just the heavy spenders?

Can the cash shop price be adjusted to fit the global culture and cater to larger audiences?
Answer

For the accumulative charge/washing machine purchase rewards, we ask for understanding that those are bonus items that provide additional value from your actual charges/purchase. However, we will consider adding various charge milestones and provide more reasonable bonus rewards to have a more satisfactory experience.

We will also try to design more affordable packages and sales for small spenders. We seek your understanding that it’s hard for us to lower the default pricing of the products because it can harm the market value of items. We were able to maintain the market value of items for years and not only with the shop pricing but also with the content/event rewards. In the past update, we have considered the requests from Agents who are not using USD. To make some adjustments due to concerns about the expensive exchange rate, we have changed the default pricing of the Washing Machine from 100 to 90.

We will keep on reviewing your suggestions about the shop costs and try to provide products that fit the value of your purchases.


▶Topic: Product Suggestions

Questions, Feedback/Suggestions

Enhancement Buff Voucher -> Permanent Cash Shop Item.

Please add old costume sets to the N-Coin shop permanently.

Can Naddic bring back old costumes to the shop and not washer machine?

Please add a giftable Visual Slots pack to the N-Coin Shop.
Answers

Feedbacks/Suggestions that we have considered:
We will add a year-around Enhancement Buff Voucher to the UNION Store with monthly purchase restriction.
▶Topic: Black Market

Question
Will Private Black Market be implemented?Answer

We have received many requests on adding the private Black Market feature that has been introduced in KR and CHN servers. At this point, no other servers have this feature due to concerns about game abuse that can occur due to the ability of players creating fake accounts.

In the World server, we cannot receive your personal information due to legal restrictions, therefore it is not possible to have a similar account creation procedure where mobile number authentication is required. For this reason, it made us difficult to introduce this feature to our server.

However, we understand your difficulties in trading without the private Black Market feature. We have been finding other ways to apply restrictions that avoids game abuse activity but still be able to enjoy this kind of feature. We will inform you within a separate announcement when we have finalized our direction.


▶Topic: Training Room

Questions

Is that possible that this game will have a training room?

Can we get a training dummy or testing room. It could be nice to test either for PvE damage on certain entities or even just to sandbag test damage outputs.

Possible training room to test out damage, and to practice rotations against certain bosses.
Answer

We are glad to announce that we have the actual plan for the Training Room content in the future, however, we are unable to provide the exact update schedule for it. We kindly ask for your patience regarding this.


▶Topic: Contribution Shop

Question

Please consider adding Elite Status, Enhancement Buff Voucher and +14 Gear Booster to the Contribution Shop.

Can the price for normal phase wings in the contribution shop be decreased from 90,000 to a more reasonable and obtainable number, such as 30,000 or 40,000?

Would it be possible to add transparent costume pieces to the contribution shop to make them more accessible to f2p players?
Answer

We will review and analyze the usage data of the Contribution and UMP shop first, then we will see if we could consider renewal and improvements on these features.


▶Topic: Craft Discount for Alts

Questions

Alts any plans to make alts gearing be a bit less of a chore.
Answer

We will support alts character gear farming with more events that could help them obtain gears easier than before. In this way we can gradually make it as a replacement for the craft discount system.


▶Topic: Revamp on New Player Game Experience + Old Character Gameplay

Question

Will there be a revamp of the new player experience?
Answer

We will be introducing a support system for New/Returning players in the future update. For a meantime, we will renew the current New/Returning system’s events to support that could encourage them to keep enjoying Closers with you.

As for the basic level design, especially for the old characters, we have gradually and keep on renewing the leveling of old teams since the past patch updates. There will be more revamps on old contents that are scheduled to be applied in the World server.

We apologize that old characters and content went outdated after we have introduced the new patch. We will keep on re-organizing the old characters/contents to provide a more fun and worthy gameplay experience.


▶Topic: Incentives for Helping Other Players

Question
Will there be any other beneficial implementation on some raid dungeons to be incentive for carries to help out strangers rather than the people in their crew only?Answer

A special buff will be provided as a benefit reward for New/Returned players and for those who are helping them. To activate it to all members, the New/Returned player and the user who helps them should be together in a squad.


▶Topic: Crew System/Content Improvements & Renewal

Question

Is there a plan to revamp the Crew UI and system?
Answer

We have a development plan for the Crew Renewal system. However, since we recently focused on developments for new contents, it caused delays to finalize this feature. We truly wanted to improve the Crew content experience of our players, and this is one of our long-term missions. We kindly ask for your patience as it may take us for a while to fully apply this to Closers World server.


▶Topic: Squad Members Matching / iLevel Requirement

Questions

Any plans to have a better queue or party forming system? 

For some raid room settings, what if we could make it so that we can set x tcp to join
Answer

We are currently developing an improved system for Squad matching such that players will be able to set the requirements/restrictions. Please keep an eye out for updates on our website and social media pages.


▶Topic: Reduce Loading Time

Question

Will the number of waiting for “Loading Screens” to load be decreased?
Answer

We have greatly improved the client loading speed during updates in the past couple of years. Internal research for further improvements is still on-going and it will be applied to the server gradually.

Regarding the suggestions on allowing entrance to other dungeons inside the dungeon, this kind of system is complicated to be added, but we will find other ways to reduce inconvenience due to loading.


▶Topic: Game Launcher without Web + Changing Default Browser of the Game Launcher

Question

Can you guys at least make the game default browser to something else other than I.E? And make a stand alone client pls.
Answer

I’m afraid to say this but currently it is difficult for us to provide an independent launcher that is not going through the website. We seek your understanding regarding this.

For the default web browser, since I.E. is outdated we are trying to change it to the default web browser that is set from your PC. We will do our best to fix it during the scheduled updates, any news about this will be announced through website notice.


▶Topic: Return AOS

Question

(AOS) Please consider bringing back AOS
Answer

Unfortunately, there’s no plan to bring AOS back to the server as official content. There have not been many players who enjoyed this content when we launched it. We truly apologize if we are unable to provide a satisfactory answer regarding this. We will put our best efforts to develop contents that are better than the AOS mode.


▶Topic: Gear Drop Rate

Question
Did the EX gear drop rate really added into the game? Since no one still drop it until nowAnswer

We have checked the actual drop log of EX gears and confirmed that they currently exist in the game.

But since the amount of it is lower than expected, we will have an X3 drop rate event for EX gears from August 18th to October 6th. Hopefully more Agents could get a chance to obtain EX gears during this event.


▶Topic: Increase Enhancement Success Rate

Question
With the increase of cap confirmed for +22 on gear, will there be anything done to address this change?Answer

The default enhancement rate will be greatly increased with the upcoming September 8th update. It will be similar to the update that applied to KR server last July 29th. Further information about the changes that we have made will be posted in a separate announcement post.


▶Topic: Housing/Gardening

Questions

Are there going to be more items for the house and farm at a later point?

Will the housing and gardening be updated?
Answer

We have plans to renew the outdated My Room exploration rewards. Please keep yourself updated by visiting our website regularly.


▶Topic: User Interface

Questions

Will there ever be UI scaling for ultrawide resolution?

Can we have a UI scaling interface?
Answer

We are working on how we can apply UI updates to the whole system without issues. We are unable to provide an exact schedule, but it is planned to be applied to the server.


▶Topic: Raid Time

Question
When will you add 21 hour raid opening time, arent we CLOSERS “WORLD”?Answer

Raid time for Beelzebub and Asmodeus will be changed to 4:10 AM – 2:00 AM, UTC (total 21 hours and 50 mins) with the August 18th update considering worldwide time zone.


▶Topic: Adding Difficult Content

Question
Can we release actual difficult content?Answer

We understand that gameplay difficulty level is important for online games, especially for RPGs like Closers online.

As we aim for this, we would like to announce that Mock Battles will be introduced to Closers World server soon. This is a chance to prove your character’s strength and your abilities. Also, the latest raid content that was updated in KR server provides a challenge mode requiring huge TCP and sophisticated control techniques to clear the stage.

Please look forward to the content Roadmap that will be announced soon for more information about the actual update schedule for these contents. We will keep working on creating challenging but worthwhile contents.


▶Topic: Daily Reset Time Fix

Question
Can be daily server reset fixed? Daily buff upgrade come in several hours after daily reset & sector entry for some dungeons still I guess.Answer

Please submit contact us with your client’s Log file if you find/encounter any weird time reset in-game.

Send your Support Inquiry here: https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to: support@closersonline.com


▶Topic: Gamepad – Quick slot

Question
Please allow us to configure the “Swap quick slot bar” key using Gamepad buttons (or make it enabled like LT+ RT or LB + RB). Thank youAnswer

We will be checking this issue including the other Gamepad features as well. We will find a way to provide a better gamepad play experience for all Agents.


▶Topic: Patch Error / IP Ban Error

Question

Patcher update failed. Maintenance error. These two are common issues I see occurring with new users.
Answer

If you run into patch errors, kindly provide us with details of the error that you have encountered and your current log file (CLOSERS Game Folder > Log).

We need to check the logs to find what caused it to occur. Please note that the cause of the error varies case by a case basis.

For the web login issue or known as ‘IP Error’, please submit a Support inquiry or an email and mention your IP address, once we have this, we will review it further.

Send your Support Inquiry here: https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to: support@closersonline.com


▶Topic: Exclusive Content for World Server

Question
Do you have any plans to release custom contents for World server? Or anything that will differentiate it from other servers beyond the fatigue system to incentivize players from actually playing in this server rather than some other server like KR or JP or CN?Answer

We will consider providing Agents a World server exclusive in-game reward.


▶Topic: Gameplay Guide/Mini Wiki for Players

Question
Will there be a mini wiki/guide (can be community sourced and dev/staff vetted) on the website?Answer

We will be adding more informative content to our web guide step-by-step, such as a guide for gear farming.


▶Topic: Costume Conversion 100% at higher price

Question
On other servers, Synchro fibers cost a little more NCoin, but have a 100% success rate. Can global obtain that as well? The chance of failure doesn’t seem particularly enticing for any player and even discourages them from obtaining it. Having 100% Synchro fibers would actually encourage players to buy and make signature costumes.Answer

The 100% costume conversion is a feature that is exclusive in the CHN server since they are not able to trade signature/unique costumes.

We ask your understanding as we believe that the current system is better for protecting the value of items in the World server.


▶Topic: Emote ‘on/off’ Sound Option in Hub

Question
Can we have a different audio option to mute music from emotes they are annoying as hell instead of having to mute all the audio or moving HUB.Answer

We are sorry to hear about the inconvenience. We will include a mute option for this to our future sound setting improvement development.


▶Topic: Regional servers such as EU

Question
Any chance for an EU server? Ping is an issue for some.Answer

We understand the concerns of users from the EU, unfortunately, we will maintain one unified server for Closers World. This is to vitalize multiplay and market trade between players within a server.


▶Topic: OTP Authentication

Question
Can we have OTP authentication?Answer

We will review legal restrictions related to the authentication and development cost for this. Please keep an eye out for updates on our website.


▶Topic: Washing Machine for each team/not all character

Question
Possible change for Bitna to only roll your Character or your Character’s Team when the costume pool is for all the members.Answer

We will consider team Washing Machine for some of the costumes in the future.

notes.content:

It has come to our attention that there are several accounts joining the Closers Discord server in a short period of time in order to increase votes from entries in the Fanart Contest.

The team has reviewed this and sadly we are limited with options to filter out those accounts that are not authentic or owned specifically by a unique user.

Therefore, we would like to announce that votes from accounts who joined in Closers Discord server before we started the Discord Fanart contest (July 21, 2021 at 2:30 AM UTC) will only count towards the final Fanart voting. We hope for your understanding.

Be warned that we will closely monitor the voting activities of the entries until the event ends on August 16, 2021 at 12:00 AM UTC. Any confirmed violators will be disqualified from this event and any community events that we will have in the future.

Thank you and we hope for a fair vote results from the community.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

support@closersonline.com

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/20d3c4ce7950d0284f099add12a8524af23bd008.jpg

AUGUST Closers Day Event and Package!

The first Saturday of each month is Closers Day!!!

Event Period
UTC: August 7, 2021 4:00 AM – August 8, 2021 3:59 AM UTCPDT: August 6, 2021 9:00 PM – August 7, 2021 8:59 PM PDTGMT+7: August 7, 2021 11:00 AM – August 8, 2021 10:59 AM GMT+7

Hello Agents!

We have recently announced the Q&A with the Closers World Devs where we invited all players to share questions that you wanted to ask the Developers, including feedback and suggestions that you wanted them to hear.

We are grateful for the overwhelming number of entries that we have received, and we thank you for the unending support! Please know that the Q&A with the Closers World Devs answers will be announced by mid-August.

But to start this out, we will begin with one of the most frequently mentioned topics that we have received.. The Closers World Road Map!

This month of August, we will be releasing the Closers World Road Map that covers updates between September 2021 to March 2022. Please keep an eye on the Closers World Official website and social media for further updates!

Thank you once again for your support!

Don’t forget that for any further feedback and suggestions, kindly send it via Support inquiry to https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or send us an email to, support@closersonline.com.

notes.title: Summer Events Re-cap and Update!
notes.content:
Summer Events Re-cap and Update!

Hello Agents,

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions. Due to your overwhelming support specifically to those who wanted the official merchandise, here are the changes that we applied and a summary to easily know how to get that!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b086e175b3e91856b285fb354e3a8ddc37466921.png

Clear event dungeons and randomly get Summer Festival Exchange Ticket 1st – 5th, or Special.Collect x10 Summer Festival Exchange Ticket (SPECIAL) and exchange it for a 2021 Beach Towel Raffle Ticket. The more raffle tickets that you have, the more chances of winning!2021 Beach Towel Raffle Ticket will expire on September 8, 2021, at 9:00 AM UTC, but the data will be collected during the maintenance and winners will be announced on September 10th.10 lucky players will be chosen as winners!To know the other events that is related to the exchange ticket, visit this link: Summer Events (Summer Festival + Burnout Paradise) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9374f88f3b8bac03e0869687979eee65598281b5.png

Create digital art, hand-drawn art, or a painting that is related to ‘Summer’ and ‘Closers’.Join the Closers World Discord and submit your entry to #closers-summer-art-contest channel.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png
The winners will be decided through votes! 50% will be decided by the public through Discord heart react and 50% will be based on the vote of from the Naddic Art Team.A total of 8 Winners will win a huge amount of N-coins, but the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners will win the Closers Summer Swimsuit Beach Towel Set (Official Physical Merchandise)!Warning! Once the art was proven not originally created by the participant, they will be permanently banned from any community events in the future. This event ends on August 16, 2021, at 12:00 AM UTC.Winners will be announced on August 18, 2021, and they will be contacted through Discord on the same account that they have used to participate.Visit this link for more details: Closers Summer Fan Art Contest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e30ba4fc5ac9ba5fa4373f0642b5715e208f110e.png

You are not only getting N-coins from your purchase, but you could also get rare item rewards when you reach a milestone!All item rewards will be given based on the total amount of N-coins charged on the account during the event period. The top 10 players will receive a 2021 Summer Swimsuit Beach Towel set!Want to know if you are included in the Top 10 or not? On August 4th, you got only 1 chance to ask about it via Support inquiry until August 25t.As an update, we have added UMP to each milestone, and we will be adding more winners of the official merch!

Closers Summer Fan Art Contest

Let’s have some fun this summer! To perk up all agents during this hot season, release your inner creativity, and show your fresh ideas through art!

Showcase your summer-themed artwork of Closers for a chance to win a huge amount of N-coins and an official Closers Summer Swim Suit Beach Towel Set merchandise!

Event Location
▶Closers Official Discord Server: #closers-summer-art-contest channel

Mechanics
▶Create a hand-drawn art, painting, or digital art that is related to Closers and the season of Summer!

Minimum Size Requirement
For Digital Art: 1080×1080 (does not have to be square)For hand drawn/paint art: A3 or A4 size (please scan your artwork or take a clear photo of your entry during submission) 
Submission
▶One entry per Discord account and Closers account.

Submission Period
July 21, 2021 to August 16, 2021 at 12:00 AM UTC
Submission Location
Join to Closers World Discord server and submit your entry to #closers-summer-art-contest channel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png

Submission Format
Closers Name and Closers Character name + attached your entryClosers Name: Eunha001, Closers Character Name: Eunha + attached a photo of your entry ⚠️Warning⚠️ Once the art was proven not originally created by the participant, they will be permanently banned from any community events in the future.Any entry that has “Edited” will be automatically disqualified. If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove the original entry then re-submit it again.During the event end period (August 16, 2021 at 12:00 AM UTC) the event channel will be hidden to avoid any further Discord votes while all entries are being compiled.
Criteria for judging

▶ 50% Discord React Vote
▶ 50% Art Team Vote
8 agents with the highest score will win!Red Heart {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/01b0a8dab1cd66d22803ab735c24025aab1e7d74.png (: heart :) reacts will only be counted, any other reacts will not be counted.
Prizes

1st Place Winner
▶ 30,000 N-Coin + Closers Summer Swim Suit Beach Towel Set (Official Physical Merchandise)

2nd Place Winner
▶ 20,000 N-Coin + Closers Summer Swim Suit Beach Towel Set (Official Physical Merchandise)

3rd Place Winner
▶ 10,000 N-Coin + Closers Summer Swim Suit Beach Towel Set (Official Physical Merchandise)

5 Runner-up: Excellence Awards Winners
▶ 1,000 N-Coin

All winners will have their artwork announced on the Official Closers World Website and in Closers Steam.

The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd winners will also have their artwork posted in the Official Closers World Facebook, Twitter, and Discord.
Winners will be announced on August 18, 2021, and they will be contacted through Discord on the same account that they have used to participate.
Top 3 winners should be willing to provide us their Contact number and Delivery address for their official merchandise reward.
Rules
Players should post an original art showcasing anything related to Closers and Summer.Art can be digital, painting, and hand-drawn or any forms of techniques are welcome.Entries should be submitted in photo form only (GIF, Video, etc. will not be valid).Naddic team has the right to remove any non-related entries or discussions in the event channel. If you have any concerns, you may contact us at support@closersonline.com.Participants are required to input their Closers Name and Character Name otherwise; the entry will be invalid.No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any art that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed.One entry per Discord account and Closers account.Any entry that has “Edited” will be automatically disqualified. If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove the original entry then re-submit it again.Copied art from other participants or people outside the game will be disqualified.Please contact us (support@closersonline.com if you have complaints or to report a participant.

notes.title: Scheduled Temporary Maintenance – June 24
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png
              
Hello Agents,

This is to inform you with the following concerns that occurred after the June 23rd update. To correct the issues that will be mentioned below, we will be having a temporary maintenance during this schedule by time zone:
UTC: June 24, 2021 at 2:00 AM – 3:30 AM UTCPDT: June 23, 2021 at 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM PDTGMT+7: June 24, 2021 at 9:00 AM – 10:30 AM GMT+7
1st Concern: Content of the #8 1st Tab Chain Discount

The #8 1st Tab Chain Discount that should have a SS Guaranteed D Component: Costume appears to be providing a SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear box.

As compensation for this issue, we won’t be removing the SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear box which means that you will be getting two (2) items from the #8 1st Tab Chain Discount. Also, this will now be the default content of the #8 Chain Discount from now on.
For players who claimed the #8 1st Tab Chain Discount from the delivery box before the temporary maintenance that will happen to the said schedule, you will be receiving an SS Guaranteed D Component: Costume to your mail. This item will be sent during the maintenance.For players who were not able to claim the #8 Chain Discount item from the delivery box, the item will automatically change to a x1 SS Guaranteed D Component: Costume + x1 SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear box during the maintenance.
2nd Concern: Cool Summer All-in-One Package

The All-in-One package should contain Normal D Component instead of SS Guaranteed D Component. We have temporarily removed the Cool Summer All-in-One Package from the store and we will update it correctly during the maintenance.

We have removed the incorrect item from users that were able to obtain it. Credits will be removed according to the amount that were already consumed. Further information about this will be explained to those who were affected in this issue.

Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/

Or send us an email to:
support@closersonline.com

notes.title: June 9 Name Reset & Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6dd6fda065f2740eae13b84d93f745a265c8208e.png

June 9 Name Reset & Event

Hello Agents!

We know that it has been difficult for you to get your desired name or even find a name just to proceed with the character creation. After waiting for so long, it is now time to let go of inactive names for others to start over. It’s a new beginning and a chance for you to get the name that you wanted.

During the server maintenance on June 9, 2021 at 7:00 AM UTC, agents who didn’t logged-in to the game since November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC will have their Closers name and character names reset. For those who were able to successfully migrate their account but didn’t log-in to the game yet, we highly advise you to log-in to the game to keep your names.

Better be quick! A lot of rare Closers names and Character names will be available as soon as the server goes up. Those who register the name in-game the earliest will own it!

To go along with the inactive name reset is an event that all agents will get to enjoy.

Nickname Reset Event

To support you in changing your character’s name, a UNION Name Tag will be provided once you enter the game. Additional support items will also be given the longer you stay in-game.

Event Period
June 9, 2021 maintenance – June 23, 2021 at 9:00 AM UTC
[table][tr][td]Hour[/td][td]Item Name[/td][td]Amount[/td][/tr][tr][td]Login[/td][td]UNION Name Tag[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][tr][td]1 hour[/td][td]All-in-One Talisman Box (1-Day)[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][tr][td]2 hours[/td][td]Normal D Component: Gear[/td][td]2[/td][/tr][tr][td]3 hours[/td][td]Normal D Component: Costume[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][tr][td]5 hours[/td][td]Gear Booster Fuel I[/td][td]10[/td][/tr][tr][td]10 hours[/td][td]Gear Booster Fortifier[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][tr][td]20 hours[/td][td]+13 Gear Booster[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][/table]

F.A.Q.

When will the name reset scheduled to happen?
During the server maintenance of Closers World server on this schedule by timezone:
UTC: June 9, 2021 at 07:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTCPDT: June 9, 2021 at 12:00 AM – 3:00 AM PDTGMT+7: June 9, 2021 at 02:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7

What will happen to my Closers/Character name?
If you are an active user or was able to log-in at least once since November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC, your Closers name and Character names won’t experience a reset.If an account was not able to migrate, the Character names and Closers names will now be available to use after the server maintenance on June 9th. If you want to continue using the name that was registered from your non-migrated account, you can use it again in a new account or character after the server maintenance on June 9, 2021.If you have migrated your account from En Masse to Naddic but were not able to log-in after November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC, your Closers name and character name will be gone. However, if you log-in to the game after the name reset has been completed, you could freely choose a new Closers name or Character name once you log-in to the game again.Please be advised that if you want to keep your Character/Closers name we highly suggest that you log-in to the game before the server maintenance on June 9, 2021 at 7:00 AM UTC as there will be no name appeal after the name reset has been completed.

I wanted to keep my Closers name and Character name. How can I do that?
Make sure to log-in to the game in Closers World server before the server maintenance on June 9, 2021 at 7:00 AM UTC.If you have successfully migrated before and returning to Closers, you can log-in or retrieve your account by clicking on the “Find Account” or “Find Password” section from this site: https://www.closersonline.com/signin/

Why can’t I input or proceed with the name that I choose?
The possible reason is that the name contains a filtered word/character or the name has already been taken. For those who were became inactive after November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC, we highly suggest that you log-in to Closers before the server maintenance on June 9th to keep your names before the reset happens.

I was not able to migrate my Closers account before. Will I be able to save my character name?
Sadly, if you didn’t migrate your Closers account from En Masse to Naddic you won’t be able to access the account anymore. However, you could save your Closers name or Character names to a new account if you wish to keep it.

I have successfully migrated my account before. What’s the next step to keep my names?
You will need to log-in to your account again and enter the game. You may download Closers World server via website or in Steam.

Greetings Agents,

We would like to announce that the scheduled server maintenance on May 20th will start 10 minutes early from its expected schedule.

Below is the updated schedule by timezone:
 UTC: May 20, 2021 at 6:50 AM – 9:50 AM UTC
 PDT: May 19, 2021 at 11:50 PM – May 20, 2021 at 2:50 AM PDT
 GMT+7: May 20, 2021 at 1:50 PM – 4:50 PM GMT +7
Along with this change, the Cheolsu Black Hands Dungeon Clear Event schedule will be extended until June 8, 2021 at 8:00 AM UTC.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Name Filter Notice
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png

Hello Agents,

During the maintenance, we have applied an update with the banned words filter in-game. You may proceed to update your Closers name or Character name if you have received a pop-up notice in-game.

However, if you feel that your Closers/Character name does not contain a severe bad word, you can choose a temporary name at this time, and on [strike]May 20th[/strike] May 7th (UTC), we will be providing a Closer Name Tag and Union Name Tag to all users if you wish to use the character name again.

Also, please know that we will be having hotfix maintenance to return the previous word filter. For those who haven’t changed their name yet, you can keep your name when you log in after the hotfix maintenance ends.

Below is the schedule by time zone:
 May 7, 2021, at 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM UTC
 May 6, 2021 at 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM PDT
 May 7, 2021 at 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM GMT +7
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

Updates
 As of May 7, 2021, 1:30 AM UTC, we would like to give you an update that we will be providing the Closers Name Tag and UNION Name Tag during the hotfix maintenance on May 7, 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM UTC. You will be receiving these items on your first log-in to the game and you can only receive them once per account until May 20th.

notes.content:
April 21 Update Patch Notes

1) Contents & System 

Guardian of New Rice Event Dungeon: 

– Event dungeon  has been added. 
 dungeon entrance is located in the ‘Planar Gate’ area.  dungeon quests have been added for characters level 60 or higher. You can enter the ‘Otherworldly Rice Paddies’ dungeon twice a day per account, and the ‘Burning Rice Paddies’ dungeon once a day per account. You can get ‘Otherworldly Organic Rice’ and ‘Otherworldly New Rice’ when clearing the  dungeon.  title has been added. 
– The  event item shop has been added. 
Access the event item shop by visiting NPC Carol in the ‘Planar Gate’ area. Event item shops are categorized into the ‘Guardian of New Rice’ and ‘Harpas’s Remains’. You can exchange event items using “Otherworldly Organic Rice” and ‘”Otherworldly New Rice”. 
※ Only 6 types of tokens are shown on Event shop. Please note when using the store.

– Charm item ‘Harpas’s Remains’ has been added. [Shortcuts] 
You can get ‘Harpas’s Remains’ in the ‘Guardian of New Rice Support Box’ and in the ‘Harpas’s Remains’ category in the event shop.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png

Contents & System

1 ) Mirae Black Hands Update
Mirae’s new Class has been added.Mirae ‘Black Hands’ promotion can be progressed through the ‘Black Hands’ episode in the ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater’ areaA new dungeon only for Rattus team has been added in the ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater’ areaWhen you clear the Mirae ‘Black Hands’ episode, you will receive a ‘Black Hands Costume Box (3 days)’ item.Exclusive passive skills will be provided when promoting Rattus characters to ‘Black Hands’.Mirae Black Hands skills have been added.[table][tr][td]Black Hands Queen: Mirae[/td][/tr][tr][td]The state that Mirae has attained in the worst-case “future” scenario.
Originally, Mirae could have never gained such great power, but she was able to obtain it by undergoing trials in Fantasy World. It’s all for the sake to move towards the future, together with her loved ones.
Allows use of [Special Move: Accept Dead Night] skill. Using Messenger Special Move triggers [Queen’s Punishment], which is enhanced by the skill level of [Special Move: Accept Dead Night].
 
* [Queen’s Punishment] triggered by Messenger Special Movecounts as [Air Strike / Back Attack / Chase].[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]Special Move: Accept Dead Night[/td][/tr][tr][td]She swiftly jumps forward and slashes her enemies, then slashes them once more while falling to the ground. Once her series of attacks are done, she performs additional attacks for a set duration. Shadow Vines wind around the enemies nearby and terminate them at once. Becomes [Invincible while using [Special Move: Accept Dead Night, and all hit attacks count as [Critical], [Air Strike / Back Attack / Chase].

“I’ll remember all the nights that have perished, no matter what the future holds.” – Mirae [/td][/tr][/table]Mirae Black Hands promotion emoticons have been added. Mirae Black Hands visual frame has been added. Mirae character promotion achievements have been expanded. 
2 ) Divine Battle 9th (Dark vs Light)
The 9th Divine Battle (Dark VS Light) has begun.
Divine Battle Start
The 9th Divine Battle will be held from April 7th, 2021 to May 6th, 2021 7:00 am UTC.The settlement Period will be from April 28th, 2021, 4:00 am, to May 6th, 2021, 7:00 am UTC.An account with a character level 83 or higher can start the event quest through the ‘Count D’ NPC in the Fantasy World: Dream Theater area.You can participate in Divine Battle after selecting a faction through the NPC.
Divine Battle Progress

 The section in which the Divine Battle takes place consists of a 3-week faction battle period and a 1-week settlement period.
 All quests required to proceed with Divine Battle are set to be exposed only during ‘Running Time’.

Faction Battle (3-week)

[table][tr][td]Run Time [/td][td]All players are able to select their camp. Players who selected their camp can get Divine Point from certain dungeons. [/td][/tr][tr][td]Finale[/td][td]The Divine Battle no longer admits new players. 2 times as many Divine Points can be earned during this period. [/td][/tr][/table]
Settlement (1-week)

Divine Battle Win or Lose
The outcome of the Divine Battle is determined by the following three criteria.Participant Ratio/ Total Team Divine Battle Points/ Average Sector Clear PointsWhen entering the dungeon, only one operation area will appear.

notes.title: March 24 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png

1) April Fool’s Day Event Dungeon

▶ Event dungeon  has been added
The  dungeon event will be held from March 24th to April 21st.Requires Level 40 in order to enter the dungeon.The dungeon entrance is located at the ‘Han High School’ area and you can enter through the dungeon Mission Minder.You can go directly to the ‘New Han High School’ area if you accept the quest from Planar Gate NPC Bitna.You can get ‘New Han High School Certificate’ and ‘New Han High School Meal Ticket’ when clearing the  dungeon.Craft various items using the ‘New Han High School Certificate’ item.Consumable items from the event will be deleted on June 31, 2021, at 9:00 am.The dungeon Mission Minder in the Han High School area is displayed in a transparent state.
2) April Fool’s Day Skin Activation

▶ April Fools’ illustration skin is activated

3) Mirae Cheolsu Dark Command Synthesis

When the costume is successfully synthesized using ‘Dark Synchro Fiber’ with Mirae and Cheolsu, the Dark Command costume will appear.
If you have 6 sets of Dark Command, the Dark Command Pack will be activated and you can use the basic attitude of the village and exclusive emotion skills. If you have 10 sets of Dark Command, the Dark Command special pack is activated.

notes.title: Update on Account Suspension
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that 27 accounts were permanently blocked from the Closers World server. This is due to suspicious and odd activity logs found in their accounts. If you feel this is a mistake, please send us an inquiry through https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/ or send us an email to support@closersonline.com.

In general, we would like to warn everyone that using 3rd party hack tool, macro, or exploiting game bugs can lead to a permanent ban of an account or a permanent block from playing on the Closers World server.

Also, if you see any suspicious players or find any critical bugs, please report them immediately to our Customer Support and we will investigate them further.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

notes.title: Account or Log-in Issues on the Website
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png

Account or Log-in Issues on the Website

If you are having trouble logging in or registering on the Closers website, please send us an email to support@closersonline.com with a summary of the issue that you have encountered.

We highly appreciate it if you could also provide your current IP address beforehand for us to review your concern faster.

Once you have access to the website, you may now contact us via Web Support.

How to contact Naddic Support through Web Support:
[olist]
    Log-in your account to https://www.closersonline.com/
    Select the "Support" category then click on "Contact us"
    Choose the most appropriate category for your concern or inquiry
    Input the required fields and a summary of your concern, then press the "Submit"button
[/olist]
Updates of your concern will be received at your registered email address.

This does not limit you to contact us about account issues, you can send us an inquiry if you have any questions or if you want help related to Closers.
 
Thank you and don't forget to check out the "Need Help?" post for the official web links of the Closers World server.

notes.title: Mar 15 Hotfix Server Maintenance
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png

Hello Agents,

We will be having hotfix maintenance on March 15, 2021, in order to correct the rewards from the Babel Program.

Schedule by time zone
 UTC: March 15, 2021 at 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC
 PDT: March 15, 2021 at 2:00 AM – 3:00 AM PDT

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png

1) New Dungeon Asmodeus – Ocean King

▶ New Dungeon Asmodeus – Ocean King is added
You can find the [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon at the [Dream Theater  area]The level requirement to enter the [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon is level 87[Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon quests have been addedYou can enter the solo dungeon for quest clearYou can enter [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon when all quests are cleared.All [Eroding Mist] quests need to be cleared in order to enter the [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon.Fly King’s wishes items have been renamed to Legion Commander’s Wishes
▶ [Legion Commander The Audience: Ocean King Asmodeus] Survey contribution and point rewards have been added.
Contribution points for each part can be acquired by playing with a 12-player investigation team (F~SSS grade)At the end of the raid, a rank is given according to the number of accumulated contribution points, and the rewards will depend on the rank. (Once a day)
▶ [Ocean King Asmodeus] new items have been added
A new core/module/trinket has been added.The group before the reinforcement of Asmodeus equipment has been added.Asmodeus gear set compatibility has been added.          ○ TCP(%) Ranking has been added
          ○ Players on the top 50% will receive rewards
          ○ TCP(%) Ranking will be a different ranking than the TCP top 10 ranking

▶ The chain buff system has been added.
A new buff system ‘Chain Buff’ has been added to Asmodeus equipment.Chain Buff’ is a buff system that is applied as different types of buffs are constantly changed.The ‘Chain Buff’ system has the following types, and a probability is applied between each chain.Endless chain in the form of A buff → B buff → A buff → B buffA buff → B buff → C buff → buff ends
▶ New Gear Grade ‘Extra Item’ has been added.
“Extra Item” is the highest grade item.Group before Enhancement of Extra Item has been added.Extra items can be acquired through the [Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King] Dungeon.
2) Maximum Enhancement Limit has been increased to +20

▶ Achievement for Item enhancement has been expanded. 
▶ Enhancement Balance has been modified.
Enhancement Attack Power factor of +14 and above modules has been changed.The success rate is increased when enhancing +10~+12 items.
3) T3 platinum chip 
T3 platinum chip has been unlocked. Maximum Chip Enhancement Limit has increased to +20
4) Union Membership Point Shop
Union membership point shop has been added.You can access the Union Membership Point from the Union StoreVarious items are sold on the Union Membership Point Shop which can be purchased using Union Membership PointShop reset time varies depending on the item. It may reset every day at 04:00 or every Saturday at 04:00 or every 1st day at 04:00.

notes.title: Thailand Server Merge Guideline
notes.content:
Thailand Server Merge Guideline

Dear Closers Agents from Thailand,

Finally! Migration to the world server has been completed.

There are some things you need to do in order to log in. Please read through our guidelines below:

I. Delete the Original Thailand Server Client (Required)

In order to log in to the world server, you must completely delete the Closers Thailand game client from your PC.

How to delete the Thailand Server Game Launcher?

You can delete the Original Thailand Closers client after entering the ‘Settings’ menu on your computer and selecting an app.

You may visit this link for the steps:

ขอต้อนรับสู่ World Server

II. Change Password (Required)

You must change your password before downloading the World Server Client.

You will not be able to download the World Server’s full client and won’t be able to log-in from the website unless you change your password.

Change Password Steps

1. Go to the official Closers World website, https://www.closersonline.com/signin/.

Select the ‘Find Password‘ button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0d77109a75dd5142046ad1660217df7b7df76897.png


2. Enter the email address that you used to sign-up from the Closers Thailand server.

Complete the verification and select the ‘Send Email‘ button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7255659d658ad702745dda2674f39dba440f7725.png


A notification will appear informing you that a password reset email has been sent to your registered email.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/aa041333b35d4e328cc5c657bb65f2a5d70ab46a.png


3. Check your inbox and find the email that was sent from Closers.

Select the ‘Reset Password‘ button that will direct you to a page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/12b945ff6ebdbf815d70f96ca364d8b5b84c3027.png


4. Enter your new password following the listed conditions.

Please do not forget to double-check before proceeding! Once you are sure with your new password, select the ‘Confirm‘ button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6731f3cacc85a15a127e7b5c6c73dd8b6d8c8d95.png


After you completed resetting the password of your Closers Thailand account, you can now proceed to use the account on the official website of the Closers World server.

III. Download World Server Client (Required)

After you are done with the steps above, do not forget that downloading the Closers World Server.

Closers World Game Launcher Download:
https://www.closersonline.com/game-download/
*Account log-in is required in order to download the full game client.

Once you have downloaded the game client, select ‘Game Start‘ found on the upper right corner of the Closers World website.

Finish the patch and you can now enjoy playing Closers World!

Notes and Reminders

[table][tr][td]If you have any concerns, you may contact the Closers Customer Support at the link below[/td][/tr][tr][td]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/
[/td][/tr][/table]Kindly provide us information beforehand to resolve your concern sooner.Please make sure that you are logged in to your Closers Thailand account when sending us a CS message for verification purposes.If you sent your message using a different email, the Customer Support representative may require you to log-in to your Closers Thailand account to proceed.

notes.title: February 17 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png

1) Babel Program

▶ New Contents [Babel Program] is added.
[Babel Program] is a new feature that lets you use multiple characters to clear a dungeon of 20 floors.You can find the [Babel Program] at the Planar Gate Areas NPC Bitna Dungeon Entrance.[Babel Program] is a 20floor dungeon that consists of a Normal Stage and a Boss Stage that depends on which floor you are in.Different Buff and DeBuff effects are applied to each floor of the [Babel Program].

▶ [Babel Program] Clear Reward is added.You can receive the Clear Reward after clearing the Dungeon for the first time, and it may be Rearranged when the stage is expanded later.You can receive a “Babel Coin” item on [Babel Program] Dungeon Clear.You can craft various items using the Babel Coin item.
 
▶ [Babel Program] has a limited number of entries and time limit.
You can only enter [Babel Program] Dungeon 5x a week and it resets every Saturday at 4:00 AM UTC.You cannot use HP/MP Recovery Potion and Resurrection Capsule in [Babel Program] Dungeon. (Nightmare Queens Elixir Item can be used)If the Dungeon is not cleared within the time limit or the character dies, the number of entries will be consumed.You can retry if you failed during the boss stage.On failure in the boss stage, the remaining HP amount of the boss will be maintained in order to clear it more easily when you retry the stage.
 
2) CMC Material Conversion

▶ CMC substance conversion starts.
You can change the Product List using a CMC Rearrange Ticket and get the Products from the list through CMC Transfer Ticket.CMC Rearrange Ticket and CMC Transfer Ticket can be purchased from the Cash Shop.Fallen Wings Costume can be acquired through CMC material conversion (including Mirae and Cheolsu)UNION Marching Band C Type can be acquired through CMC material conversion.

notes.title: Rookie Agent Invasion
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4e2c2dd71238b107cce5cae0162cbe1d7360708a.jpg

Let’s spice something up for new players with an exclusive event!

New accounts that were created within the event period can participate in these two awesome events where you could get FREE N-coins and 20% additional N-coins.

Event Period:
• UTC: January 20, 2021 at 12:00 AM – February 16, 2021 at 11:59 PM UTC
• PST: January 19, 2021 at 04:00 PM – February 16, 2021 at 03:59 PM PST

Event 1 – 1,000 N-Coin for Rookies who achieve Level 86!

Leveling-up will not only experience you new adventures but it could also gain you a surprising reward!

Reach level 86 or higher and get 1,000 N-Coins (that’s worth $10!)

Conditions:
• Applicable to users who created a new game account within the event period
• Have at least one level 86 or higher level character in the new account

[table][tr][td]1st Batch[/td][/tr][tr][td]Participating Period:
UTC: January 20, 2021 at 12:00 AM PDT to February 2, 2021 at 11:59 PM UTC
PST: January 19, 2021 at 04:00 PM PDT to February 2, 2021 at 03:59 PM PST

1st Batch Rewarding:
February 3, 2021 - during regular maintenance
[/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td]2nd Batch[/td][/tr][tr][td]Participating Period:
UTC: January 20, 2021 at 12:00 AM PDT to February 16, 2021 at 11:59 PM UTC
PST: January 19, 2021 at 04:00 PM PDT to February 16, 2021 at 03:59 PM PST

2nd Batch Rewarding:
February 17, 2021 - during regular maintenance
[/td][/tr][/table]
• Users who have received the reward during 1st batch will be excluded from the 2nd batch (Reward is once per account).

Event 2 - Additional 20% N-coins for the Rookies

To give you a kick-start for your adventure, we will be adding up 20% N-coins from your total amount charge during the event period!

Conditions:
• Newly created accounts in the Closers website within the event period
• Purchased N-coins from the website for the first time within the event period

[table][tr][td]Reward: 20% additional N-coins amount of the total charge price within the period
[/td][/tr][tr][td]The reward will be given on [strike]March 3, 2021[/strike] March 10, 2021- during the server maintenance[/td][/tr][/table]

We appreciate your willingness to join this event, however, taking advantage of this event may negatively affect your account.

Update:

Due to the change of update schedule, the Reward distribution for the 20% additional N-coins amount has been changed from March 3 to March 10.

Account Creation and Verification Issue

Let the music take you away. Everyone is born to rock with the Shining Star Costumes!

This is the first Unique Costume that will roll along with our December 17th update.

New Commands when using the Shining Star Costume:
 Band: /music, /MUSIC, /band, /BAND
 Solo: /play, /PLAY, /solo, /SOLO

1. Shining Synchro Fiber
 Shining Synchro Fiber is one of the basic items necessary for the Shining Star Costume Conversion.
 Converting Shining Synchro Fiber has a chance to acquire a Shining Star Costume.

2. Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume]
 An item that can repackage Unique Costume once.
 Can be repeated but won’t work if the repackaging count has reached the maximum limit.
 The necessary amount of Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume] will depend on the specific Unique Costume.
 Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume] can be purchased in the Store with no purchase restriction and it is tradable.

notes.content:
1) New Dungeon [Eroding Mist – Misty Castle]
▶ New Dungeon [Eroding Mist – Misty Castle] is added.

[Misty Castle] Dungeon can be entered through Hunter’s Night Area.
[Misty Castle] Dungeon Quest is added.
[Misty Castle] Dungeon can be entered after the ‘Fly King’s Growth – Gluttony King’ Quest Clear.
[Misty Castle] Dungeon will be selected randomly between 8 Hunter’s Night Area Dungeon.
[Misty Castle] On Dungeon Entrance, ‘Phase Change Kit’ Item will be consumed and it can be crafted through MatterMixer.

Update:

 Character name
